## 10S.23 Close Condition

Boot/session layer is trusted only if:

`boot starts at user front door`

`boot writes boot receipt`

`boot runs recovery scan first`

`boot runs reducer verify`

`boot runs sync guard`

`boot checks open tokens`

`boot checks pending receipts`

`boot checks root intake`

`boot checks human review`

`boot projects console from trusted state`

`shutdown writes shutdown receipt`

`handoff packet preserves blockers and DoesNotProve`

`nxt resolves to next legal action`

If any missing:

`COMMAND_CENTER_BOOT_LAYER_NOT_TRUSTED`

If all pass:

`COMMAND_CENTER_BOOT_LAYER_MVP_PASS`

---

## 10S.24 Batch 10S Carry Line

`THE COMMAND CENTER MUST BOOT BEFORE IT WORKS. START AT USER FRONT DOOR, THEN RECOVER, REDUCE, SYNC, CHECK ROOT, CHECK TOKENS, CHECK RECEIPTS, CHECK HUMAN REVIEW, CHECK GUARD, PROJECT CONSOLE, WRITE BOOT RECEIPT, AND ONLY THEN SHOW NEXT LEGAL ACTION. STARTUP DOES NOT DO WORK. SHUTDOWN PRESERVES OPEN TRUTH, NOT FAKE COMPLETION. NO BOOT RECEIPT, NO TRUSTED RESUME.`









## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 10T — Schema Versioning / Migration / Upgrade Standard / No Silent Shape Drift

Batch 10S built boot and session lifecycle. Batch 10T handles the next long-term failure point: **the command center will evolve**, and if its files, ledgers, schemas, buttons, gates, packets, and receipts change without controlled migration, the whole system will rot.

The danger is not only broken files. The danger is silent mismatch:

`old receipt schema`
but
`new receipt judge`

`old button meaning`
but
`new command grammar`

`old packet fields`
but
`new actor adapter`

`old dashboard projection`
but
`new reducer invariant`

That creates ghost-state.

Core rule:

`COMMAND CENTER SHAPE MAY CHANGE ONLY THROUGH VERSIONED MIGRATION.`

Carry line:

`NO SCHEMA DRIFT. NO SILENT FIELD CHANGE. NO OLD PACKET FLOATING FORWARD. EVERY UPGRADE NEEDS VERSION, MIGRATION PLAN, BACKUP SNAPSHOT, COMPATIBILITY VERDICT, TEST, RECEIPT, AND ROLLBACK PATH.`

---

## 10T.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_SCHEMA_VERSIONING_AND_MIGRATION_STANDARD_V0_1`

Wording:

`EVERY COMMAND CENTER FILE, LEDGER, PACKET, RECEIPT, BUTTON, GATE, ADAPTER, REDUCER OUTPUT, CONSOLE PROJECTION, AND TEST FIXTURE MUST DECLARE ITS SCHEMA VERSION. ANY CHANGE TO REQUIRED FIELDS, meanings, allowed values, authority boundaries, gate order, transaction phases, or receipt requirements must be migrated under a versioned migration packet and receipt.`

This blocks:

`new assistant expects fields old files do not have`

`old receipt accepted under new judge without compatibility check`

`button label unchanged but meaning changed`

`gate order changed without test`

`old mutation packet reused after schema upgrade`

`dashboard rebuilt from stale state`

`schema update overwrites human approval`

`migration script modifies live state without receipt`

---

## 10T.2 Version Classes

Not every change is the same.

Use explicit version class:

`PATCH`

Clarifies text, fixes typo, adds non-required explanation. No schema or authority change.

`MINOR`

Adds optional fields, new non-breaking verdicts, new read-only views, new tests. Existing records remain valid.

`MAJOR`

Changes required fields, authority rules, gate order, receipt requirements, button meaning, reducer invariants, actor adapter contract, mutation policy, or closeout standard.

`EMERGENCY`

Blocks unsafe behavior immediately. May add freeze rule before full migration, but must write emergency receipt and later reconcile.

Hard rule:

`ANY AUTHORITY CHANGE IS MAJOR UNLESS PROVEN OTHERWISE.`

---

## 10T.3 Schema Registry

Create:

```text
_LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS\
  ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER_STATE\
    SCHEMA_REGISTRY.csv
```

Columns:

```text
SchemaId,SchemaName,SchemaVersion,AppliesTo,RequiredFields,OptionalFields,AllowedValues,Owner,CurrentStatus,IntroducedByMigration,DeprecatedByMigration,CompatibleFrom,CompatibleTo,DoesNotProve
```

AppliesTo values:

`USER_CONSOLE`

`ACTIVE_OBJECT`

`ACTOR_BOARD`

`WORK_TOKEN_LEDGER`

`ROUTER_LEDGER`

`CUSTODY_PACKET_INDEX`

`RECEIPT_INDEX`

`BLOCKER_BOARD`

`HUMAN_REVIEW_QUEUE`

`BYTE_ACCOUNTING_LEDGER`

`GUARD_STATUS`

`ROOT_INTAKE_QUEUE`

`TRANSACTION_LOG`

`GATE_REGISTRY`

`GATE_RECEIPT`

`DISPATCH_QUEUE`

`ACTOR_ADAPTER_REGISTRY`

`BOOT_RECEIPT`

`SHUTDOWN_RECEIPT`

`MUTATION_PACKET`

`HUMAN_APPROVAL_RECEIPT`

`COMMAND_RECEIPT`

`TEST_FIXTURE`

Default if unknown:

`SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_BLOCKED`

---

## 10T.4 Required Schema Header

Every markdown/json/csv-ledger family must carry or map to a schema version.

For markdown:

```text
SchemaName:
SchemaVersion:
GeneratedFrom:
CanonicalSource:
LastProjectionUtc:
DoesNotProve:
```

For JSON:

```json
{
  "SchemaName": "",
  "SchemaVersion": "",
  "GeneratedFrom": "",
  "CanonicalSource": "",
  "DoesNotProve": []
}
```

For CSV:

The schema registry must identify the exact header row and version. If the CSV itself cannot store metadata cleanly, pair it with:

```text
<LEDGER_NAME>.schema.json
```

Hard line:

`NO SCHEMA VERSION, NO TRUSTED INGEST.`

---

## 10T.5 Migration Packet

Every migration needs a packet.

```text
MIGRATION_PACKET

MigrationId:
CreatedUtc:
RequestedBy:
MigrationClass:
FromVersion:
ToVersion:
AffectedSchemas:
AffectedFiles:
AffectedActors:
AffectedGates:
AffectedButtons:
AffectedPackets:
AffectedReceipts:

Reason:
Risk:
AuthorityChange:
HumanApprovalRequired:
BackupSnapshotRequired:
DryRunRequired:
ReducerRebuildRequired:
TestBenchRequired:
RollbackPlan:

ForbiddenActions:
StopConditions:
DoesNotProve:
NextLegalAction:
```

Default:

`DryRunRequired: true`

`BackupSnapshotRequired: true`

`TestBenchRequired: true`

If migration touches approval fields, mutation packets, gate order, authority matrix, or closeout:

`HumanApprovalRequired: true`

---

## 10T.6 Migration Modes

Allowed modes:

`DRY_RUN_ONLY`

Reads files, reports proposed changes. Writes report only.

`SCHEMA_REGISTER_ONLY`

Adds schema metadata. Does not modify live state.

`PROJECTION_REBUILD_ONLY`

Rebuilds user/backstage views from reducer output.

`STATE_MATERIALIZATION_REBUILD`

Rebuilds assistant materialized state from canonical log.

`CANONICAL_MIGRATION`

Changes canonical records or how they are interpreted. High risk.

`EMERGENCY_FREEZE_MIGRATION`

Adds blocker/freeze rule to stop unsafe behavior. No cleanup.

`ROLLBACK_STATE_ONLY`

Restores command-center state from snapshot. Does not touch project files.

Forbidden mode:

`JUST_UPDATE_FILES`

No such legal mode.

---

## 10T.7 Migration Preflight

Before migration:

1. Run boot.
2. Run recovery scan.
3. Run reducer verify.
4. Run sync guard.
5. Run root leakage guard.
6. Snapshot command-center state.
7. Snapshot schema registry.
8. Identify open work tokens.
9. Identify pending receipts.
10. Identify pending human approvals.
11. Identify active blockers.
12. Decide if migration can proceed.

If any unresolved recovery issue exists:

`MIGRATION_BLOCKED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED`

If open work token exists:

`MIGRATION_BLOCKED_OPEN_WORK_TOKEN`

unless migration is emergency freeze.

If pending human approval exists and migration touches approval schema:

`MIGRATION_BLOCKED_HUMAN_APPROVAL_PENDING`

Hard rule:

`DO NOT MIGRATE WHILE THE HOUSE IS MID-STEP UNLESS THE MIGRATION IS A FREEZE/RECOVERY MIGRATION.`

---

## 10T.8 Migration Snapshot

Before migration, create:

```text
_LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS\
  ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER_STATE\
    MIGRATION_SNAPSHOTS\
      MIGRATION_<UTC>_<MIGRATION_ID>\
```

Must include:

`SCHEMA_REGISTRY.csv`

`AUTHORITY_MATRIX.csv`

`GATE_REGISTRY.csv`

`COMMAND_CENTER_TRANSACTION_LOG.jsonl`

`COMMAND_CENTER_HASH_CHAIN.jsonl`

all materialized state files,

all user-facing projection files,

all assistant backstage view files,

migration packet,

preflight report.

Snapshot manifest:

```text
MIGRATION_SNAPSHOT_MANIFEST

MigrationId:
CreatedUtc:
FilesIncluded:
FileHashes:
OpenWorkTokens:
PendingReceipts:
OpenBlockers:
HumanApprovalItems:
DoesNotProve:
```

DoesNotProve:

`Migration snapshot preserves command-center state only.`
`Migration snapshot does not authorize rollback of project files.`
`Migration snapshot does not prove old state was correct.`

---

## 10T.9 Compatibility Matrix

Create:

```text
_LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS\
  ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER_STATE\
    SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY_MATRIX.csv
```

Columns:

```text
Consumer,ConsumerVersion,ProducerSchema,ProducerVersion,Compatible,CompatibilityMode,RequiredAdapter,BlockIfMissing,DoesNotProve
```

Consumers:

`reducer`

`projection builder`

`receipt judge`

`gate engine`

`scheduler`

`actor adapter`

`operator console`

`boot layer`

`test bench`

Compatibility modes:

`NATIVE`

Consumer reads schema directly.

`ADAPTER_REQUIRED`

Translation adapter required.

`READ_ONLY_LEGACY`

Can read old record, cannot use it for new authority.

`BLOCKED`

Cannot use.

Hard rule:

`LEGACY RECORDS MAY BE EVIDENCE. THEY ARE NOT AUTOMATIC CURRENT AUTHORITY.`

---

## 10T.10 Legacy Record Rule

Old records must not be discarded.

Old receipts, packets, and logs remain evidence.

But they may become:

`LEGACY_EVIDENCE_ONLY`

Meaning:

they can support history,

but cannot authorize new work,

cannot close current active object,

cannot approve mutation,

cannot be reused as packet,

unless migrated.

Failure labels:

`OLD_PACKET_USED_AS_CURRENT_AUTHORITY`

`LEGACY_RECEIPT_ACCEPTED_WITHOUT_COMPATIBILITY_CHECK`

`LEGACY_APPROVAL_FLOATS_FORWARD`

---

## 10T.11 Migration Gate

Add gate:

`GATE_SCHEMA_MIGRATION`

Checks:

`migration packet exists`

`version class declared`

`affected schemas listed`

`snapshot exists`

`dry run exists`

`compatibility checked`

`open work tokens resolved`

`pending receipts handled`

`human approval required if authority changes`

`test fixtures selected`

`rollback plan exists`

Blocks:

`MIGRATION_PACKET_MISSING`

`MIGRATION_VERSION_CLASS_MISSING`

`MIGRATION_SNAPSHOT_MISSING`

`MIGRATION_DRY_RUN_MISSING`

`MIGRATION_COMPATIBILITY_UNKNOWN`

`MIGRATION_AUTHORITY_CHANGE_WITHOUT_HUMAN_REVIEW`

`MIGRATION_TESTS_MISSING`

`MIGRATION_ROLLBACK_MISSING`

DoesNotProve:

`Migration readiness does not prove migration succeeded.`

---

## 10T.12 Migration Execution Rule

Migration must run as a transaction group.

Phases:

`MIGRATION_RECEIVED`

`MIGRATION_PREFLIGHTED`

`MIGRATION_SNAPSHOTTED`

`MIGRATION_DRY_RUN_COMPLETE`

`MIGRATION_APPROVED`

`MIGRATION_STAGED`

`MIGRATION_WRITTEN`

`MIGRATION_VERIFIED`

`MIGRATION_TESTED`

`MIGRATION_PROJECTED`

`MIGRATION_RECEIPTED`

`MIGRATION_CLOSED_ACCEPTED`

If any phase fails:

`MIGRATION_BLOCKED`

or

`MIGRATION_FAILED_RECOVERABLE`

If effect unknown:

`MIGRATION_FAILED_UNKNOWN_EFFECT`

Hard rule:

`MIGRATION IS A COMMAND CENTER MUTATION. IT NEEDS THE SAME DISCIPLINE AS FILE MUTATION.`

---

Every migration dry run writes:

```text
MIGRATION_DRY_RUN_REPORT
```

`DRY_RUN_BLOCKED_COMPATIBILITY_UNKNOWN`

## 10T.14 Migration Receipt

Every migration writes:

```text

ToVersion:
```

---

## 10T.15 Schema Deprecation Rule

Deprecation is not deletion.

When a schema is replaced:

old schema status becomes:

`DEPRECATED_READ_ONLY`

or

`LEGACY_EVIDENCE_ONLY`

not deleted.

Required fields:

`DeprecatedByMigration`

`ReplacementSchema`

`CompatibilityMode`

`DoNotUseForNewAuthority: true/false`

Failure:

`SCHEMA_DELETED_WITHOUT_LEDGER`

`DEPRECATED_SCHEMA_USED_FOR_MUTATION`

Hard line:

`OLD SHAPES ARE PARKED WITH MAPS, NOT THROWN AWAY.`

## 10T.16 Button Migration

Buttons are dangerous because meaning can drift.

Any button change must record:

`OldButtonId`

`OldLabel`

`OldCommandClass`

`OldTransactionType`

`NewButtonId`

`NewLabel`

`NewCommandClass`

`NewTransactionType`

`AuthorityChange`

`MutationPossibleChange`

`HumanApprovalChange`

If label stays same but meaning changes:

`BUTTON_MEANING_CHANGED_SAME_LABEL`

Blocked unless major migration.

Forbidden silent change:

`Next` changing from query to dispatch without schema bump.

`Clean Root` appearing as direct action.

`Accept Closeout` bypassing receipt judge.

Failure labels:

`BUTTON_SCHEMA_DRIFT`

`BUTTON_AUTHORITY_DRIFT`

`BUTTON_MEANING_CHANGED_SAME_LABEL`

## 10T.17 Gate Migration

Gate order and gate verdicts are high-risk.

Any gate change must record:

`GateName`

`OldVersion`

`NewVersion`

`OldPosition`

`NewPosition`

`OldBlockVerdicts`

`NewBlockVerdicts`

`NewBypassRisk`

`TestsAdded`

Gate migration is major if it changes:

order,

block behavior,

human review requirement,

mutation allowance,

closeout chain,

DoesNotProve requirement.

`GATE_DNP_REMOVED`

## 10T.18 Receipt Schema Migration

Receipts are proof. Changing them is high-risk.

If a receipt schema changes, migration must say:

`Can old receipts be judged?`

`Do old receipts need adapter?`

`Which old fields map to new fields?`

`Which new required fields are absent?`

`Can old receipt close a job?`

Default:

old receipt can be evidence,

but cannot close new workflow unless compatibility adapter says yes.

Failure:

`OLD_RECEIPT_CLOSED_NEW_SCHEMA_WITHOUT_ADAPTER`

---

## 10T.19 Reducer Migration

Reducer changes are critical.

If reducer invariants change:

major migration required.

Migration must include:

`old invariant list`

`new invariant list`

`removed invariants`

`added invariants`

`weakened invariants`

`test fixtures updated`

No invariant may be removed silently.

Failure:

`REDUCER_INVARIANT_REMOVED_WITHOUT_REVIEW`

`REDUCER_CLOSEOUT_RULE_WEAKENED`

`REDUCER_DNP_RULE_WEAKENED`

## 10T.20 Test Bench Migration

When schema changes, tests must change too.

Migration must update:

`fixture schemas`

`expected verdicts`

`failure labels`

`close conditions`

`DoesNotProve expected text`

If tests are not updated:

`MIGRATION_TEST_COVERAGE_STALE`

Any major migration requires at least one negative fixture proving the old failure remains blocked.

Rule:

`NO MAJOR MIGRATION WITHOUT BAD FIXTURE.`

`THE COMMAND CENTER WILL EVOLVE, SO IT NEEDS VERSIONED MIGRATION. EVERY FILE, LEDGER, PACKET, RECEIPT, BUTTON, GATE, ADAPTER, REDUCER OUTPUT, AND TEST FIXTURE NEEDS SCHEMA VERSION. OLD RECORDS ARE EVIDENCE, NOT FLOATING AUTHORITY. AUTHORITY CHANGES ARE MAJOR. MIGRATION NEEDS SNAPSHOT, DRY RUN, COMPATIBILITY CHECK, TEST, RECEIPT, AND ROLLBACK PATH. NO SILENT SHAPE DRIFT.`







## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 10U — Semantic Registry / Word Authority / No Vocabulary Drift Standard

Batch 10T protected file and schema shape. Batch 10U protects **word shape**.

This is not cosmetic. In this house, words become commands, statuses, gates, packets, buttons, receipts, actor roles, and authority boundaries. If the words drift, the system drifts.

The existing house source already treats `KEY` as the language layer: what labels mean, what movement is legal, and what must stop. It also uses load shelves like `LOAD_NOW`, `PROOF_ONLY`, `STALE_COPY`, `BLOCKED_LANE`, `PARKED_WITH_RETURN_TRIGGER`, and `SUPERSEDED_BUT_PRESERVED` to prevent loose interpretation.  The tool grammar candidate also states that `LANGUAGE` defines what labels mean, what moves are legal, and what must stop. 

Core rule:

`NO WORD BECOMES AUTHORITY UNTIL IT IS REGISTERED, OWNED, DEFINED, AND MAPPED.`

Carry line:

`WORDS ARE CONTROL SURFACES. DEFINE THEM OR BLOCK THEM.`

---

## 10U.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_SEMANTIC_REGISTRY_AND_WORD_AUTHORITY_V0_1`

Wording:

`EVERY COMMAND WORD, STATUS WORD, ACTOR NAME, BUTTON LABEL, GATE VERDICT, PACKET TYPE, mutation term, approval term, blocker label, closeout label, and DoesNotProve boundary must belong to a registered semantic family with a canonical meaning, aliases, forbidden meanings, authority effect, and drift verdict.`

This blocks:

`clean` becoming delete,
`done` becoming accepted closeout,
`safe` becoming authorized,
`archive` becoming disposable,
`duplicate` becoming delete authority,
`approval` becoming execution,
`root intake` becoming active job completion,
`assistant command center` becoming user authority,
`receipt` becoming truth without judging,
`packet` becoming actor-readable without install proof.

---

## 10U.4 Canonical Word Rules

### Rule 1 — `Done` Is Not Canonical

Forbidden as final state:

`done`

Allowed canonical replacements:

`ACTIVE_JOB_DONE`
`RECEIPT_ACCEPTED`
`READY_FOR_USER_ACCEPTANCE`
`CLOSEOUT_ACCEPTED`

If user or worker says “done,” translate to:

`REQUEST_RECEIPT_JUDGE`

Failure:

`WORD_DONE_FALSE_COMPLETION_RISK`

---

### Rule 2 — `Clean` Is Not Authority

Forbidden as action authority:

`clean`

Safe translations:

`ROOT_INTAKE_PREFLIGHT_REQUEST`
`REVIEW_CLEANUP_REQUEST`
`CLASSIFY_CUSTODY_ITEMS`
`PREPARE_HUMAN_REVIEW_PACKET`

Failure:

`WORD_CLEAN_BROAD_AUTHORITY_RISK`

---

### Rule 3 — `Safe` Is Not Approval

Forbidden as approval proof:

`safe`

Safe translation:

`RISK_REVIEW_REQUIRED`

Failure:

`WORD_SAFE_TREATED_AS_AUTHORITY`

---

### Rule 4 — `Duplicate` Is Not Delete

Canonical meaning:

`DUPLICATE_PROOF_CANDIDATE`

or

`DUPLICATE_PROVEN`

Forbidden translation:

`DELETE_AUTHORIZED`

Failure:

`WORD_DUPLICATE_TREATED_AS_DELETE`

---

### Rule 5 — `Archive` Is Not Disposal

Canonical meaning:

`ARCHIVE_CUSTODY`

Forbidden translation:

`SOURCE_REMOVAL_AUTHORIZED`

Failure:

`WORD_ARCHIVE_TREATED_AS_DISPOSAL`

---

### Rule 6 — `Approval` Is Not Execution

Canonical split:

`HUMAN_APPROVAL_RECORDED`
then
`MUTATION_PACKET_READY`
then
`MUTATION_EXECUTED`
then
`MUTATION_RECEIPT_ACCEPTED`

Failure:

`WORD_APPROVAL_TREATED_AS_EXECUTION`

---

### Rule 7 — `Root Intake` Is Not Active Job Completion

Canonical split:

`ROOT_INTAKE_DONE`
and
`ACTIVE_JOB_DONE`

Failure:

`WORD_ROOT_INTAKE_TREATED_AS_COMPLETION`

---

### Rule 8 — `Receipt` Is Not Truth Until Judged

Canonical split:

`RECEIPT_DETECTED`
`RECEIPT_REGISTERED`
`RECEIPT_JUDGED_ACCEPTED`
`RECEIPT_JUDGED_REJECTED`

Failure:

`WORD_RECEIPT_TREATED_AS_TRUTH`

## 10U.5 Alias Translation

Aliases are allowed for user comfort, but output must use canonical terms.

Examples:

```text
Raw phrase: nxt
Canonical: NEXT_LEGAL_ACTION_REQUEST

Raw phrase: do this now
Canonical: START_IF_IDLE or FREEZE_AND_REVIEW

Raw phrase: clean root
Canonical: ROOT_INTAKE_PREFLIGHT_REQUEST

Raw phrase: delete duplicates
Canonical: REQUEST_DUPLICATE_PROOF_REVIEW

Raw phrase: lock it
Canonical: LOCK_RECEIPTED_STATE

Raw phrase: save progress
Canonical: SAVE_PROGRESS_PACKET

Raw phrase: send to mule
Canonical: ROUTE_ACTOR_MULE

Raw phrase: use Codex
Canonical: ROUTE_ACTOR_CODEX
```

Rule:

`ALIASES MAY ENTER. CANONICAL TERMS MUST LEAVE.`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 10V — Health Monitor / Periodic Audit / No Silent Rot Standard

Batch 10U protected word meaning. Batch 10V protects the system over time.

A command center can be correct at install, then rot slowly: stale dashboard, old packet, expired work token, unjudged receipt, drifted schema, missing `DoesNotProve`, root leak, actor output sitting in quarantine, queue item forgotten, guard proof stale, migration half-applied, or boot not run recently.

Core rule:

`NO SILENT ROT.`

Carry line:

`THE COMMAND CENTER MUST HAVE HEALTH CHECKS THAT FIND STALE STATE, AGED BLOCKERS, UNJUDGED RECEIPTS, EXPIRED PACKETS, ROOT LEAKS, DRIFTED WORDS, BROKEN HASH CHAINS, AND FORGOTTEN QUEUE ITEMS BEFORE NEW WORK STACKS ON TOP.`

The existing front-door source already says chat should carry one active object, one source/proof pointer, and one next condition, while stale copies and broad proof furniture should be dropped from live carry.  That principle must become runtime health, not just chat behavior.

---

## 10V.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_HEALTH_MONITOR_AND_NO_SILENT_ROT_V0_1`

Wording:

`THE COMMAND CENTER MUST PERIODICALLY CHECK ITS OWN STATE, QUEUES, RECEIPTS, TOKENS, PACKETS, ROOT SURFACE, GUARD STATUS, SEMANTICS, SCHEMAS, HASH CHAINS, AND PROJECTIONS SO STALE OR CONTRADICTORY STATE CANNOT QUIETLY BECOME AUTHORITY.`

This blocks:

`old packet reused`

`receipt waiting forever`

`blocker hidden by dashboard`

`queue item lost`

`actor marked working forever`

`work token stale`

`root leak ignored`

`schema version missing`

`semantic drift accepted`

`hash chain not checked`

`health problem buried under new work`

---

## 10V.2 Health Monitor Is Not an Actor

The health monitor does not perform project work.

It does not mutate project files.

It does not approve.

It does not dispatch.

It does not clean.

It reads command-center state and reports health.

Allowed:

`read state`

`read ledgers`

`read queues`

`read root listing`

`read receipts`

`read guard status`

`read schema registry`

`read semantic registry`

`open blocker`

`write health report`

`recommend next legal action`

Blocked:

`delete`

`move`

`restore`

`compress`

`empty Recycle Bin`

`accept receipt`

`approve mutation`

`run actor`

`clear blocker without proof`

Rule:

`HEALTH MONITOR DIAGNOSES. IT DOES NOT TREAT.`

---

## 10V.5 Health Verdicts

Allowed health verdicts:

`HEALTH_PASS`

No blocking issue found in checked scope.

`HEALTH_WARN`

Issue exists but does not block all work.

`HEALTH_BLOCKED`

Work should not continue until cleared.

`HEALTH_FREEZE`

Affected lane must freeze.

`HEALTH_FATAL`

Command-center state cannot be trusted.

`HEALTH_UNKNOWN`

Health could not be determined because required evidence is missing.

Forbidden verdicts:

`healthy enough`

`probably fine`

`clean`

`safe`

`all good`

`done`

---

## 10V.6 Required Health Checks

### Check 1 — Boot Freshness

Check:

`last boot receipt exists`

`boot did not block`

`boot ran recovery scan`

`boot ran reducer`

`boot ran sync guard`

Finding:

`HEALTH_BOOT_STALE_OR_MISSING`

Block if no trusted boot exists.

---

### Check 2 — Recovery Cleanliness

Check:

`no open recovery-required issue`

`no staging leftovers`

`no failed unknown-effect transaction`

`no written-not-verified transaction`

Finding:

`HEALTH_RECOVERY_OPEN`

Severity:

`HEALTH_BLOCKED` or `HEALTH_FATAL`

---

### Check 3 — Hash Chain

Check:

`hash chain continuity`

`append-only continuity`

`record hash stability`

Findings:

`HEALTH_HASH_CHAIN_BROKEN`

`HEALTH_RECORD_HASH_DRIFT`

Severity:

`HEALTH_FATAL`

---

### Check 4 — Reducer Freshness

Check:

`last reducer receipt exists`

`last reducer pass after last canonical transaction`

`projection drift not open`

Finding:

`HEALTH_REDUCER_STALE`

Rule:

If canonical log changed after reducer, projections are stale.

---

### Check 5 — Sync Freshness

Check:

`dual-center sync guard ran after last user/assistant state change`

`no split-brain open`

Finding:

`HEALTH_SYNC_STALE`

or

`HEALTH_SPLIT_BRAIN_OPEN`

---

### Check 6 — Open Work Tokens

Check:

`open work tokens`

`token age`

`actor board match`

`receipt expected`

Findings:

`HEALTH_WORK_TOKEN_STALE`

`HEALTH_WORK_TOKEN_ORPHANED`

`HEALTH_ACTOR_TOKEN_MISMATCH`

Rule:

Open token owns next action until closed, superseded, or recovered.

---

### Check 7 — Pending Receipts

Check:

`receipt detected but not judged`

`receipt indexed but no file`

`receipt file exists but not indexed`

`receipt age`

Findings:

`HEALTH_RECEIPT_PENDING_TOO_LONG`

`HEALTH_RECEIPT_WITHOUT_INDEX`

`HEALTH_INDEX_WITHOUT_RECEIPT`

Rule:

Pending receipt outranks new work on same active object.

---

### Check 8 — Open Blockers

Check:

`open blockers`

`blocker age`

`required clear step`

`visible in user console`

Findings:

`HEALTH_BLOCKER_STALE`

`HEALTH_BLOCKER_HIDDEN_FROM_USER`

Rule:

A blocker with no required clear step is itself a blocker.

---

### Check 9 — Human Review Queue

Check:

`pending human review items`

`mutation depends on pending review`

`approval exactness`

Findings:

`HEALTH_HUMAN_REVIEW_STALE`

`HEALTH_MUTATION_WAITING_HUMAN_REVIEW`

`HEALTH_APPROVAL_TOO_BROAD`

Default:

`MutationAuthorized: false`

---

### Check 10 — Root Surface

Check root allowed items:

`COMMAND_CENTER\`

`START_HERE.md` if intentionally installed

`desktop.ini`

Findings:

`HEALTH_ROOT_LEAK_FOUND`

`HEALTH_ROOT_AUTHORITY_LEAK_FOUND`

`HEALTH_ROOT_INTAKE_REQUIRED`

Rule:

Root leak is intake/review, not cleanup permission.

---

### Check 11 — Packet Expiration

Check:

`active packets`

`used packets`

`expired packets`

`superseded packets`

`one-time mutation packets reused`

Findings:

`HEALTH_PACKET_EXPIRED`

`HEALTH_PACKET_REUSE_ATTEMPT`

`HEALTH_OLD_PACKET_FLOATING_FORWARD`

---

### Check 12 — Actor Output Quarantine

Check:

`actor output quarantine has unjudged outputs`

`output has receipt`

`forbidden files present`

Findings:

`HEALTH_QUARANTINE_PENDING`

`HEALTH_UNDECLARED_MUTATION`

Check:

`all active files have schema`

Findings:

Check:

Findings:

Check:

`proof level`

## 10V.7 Health Severity Ladder

`INFO`

Useful status.

`WARN`

Needs attention, but not immediate block.

`BLOCK`

Prevents affected transition.

`FREEZE`

Stops affected lane.

`FATAL`

Command-center state cannot be trusted.

Severity mapping examples:

`pending receipt` = `BLOCK` for same active object.

`root loose input` = `WARN` or `BLOCK` depending relevance.

`hash chain broken` = `FATAL`.

`unknown mutation effect` = `FREEZE`.

`DNP dropped` = `BLOCK`.

`guard presence-only` = `WARN` for ordinary read-only work, `BLOCK` for protected-rule mutation.

## 10V.9 Health DoesNotProve Library

Every health report must include:

`Health pass does not authorize mutation.`

`Health pass does not prove actor work completed.`

`Health pass does not replace receipt judge.`

`Health pass does not replace human review.`

`Health pass only covers files and checks read in this run.`

`Health warning does not authorize ignoring the warning.`

`Health block freezes only the affected lane unless severity is fatal.`

## 10V.12 Health Gate

Add:

`GATE_COMMAND_CENTER_HEALTH`

This gate runs before:

`ACTOR_ROUTE`

`DISPATCH_DECISION`

`MUTATION_PACKET_REGISTER`

`CLOSEOUT_REQUEST`

`MIGRATION_EXECUTION`

Blocks if:

`HEALTH_FATAL`

`HEALTH_FREEZE`

`HEALTH_BLOCKED` for affected active object.

Verdicts:

`HEALTH_GATE_PASS`

`HEALTH_GATE_PASS_WITH_WARNINGS`

`HEALTH_GATE_BLOCKED`

`HEALTH_GATE_FREEZE`

`HEALTH_GATE_FATAL`

DoesNotProve:

`Health gate pass does not prove downstream gates pass.`

## 10V.13 Health Findings Cannot Be Dropped

If a health finding is open, it must appear in at least one of:

`BLOCKER_BOARD.json`

`HEALTH_FINDINGS.csv`

`USER_CONSOLE.md`

`BACKSTAGE_BLOCKERS_VIEW.md`

If not:

`HEALTH_FINDING_DROPPED`

Rule:

`A HEALTH FINDING IS A LIVE OBJECT UNTIL CLEARED BY PROOF.`

---

## 10V.14 Health Finding Clearance

A health finding clears only through proof.

Examples:

`pending receipt judged`

`open work token closed`

`root leak routed with root-intake receipt`

`schema migration completed`

`semantic drift mapped`

`guard proof upgraded`

`sync guard pass`

`hash chain repaired or incident closed`

No manual “cleared” note.

Failure:

`HEALTH_FINDING_CLEARED_WITHOUT_PROOF`

---

## 10V.15 Aging Rules

Suggested first thresholds:

`pending receipt` — review immediately before more same-object work.

`open blocker` — visible until cleared.

`open work token` — stale if no receipt/status update during active session.

`root loose file` — visible until routed/classified.

`human review item` — remains visible until decision.

`schema unknown` — blocks ingestion.

`hash-chain issue` — fatal until resolved.

Do not turn these into hidden timers that mutate. Aging only escalates visibility/blocking.

Rule:

`AGING ESCALATES REVIEW. AGING DOES NOT EXECUTE.`

---

## 10V.16 Trend Ledger

The command center should learn recurring health failures.

`HEALTH_TREND_LEDGER.csv` columns:

```text id="v-trend"
TrendId,FirstSeenUtc,LastSeenUtc,FindingType,Count,RecurringLayer,RecurringActor,RecurringActiveObject,Pattern,EscalationSuggested,DoesNotProve
```

If the same finding repeats:

`RECURRING_HEALTH_FAILURE`

Then route to:

`ROOT_GHOST_COLLAPSE`

not another surface fix.

Example:

Repeated `PACKET_NOT_INSTALLED_WHERE_ACTOR_READS` means the actor adapter or packet placement rule is broken.

## 10V.19 Close Condition

Health layer is trusted only if:

`health status file exists`

`health check ledger exists`

`health findings ledger exists`

`health checks include boot, recovery, hash chain, reducer, sync, tokens, receipts, blockers, human review, root, packets, quarantine, schema, semantic, guard, queues`

`health finding cannot disappear without proof`

`health blocks affected transitions`

`health appears in user console`

`health reports preserve DoesNotProve`

`recurring health failures escalate to root/ghost review`

If any missing:

`COMMAND_CENTER_HEALTH_LAYER_NOT_TRUSTED`

If all pass:

`COMMAND_CENTER_HEALTH_LAYER_MVP_PASS`

`THE COMMAND CENTER NEEDS HEALTH MONITORING. NOT AUTOMATION, NOT CLEANUP: HEALTH. IT CHECKS BOOT, RECOVERY, HASH CHAIN, REDUCER, SYNC, TOKENS, RECEIPTS, BLOCKERS, HUMAN REVIEW, ROOT, PACKETS, QUARANTINE, SCHEMA, SEMANTICS, GUARD, AND QUEUES. FINDINGS STAY LIVE UNTIL CLEARED BY PROOF. HEALTH PASS DOES NOT AUTHORIZE MUTATION. HEALTH BLOCKS SILENT ROT BEFORE NEW WORK STACKS ON TOP.`










## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 10W — Retention / Archive / Compaction / Evidence Lifecycle / No Cleanup-by-Age Standard

Batch 10V built health monitoring. Batch 10W answers the next pressure: the command center will generate a lot of state, logs, receipts, packets, reports, snapshots, queues, quarantine outputs, guard findings, and test artifacts. If there is no retention standard, the command center becomes either a junk pile or a deletion machine.

Both are bad.

The existing front-door source already says the system should carry one active object, one source/proof pointer, and one next condition, while preserving proof/history and dropping stale copies only from live carry, not from custody.  The tool grammar candidate says the same thing as method: `SCISSOR` cuts stale live-carry weight, while `SEW` reconnects with typed tunnel, proof, key, boundary, and return path. 

Core rule:

`RETENTION IS NOT CLEANUP.`
`ARCHIVE IS NOT DISPOSAL.`
`COMPACTION IS NOT DELETION.`
`AGE IS NOT AUTHORITY.`

Carry line:

`KEEP THE PROOF. REDUCE THE CARRY. INDEX THE MASS. NEVER DELETE BY AGE, SIZE, DUPLICATE, OR BOREDOM.`

---

## 10W.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_RETENTION_AND_EVIDENCE_LIFECYCLE_V0_1`

Wording:

`EVERY COMMAND CENTER ARTIFACT MUST HAVE A RETENTION CLASS, owner, proof role, live-carry status, archive lane, return trigger, deletion authority state, and DoesNotProve boundary before it can be moved, compacted, archived, superseded, or removed from active view.`

This blocks:

`old means delete`

`large means bloat`

`archived means disposable`

`proof-only means removable`

`duplicate means delete`

`snapshot replaces original`

`summary replaces receipt`

`compaction removes raw logs`

`health cleanup deletes findings`

`closed workflow loses evidence`

---

## 10W.2 Retention Classes

Every artifact gets one class.

`LIVE_CARRY`

Currently shown in user/front-door or active assistant state.

`ACTIVE_STATE`

Current materialized state used by kernel/reducer/scheduler/gates.

`ACTIVE_PROOF`

Receipt, gate verdict, or proof object needed for current active object.

`HOT_CUSTODY`

Recently used proof/history likely needed soon.

`WARM_CUSTODY`

Preserved but not normally loaded.

`COLD_CUSTODY`

Preserved long-term; indexed, not carried.

`PROOF_HISTORY`

Historical proof required to explain prior decision, migration, recovery, receipt, or failure.

`LEGACY_EVIDENCE_ONLY`

Old packet/receipt/schema/log that remains evidence but cannot authorize new work.

`RECOVERY_CUSTODY`

Recovered material awaiting classification or review.

`ARCHIVE_CUSTODY`

Preserved archive material. Not disposable by default.

`QUARANTINE`

Actor output awaiting judge/review.

`PARKED_WITH_RETURN_TRIGGER`

Alive but inactive until a named condition returns.

`SUPERSEDED_PRESERVED`

Replaced by newer artifact but preserved for history/drift proof.

`DISPOSAL_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY`

Potential future removal candidate. Not deletion authority.

Forbidden class:

`JUNK`

No artifact gets that class.

---

Create:

```text
_LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS\
  ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER_STATE\
    RETENTION_REGISTRY.csv
    RETENTION_POLICY.csv

    RETENTION_REPORTS\
```

`RETENTION_REGISTRY.csv` columns:

```text
ArtifactId,Path,ArtifactType,OwnerLayer,OwnerActor,ActiveObject,RetentionClass,LiveCarryStatus,ProofRole,CanonicalSource,IndexedBy,Bytes,SHA256,CreatedUtc,LastReferencedUtc,ReturnTrigger,MayMove,MayCompact,MayArchive,MayDelete,DeletionAuthority,RequiredApproval,DoesNotProve
```

Default values:

```text
MayMove: false
MayCompact: false
MayArchive: false
MayDelete: false
DeletionAuthority: NONE
```

No blank deletion authority.

---

## 10W.4 Retention Policy

`RETENTION_POLICY.csv` columns:

```text
RetentionClass,DefaultLane,MayBeLiveCarry,MayBeArchived,MayBeCompacted,MayBeDeleted,RequiresHumanReview,RequiresLosslessAccounting,RequiresReceipt,ReturnTriggerRequired,DoesNotProve
```

Policy defaults:

`LIVE_CARRY`

May be reduced from live view, but source stays in custody.

`ACTIVE_STATE`

May not be archived while active.

`ACTIVE_PROOF`

May not be moved until active object closes.

`PROOF_HISTORY`

May be indexed and moved to proof/history custody, not deleted.

`LEGACY_EVIDENCE_ONLY`

May not authorize new work; may remain in cold custody.

`RECOVERY_CUSTODY`

May not be deleted or compressed-away until review and approval.

`ARCHIVE_CUSTODY`

May be moved within archive custody with accounting. Not deletion.

`QUARANTINE`

May not be promoted or deleted until judge verdict.

`PARKED_WITH_RETURN_TRIGGER`

Must keep return trigger visible.

`SUPERSEDED_PRESERVED`

May leave live carry but remains proof/history.

---

## 10W.5 Live Carry vs Custody

This is the main distinction.

`LIVE_CARRY` means currently carried in the user/operator or assistant/backstage view.

`CUSTODY` means preserved, indexed, findable, and protected.

Removing from live carry does not mean deletion.

Correct:

`Remove stale packet from live carry -> mark SUPERSEDED_PRESERVED -> preserve path/hash/receipt -> point to current packet.`

Incorrect:

`Old packet is stale -> delete it.`

Rule:

`SCISSOR CUTS LIVE CARRY. IT DOES NOT CUT CUSTODY WITHOUT SEPARATE AUTHORITY.`

---

## 10W.6 Archive Rule

Archive has one meaning:

`PRESERVED OUT OF ACTIVE CARRY`

Archive does not mean:

`delete source`

`dispose`

`compress and remove`

`ignore`

`lose return path`

`forget proof`

Hard line:

`ARCHIVE_CUSTODY IS STILL CUSTODY.`

Failure labels:

`ARCHIVE_TREATED_AS_DISPOSAL`

`ARCHIVE_LOST_RETURN_PATH`

`ARCHIVE_WITHOUT_ACCOUNTING`

`ARCHIVE_DROPPED_DNP`

---

## 10W.7 Compaction Rule

Compaction is allowed only as index/summary creation unless explicitly packeted otherwise.

Allowed compaction:

`create summary`

`create index`

`create rollup report`

`create manifest`

`create nav pointer`

`create reduced user view`

Blocked compaction:

`summary replaces receipt`

`rollup deletes raw log`

`index deletes source`

`compressed copy removes original`

`short summary drops DoesNotProve`

Rule:

`COMPACTION MAY REDUCE VIEW. COMPACTION MAY NOT ERASE SOURCE.`

Failure labels:

`COMPACTION_TREATED_AS_DELETION`

`SUMMARY_REPLACED_RECEIPT`

`ROLLUP_DELETED_RAW_LOG`

`COMPACTION_DROPPED_DNP`

---

## 10W.8 Log Rollup Standard

Append-only logs can become large. They may be rolled up, but not erased.

Rollup output:

```text
ROLLUP_REPORT

RollupId:
SourceLog:
SourceRange:
SourceFirstHash:
SourceLastHash:
RecordsCount:
RollupSummary:
OpenItems:
ClosedItems:
DoesNotProve:
RawLogRetained:
RawLogPath:
RollupReceipt:
```

Required:

`RawLogRetained: true`

If raw log is moved to cold custody:

must include lossless accounting.

If raw log is deleted:

blocked by default.

Failure:

`LOG_ROLLUP_LOST_RAW_SOURCE`

---

## 10W.9 Snapshot Retention

Snapshots are proof of state, not replacement for state history.

Snapshot retention classes:

`SNAPSHOT_ACTIVE_RECOVERY`

Needed for current recovery.

`SNAPSHOT_CLOSEOUT_PROOF`

Needed to prove closed workflow.

`SNAPSHOT_MIGRATION_PROOF`

Needed to prove version migration.

`SNAPSHOT_COLD_CUSTODY`

Older preserved snapshot.

Snapshot DoesNotProve:

`Snapshot does not prove actor work completed.`
`Snapshot does not authorize project-file rollback.`
`Snapshot does not replace transaction log.`

Failure:

`SNAPSHOT_TREATED_AS_CANONICAL_REPLACEMENT`

---

## 10W.10 Receipt Retention

Receipts are never disposable by default.

Receipt classes:

`ACTIVE_RECEIPT`

Current active object.

`ACCEPTED_RECEIPT`

Accepted proof.

`REJECTED_RECEIPT`

Rejected but still evidence.

`LEGACY_RECEIPT`

Old schema or old workflow evidence.

`CONFLICTING_RECEIPT`

Must be preserved for incident review.

Rule:

`REJECTED RECEIPT IS STILL EVIDENCE.`

Failure:

`REJECTED_RECEIPT_DELETED`

`RECEIPT_ARCHIVED_WITHOUT_INDEX`

`LEGACY_RECEIPT_USED_AS_CURRENT_AUTHORITY`

---

## 10W.11 Quarantine Retention

Actor output quarantine must not become a graveyard.

Quarantine states:

`AWAITING_RECEIPT`

`AWAITING_JUDGE`

`ACCEPTED_PROMOTED_TO_ARTIFACT_INDEX`

`REJECTED_PRESERVED`

`CONFLICT_REVIEW`

`UNKNOWN_EFFECT_REVIEW`

Quarantine items may not be deleted by age.

If old:

`QUARANTINE_STALE_REVIEW_REQUIRED`

not cleanup.

Failure:

`QUARANTINE_DELETED_BY_AGE`

---

## 10W.12 Recovery Custody Retention

Recovery custody is protected.

Class:

`RECOVERY_CUSTODY`

Default:

`MayDelete: false`

`MayCompact: false`

`MayArchive: true only after classification`

`RequiresHumanReview: true for final disposition`

Hard line:

`RECOVERY CUSTODY MASS IS NOT BLOAT.`

Failure:

`RECOVERY_CUSTODY_TREATED_AS_BLOAT`

`RECOVERED_ITEM_DELETED_WITHOUT_REVIEW`

`RECOVERY_CUSTODY_COMPRESSED_AND_SOURCE_REMOVED`

## 10W.24 Close Condition

Retention layer is trusted only if:

`retention registry exists`

`retention policy exists`

`every artifact has retention class`

`live carry is separated from custody`

`archive does not mean disposal`

`compaction keeps source`

`rollup keeps raw log`

`receipts are never disposable by default`

`recovery custody is protected`

`parked items have return triggers`

`superseded items have replacement pointers`

`retention actions require packets`

`disposal is separate and human-approved`

`retention health check exists`

`retention gate exists`

If any missing:

`COMMAND_CENTER_RETENTION_LAYER_NOT_TRUSTED`

If all pass:

`COMMAND_CENTER_RETENTION_LAYER_MVP_PASS`

## 10W.25 Batch 10W Carry Line

`THE COMMAND CENTER NEEDS RETENTION CONTROL. LIVE CARRY CAN BE CUT; CUSTODY MUST REMAIN. ARCHIVE IS PRESERVATION, NOT DISPOSAL. COMPACTION BUILDS SUMMARIES AND INDEXES, NOT SOURCE DELETION. RECEIPTS, REJECTED RECEIPTS, SNAPSHOTS, QUARANTINE OUTPUTS, RECOVERY CUSTODY, LEGACY PACKETS, AND SUPERSEDED ITEMS STAY INDEXED UNTIL AN EXACT HUMAN-APPROVED DISPOSAL PACKET EXISTS. KEEP THE PROOF, REDUCE THE CARRY, NEVER DELETE BY AGE.`






## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 10X — Integrated Test Court / Certification Bench / No Paper-Pass Standard

Batch 10W built retention. Batch 10X builds the proof machine.

At this point the command center has a full nervous system: front door, backstage, queue, scheduler, gate engine, reducer, adapters, boot, migration, semantics, health, and retention. But if those layers only exist as written standards, the system can still lie to itself.

The next layer is the integrated test court.

Core rule:

`NO COMMAND CENTER LAYER IS TRUSTED BECAUSE IT IS WRITTEN WELL.`
`IT IS TRUSTED ONLY WHEN ITS FIXTURES PASS AND ITS FAILURE CASES FAIL CLOSED.`

Carry line:

`SPEC IS NOT PROOF. FIXTURE IS PROOF PRESSURE. RECEIPT IS PROOF RECORD. CERTIFICATION IS A VERDICT WITH SCOPE.`

The existing process ledger already uses repeated same-shape workflow, smoke-break reset, drift review, and checkpoint verdicts instead of treating one clean write as proof.  That becomes the command center test philosophy.

---

## 10X.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_INTEGRATED_TEST_COURT_AND_CERTIFICATION_BENCH_V0_1`

Wording:

`EVERY COMMAND CENTER LAYER MUST HAVE POSITIVE FIXTURES, NEGATIVE FIXTURES, DRIFT FIXTURES, RECOVERY FIXTURES, AND INTEGRATION FIXTURES BEFORE IT CAN BE CALLED TRUSTED. A PASS MUST NAME SCOPE. A FAILURE MUST BLOCK OR FREEZE THE AFFECTED LANE.`

This blocks:

`paper architecture treated as working system`

`happy-path-only testing`

`button exists therefore safe`

`receipt exists therefore true`

`schema exists therefore enforced`

`health check exists but does not block`

`migration standard exists but old packet still floats forward`

`guard file exists but semantic protection missing`

`console looks clean but blocker hidden`

---

## 10X.2 Test Court Is Not the Judge of Reality

The test court proves system behavior under fixtures.

It does not prove the real world is correct.

It does not prove actor output quality.

It does not authorize deletion.

It does not approve mutation.

It does not replace human review.

It says:

`given this fixture, the command center behaved according to its rules`

or

`given this fixture, the command center failed`

DoesNotProve:

`Test pass does not prove future runs will pass.`
`Test pass does not prove actor work quality.`
`Test pass does not authorize mutation.`
`Test pass proves only the tested scope, fixture set, and version.`

---

## 10X.7 Test Verdicts

Allowed verdicts:

`TEST_PASS`

`TEST_PASS_WITH_WARNINGS`

`TEST_FAIL_OPEN`

`TEST_FAIL_CLOSED`

`TEST_BLOCKED_FIXTURE_INVALID`

`TEST_BLOCKED_MISSING_EVIDENCE`

`TEST_BLOCKED_UNSAFE_TO_RUN`

`TEST_INCONCLUSIVE`

Interpretation:

`TEST_FAIL_OPEN`

The dangerous one. The system allowed something it should have blocked.

`TEST_FAIL_CLOSED`

Usually safer. The system blocked more than expected, but did not allow unsafe action.

`TEST_INCONCLUSIVE`

No certification.

Hard rule:

`FAIL OPEN FREEZES THE AFFECTED LAYER.`

## 10X.10 Integration Chain Tests

Layer tests are not enough. The command center needs chain tests.

### Chain 1 — User Command to Queue

Input:

`nxt`

Expected chain:

`semantic normalize`

`health quick check`

`boot/session state checked`

`next legal action resolved`

No actor dispatch unless scheduler allows.

Forbidden:

`direct actor launch`

### Chain 2 — Root Drop While Busy

Input:

root file appears while active work token open.

Expected chain:

`sensor detects`

`stability wait`

`queue root intake`

`console shows queued root intake`

`active job not closed`

Forbidden:

`root file moved/deleted`

`active job marked done`

### Chain 3 — Actor Return to Receipt Judge

Input:

Mule returns output.

Expected chain:

`quarantine`

`receipt register`

`receipt judge`

`reducer update`

`console projection`

Forbidden:

`stdout treated as receipt`

`new actor work started first`

### Chain 4 — Human Approval to Mutation Packet

Input:

Expected chain:

`human decision receipt`

`mutation authorized still false until packet`

Forbidden:

### Chain 5 — Closeout

Input:

worker says complete.

`sync guard`

## 10X.11 Test Isolation

Tests must run in test lanes.

Allowed test lanes:

```text id="x-test-lanes"
_LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS\

    TEST_COURT\
      SANDBOX_STATE\
      SANDBOX_ROOT\
      SANDBOX_RECEIPTS\
      SANDBOX_ACTOR_OUTPUT\
```

Blocked:

testing against live root unless explicitly read-only,

testing against live receipts with mutation fixtures,

deleting real artifacts,

moving real custody files,

rewriting live transaction log.

Failure:

`TEST_MUTATED_LIVE_STATE`

Hard line:

`TEST COURT PRESSURES THE SYSTEM. IT DOES NOT DAMAGE THE HOUSE.`

---

## 10X.12 Certification Levels

Certification must name scope.

Allowed levels:

`NOT_CERTIFIED`

No sufficient tests.

`SPEC_ONLY`

Written spec exists; no working proof.

`FIXTURE_PARTIAL`

Some tests pass.

`NEGATIVE_TESTED`

Failure cases fail closed.

`INTEGRATION_TESTED`

Layer chain tested.

`MVP_CERTIFIED_WITH_SCOPE`

Enough positive, negative, drift, recovery, and integration tests pass for MVP scope.

`CERTIFICATION_REVOKED`

A later health, migration, semantic, or regression finding invalidated certification.

No bare word:

`certified`

Always say certified for what scope.

---

## 10X.13 Certification Packet

```text id="x-cert-packet"
CERTIFICATION_PACKET

CertificationId:
Layer:
RequestedBy:
Version:
Scope:
RequiredTests:
RequiredCoverage:
RequiredReceipts:
KnownExclusions:
KnownRisks:
DoesNotProve:
```

Known exclusions are mandatory.

Example:

`MVP_CERTIFIED_WITH_SCOPE` may exclude:

## 10X.15 Regression Rule

Every fix must add or update a test.

If a bug happened once and was repaired:

add regression fixture.

If a root/ghost failure repeated:

add parent-level fixture, not only surface symptom.

Failure:

`FIX_WITHOUT_REGRESSION_FIXTURE`

Rule:

`NO FIX CLOSES WITHOUT A BAD FIXTURE THAT WOULD HAVE CAUGHT IT.`

---

## 10X.16 Incident Replay

Any serious incident becomes replay material.

Incident replay packet:

```text id="x-incident-replay"
INCIDENT_REPLAY_PACKET

IncidentId:
FailureFamily:
OriginalTrigger:
ObservedBadOutcome:
RootCause:
ExpectedBlockedOutcome:
FixturePath:
RegressionTestId:
DoesNotProve:
```

Examples:

terminal parser/control-surface failure,

root intake false completion,

lossless custody weakening,

recovery mass treated as bloat,

assistant memory treated as worker rule,

receipt stdout treated as proof.

The front-door support card is explicit that chat support files are not doctrine and do not authorize automation, watcher, delete, move, or broad refactor.  Those boundaries should become incident replay tests, not just reminders.

## 10X.22 Close Condition

Test court layer is trusted only if:

`test registry exists`

`fixture index exists`

`test run ledger exists`

`failure ledger exists`

`coverage matrix exists`

`certification ledger exists`

`every layer has positive and negative fixtures`

`integration chain tests exist`

`fail-open blocks certification`

`tests run in sandbox lanes`

`fixes add regression fixtures`

`incidents become replay fixtures`

`certification names scope and exclusions`

`test reports preserve DoesNotProve`

If any missing:

`COMMAND_CENTER_TEST_COURT_NOT_TRUSTED`

If all pass:

`COMMAND_CENTER_TEST_COURT_MVP_PASS`

## 10X.23 Batch 10X Carry Line

`THE COMMAND CENTER NEEDS A TEST COURT. SPEC IS NOT PROOF. EVERY LAYER NEEDS POSITIVE FIXTURES, NEGATIVE FIXTURES, DRIFT FIXTURES, RECOVERY FIXTURES, AND INTEGRATION CHAIN TESTS. FAIL OPEN FREEZES. HAPPY PATH ONLY IS NOT CERTIFICATION. FIXES NEED REGRESSION FIXTURES. INCIDENTS NEED REPLAY FIXTURES. CERTIFICATION MUST NAME SCOPE, EXCLUSIONS, RECEIPTS, AND DOES_NOT_PROVE. NO PAPER PASS.`






## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 10Y — MVP Activation Ladder / Cutover / No Big-Bang Install Standard

Batch 10X built the test court. Batch 10Y defines how this command center becomes real without turning into a giant unproven machinery drop.

The danger now is obvious: the spec is large. If the whole thing is installed at once, every layer can blame every other layer. If the front door, reducer, scheduler, gates, adapters, health, retention, and tests all activate together, a failure becomes impossible to localize. That creates the exact drift this system is supposed to prevent.

Core rule:

`NO BIG-BANG COMMAND CENTER INSTALL.`

Carry line:

`INSTALL IN LAYERS. PROVE EACH LAYER. FREEZE ON FAIL. PROMOTE ONLY AFTER RECEIPT. ONE ACTIVATION STEP AT A TIME.`

The older process ledger already uses ordered waves, checkpoint verdicts, and smoke-break resets rather than one uncontrolled push.  The front-door support card also blocks broad refactor, automation, watcher behavior, delete, move, and whole-house crawl from this support layer.  Batch 10Y turns those constraints into the activation method.

---

## 10Y.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_MVP_ACTIVATION_LADDER_AND_CUTOVER_STANDARD_V0_1`

Wording:

`THE COMMAND CENTER MUST BE INSTALLED THROUGH A VERSIONED ACTIVATION LADDER. EACH LAYER STARTS READ-ONLY, PASSES FIXTURES, WRITES RECEIPT, PROJECTS USER-VISIBLE STATE, AND ONLY THEN UNLOCKS THE NEXT LAYER. NO LAYER MAY MUTATE PROJECT FILES UNTIL ITS AUTHORITY, TESTS, HEALTH, RETENTION, AND ROLLBACK BOUNDARIES ARE PROVEN.`

This blocks:

`install everything at once`

`UI active before state is trusted`

`scheduler active before gates`

`adapter active before packet surface proof`

`health active but not blocking`

`test court written but not run`

`retention policy installed after cleanup already happened`

`migration needed but schema not registered`

`command center becomes another loose pile`

---

## 10Y.2 Activation Ladder Overview

Activation is not a flat checklist. It is a gated ladder.

```text id="y-ladder-overview"
L0_READ_ONLY_SPINE
L1_FRONT_DOOR_CONSOLE
L2_CANONICAL_LOG_AND_RECEIPTS
L3_SCHEMA_AND_SEMANTICS
L4_REDUCER_AND_PROJECTIONS
L5_GATES_AND_BLOCKERS
L6_HEALTH_AND_RETENTION
L7_QUEUE_AND_SCHEDULER
L8_ACTOR_ADAPTERS_READ_ONLY
L9_TEST_COURT_CERTIFICATION
L10_CONTROLLED_ACTOR_DISPATCH
L11_CONTROLLED_MUTATION_PACKET_FLOW
L12_MVP_OPERATIONAL_LOCK
```

Rule:

`A HIGHER LAYER CANNOT ACTIVATE UNTIL ALL LOWER REQUIRED LAYERS HAVE PASS RECEIPTS.`

If skipped:

`ACTIVATION_LADDER_SKIP_DETECTED`

## 10Y.20 Rollback Rule

Every activation layer needs rollback.

Rollback can restore command-center state from snapshot.

Rollback cannot:

undo real actor work,

delete project files,

erase receipts,

remove incident evidence,

pretend activation never happened.

Rollback receipt must say:

`Rollback restored command-center activation state only.`

Failure:

`ROLLBACK_TREATED_AS_ERASURE`

---

## 10Y.21 No Automation Cutover

The MVP activation must not smuggle in watcher/automation.

Allowed:

manual run,

user-triggered health,

user-triggered status,

queue record,

dry-run dispatch.

Blocked until separately designed and tested:

file watcher,

background mutation,

auto cleanup,

auto archive,

auto delete,

auto restore,

auto Codex launch,

auto Mule launch.

Failure:

`AUTOMATION_SMUGGLED_INTO_MVP`

This matches the support-card boundary blocking watcher and automation authority. 

---

## 10Y.22 Cutover From Existing Workflow

Existing workflow does not vanish.

Cutover strategy:

`observe existing workflow`

`mirror state into command-center projection`

`compare console to actual chat/work state`

`do not replace worker process until receipt judge and test court pass`

`start with read-only status and receipts`

`then allow queue`

`then allow dry-run dispatch`

`then controlled read-only actor dispatch`

Hard rule:

`COMMAND CENTER FIRST MIRRORS, THEN GATES, THEN DISPATCHES.`

Failure:

`CUTOVER_REPLACED_WORKFLOW_WITHOUT_MIRROR_PASS`

## 10Y.26 Close Condition

Activation layer is trusted only if:

`activation state exists`

`activation ledger exists`

`activation receipts exist`

`each layer has pass/block verdict`

`no layer can skip required lower layer`

`read-only spine installs first`

`front door activates before backstage`

`schema/semantics activate before reducer`

`gates activate before scheduler`

`scheduler dry-runs before adapters`

`adapters dry-run before actor dispatch`

`test court passes before controlled dispatch`

`mutation packet flow is separate from mutation execution`

`MVP scope and exclusions are explicit`

`rollback exists and does not erase evidence`

`automation is excluded unless separately packeted`

`COMMAND_CENTER_ACTIVATION_LAYER_NOT_TRUSTED`

If all pass:

`COMMAND_CENTER_ACTIVATION_LAYER_MVP_PASS`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 10Z — Master Traceability Matrix / Assembly Index / No Lost Layer Standard

Batch 10Y built the activation ladder. Batch 10Z closes the alphabet pass by building the thing that prevents this whole command-center design from scattering into many good but disconnected parts.

The danger now is not missing ideas. The danger is losing traceability.

A rule appears in Batch 10G, a gate appears in 10N, a health check appears in 10V, a fixture appears in 10X, and an activation step appears in 10Y. If those are not tied together, the system becomes a beautiful pile again.

Core rule:

`EVERY REQUIREMENT MUST TRACE TO A FILE, GATE, TEST, RECEIPT, AND ACTIVATION LEVEL.`

Carry line:

`NO LOST RULE. NO ORPHAN FILE. NO UNTESTED GATE. NO UNMAPPED BUTTON. NO UNOWNED LEDGER. NO ACTIVATION WITHOUT TRACE.`

---

## 10Z.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_MASTER_TRACEABILITY_AND_ASSEMBLY_INDEX_V0_1`

Wording:

`EVERY COMMAND CENTER RULE, FILE, LEDGER, PACKET, BUTTON, GATE, QUEUE, ACTOR ADAPTER, HEALTH CHECK, RETENTION CLASS, TEST FIXTURE, receipt, and activation layer must be indexed in a master traceability matrix that names its owner, source batch, required proof, current status, activation level, and DoesNotProve boundary.`

This blocks:

`good rule not installed`

`installed file not owned`

`gate with no test`

`button with no semantic mapping`

`queue with no reducer event`

`adapter with no actor-readable surface`

`health check with no blocker behavior`

`retention rule with no policy row`

`activation level with hidden exclusions`

`MVP lock with missing layer`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11A — Build Packet / Implementation Order / File-by-File Starter / No Architecture-to-Install Collapse

Batch 10 built the full command-center architecture. Batch 11 starts the conversion from architecture into a controlled build.

This is where the work can go wrong if we get sloppy. The system now has many layers: front door, backstage, state, schemas, semantics, gates, reducer, health, retention, test court, activation ladder, and traceability. If implementation starts by “making all the files,” the build becomes a pile. If it starts by coding a UI, the cockpit appears before the spine exists. If it starts by automation, it violates the exclusions. If it starts by moving root files, it turns preflight into the job.

Core rule:

`BUILD PACKET BEFORE BUILD.`
`FILE ORDER BEFORE FILE CREATION.`
`READ-ONLY SPINE BEFORE ACTIVE CONTROL.`
`NO BIG-BANG INSTALL.`

Carry line:

`BATCH 11A DOES NOT BUILD THE COMMAND CENTER. IT DEFINES THE FIRST BUILD PACKET SO THE BUILD CAN START WITHOUT DROPPING LAYERS, CREATING FALSE AUTHORITY, OR MUTATING THE HOUSE TOO EARLY.`

---

## 11A.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_BUILD_PACKET_REQUIRED_BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION_V0_1`

Wording:

`NO COMMAND CENTER FILE, SCRIPT, UI, LEDGER, STATE FOLDER, BUTTON, GATE, TEST, OR ACTIVATION STEP MAY BE created or installed until a build packet names the exact scope, file order, mutation boundary, evidence requirement, rollback boundary, and DoesNotProve limits.`

This blocks:

`architecture pasted straight into repo`

`files created before trace index`

`UI built before state spine`

`state files created without schema`

`buttons created without semantic mapping`

`actor dispatch enabled before dry-run`

`automation smuggled into MVP`

`root cleanup mixed into command center install`

`implementation claiming success without test court`

---

## 11A.2 Build Packet Is Not the Build

The build packet is a carrier.

It does not install itself.

It does not mutate the repo.

It does not prove the command center exists.

It tells the future builder exactly what may be created, where, in what order, under what restriction, and what receipt must return.

Hard line:

`BUILD_PACKET IS AUTHORITY CARRIER, NOT EXECUTION.`

`BUILD_PACKET_TREATED_AS_BUILD`

`BUILD_STARTED_WITHOUT_PACKET`

`BUILD_SCOPE_UNDECLARED`

`BUILD_CREATED_FILES_OUT_OF_ORDER`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11B — Build Packet Contents / Exact File Templates / Starter Text / No Blank Skeleton Standard

Batch 11A defined the build packet and the file creation order. Batch 11B fills the starter files.

This batch is still not implementation. It does not create files. It defines exact starter content so the first build does not generate empty shells, weak dashboards, false authority, or unlabeled ledgers.

Core rule:

`NO BLANK SKELETON.`
`NO FILE WITHOUT PURPOSE.`
`NO VIEW WITHOUT SOURCE.`
`NO STATUS WITHOUT DOES_NOT_PROVE.`
`NO STARTER FILE CLAIMS LIVE TRUTH.`

Carry line:

`BATCH 11B MAKES THE STARTER CONTENT. EVERY FILE GETS ROLE, STATUS, SOURCE, AUTHORITY BOUNDARY, DOES_NOT_PROVE, AND NEXT LEGAL ACTION BEFORE ANY BUILD SCRIPT EXISTS.`

---

## 11B.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_STARTER_TEMPLATE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILE_CREATION_V0_1`

Wording:

`A command-center file may not be created as an empty placeholder unless its schema, role, authority boundary, source-of-truth relationship, DoesNotProve block, and starter status are already defined.`

This blocks:

`empty dashboards pretending to be status`

`CSV headers without ownership`

`JSON files without schema`

`views without canonical source`

`assistant backstage created as user authority`

`test folders with no fixtures`

`trace files with no trace rules`

`activation state with no exclusions`

`starter build accidentally looking operational`

---

## 11B.2 Starter Status Vocabulary

Every starter file must carry one of these status labels.

`STARTER_TEMPLATE_ONLY`

Template text exists. File is not installed.

`STARTER_PROJECTION_NOT_CANONICAL`

User/backstage markdown view. Must point to canonical state.

`STARTER_STATE_INITIAL`

Initial local state file. May be canonical only after creation receipt.

`STARTER_LEDGER_HEADER_ONLY`

CSV ledger exists with headers only.

`STARTER_SCHEMA_STUB`

Schema registry row or schema placeholder exists, but validation has not run.

`STARTER_TEST_STUB`

Test fixture shape exists, but tests have not passed.

`STARTER_RECEIPT_REQUIRED`

File requires future build receipt before trusted.

Forbidden starter statuses:

`ACTIVE`

`READY`

`DONE`

`SAFE`

`INSTALLED`

`OPERATIONAL`

unless a real build receipt and activation receipt later prove it.

Failure:

`STARTER_STATUS_FALSE_AUTHORITY`

```text
## Backstage

Assistant backstage is subordinate:

COMMAND_CENTER/ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER/

Assistant state and receipts live in custody:

_LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS/ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER_STATE/

## Authority Split

USER_COMMAND_CENTER owns:
- intent
- approval
- block
- final acceptance
- next legal action selection

ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER owns:
- routing
- actor status
- custody packets
- receipts
- traces
- blockers
- guard status
- byte accounting
- backstage state

ACTORS execute exact packeted work only.

## Hard Rules

User in front.
Assistants behind.
Actors behind packets.

Root intake is preflight, not active job completion.
Assistant status is not user approval.
Actor receipt is not final acceptance.
Human approval is not execution.
Execution is not closure until receipt is judged.

## Does Not Prove
```

## 11B.10.2 `MASTER_EXCLUSION_LIST.md`

```text
# COMMAND CENTER MASTER EXCLUSION LIST

Status: STARTER_TEMPLATE_ONLY
SchemaName: MASTER_EXCLUSION_LIST
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: EXCLUDED_CAPABILITY_BOUNDARY
OwnerLayer: ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER
ActivationLevel: L0_READ_ONLY_SPINE
MutationAuthorized: false

## Excluded Capability: File watcher automation

WhyExcluded:
Sensor/queue must prove stable before unattended triggers.

ReturnTrigger:
After L12 MVP lock and separate watcher design packet.

RequiredBeforeActivation:
watcher packet, dry-run fixture, no-mutation fixture, user approval.

TestNeed:
detects file, queues item, does not move/delete.

DoesNotProve:
watcher detection does not prove work should start.

## Excluded Capability: Auto cleanup

WhyExcluded:
Cleanup words are semantically dangerous and can hide delete/move/archive/restore authority.

ReturnTrigger:
After retention, human review, mutation packet, and lossless custody gates pass.

RequiredBeforeActivation:
exact item list, human approval, mutation packet, accounting receipt.

TestNeed:
cleanup request must translate to review packet, not mutation.

DoesNotProve:
classification does not authorize deletion.

## Excluded Capability: Delete / Empty Recycle Bin

WhyExcluded:
Irreversible or high-risk action.

ReturnTrigger:
Exact human-approved disposal packet with lossless accounting and recovery proof.

RequiredBeforeActivation:
human review, before/after proof, exact item list, final receipt.

TestNeed:
delete request without approval fails closed.

DoesNotProve:
duplicate proof does not authorize deletion.

## Excluded Capability: Codex launch

WhyExcluded:
Codex must receive actor-readable custody surface first.

ReturnTrigger:
AGENTS.md or equivalent packet installed and indexed.

RequiredBeforeActivation:
Codex custody packet, actor adapter dry-run, output quarantine, receipt schema.

TestNeed:
Codex packet missing fails closed.

DoesNotProve:
generated AGENTS.md text does not prove Codex received it.

## Excluded Capability: Mule launch

WhyExcluded:
Mule must receive exact order and must not drift into cleanup.

ReturnTrigger:
Mule custody packet and work token ready.

RequiredBeforeActivation:
Mule order, lossless custody rule, root intake distinction, receipt schema.

TestNeed:
root intake done but active job open fails closed.

DoesNotProve:
mule receipt does not authorize cleanup.

## Excluded Capability: Guard repair

WhyExcluded:
Guard may report by default; repair can alter protected rules.

ReturnTrigger:
guard repair packet with additive-only proof.

RequiredBeforeActivation:
protected core baseline, repair authority, guard receipt.

TestNeed:
presence-only cannot claim semantic protection.

DoesNotProve:
guard presence does not prove semantic safety.
```

## 11B.10.3 `MASTER_DOES_NOT_PROVE_LIBRARY.md`

```text
# MASTER DOES_NOT_PROVE LIBRARY

Status: STARTER_TEMPLATE_ONLY
SchemaName: MASTER_DNP_LIBRARY
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: GLOBAL_NEGATIVE_BOUNDARY_LIBRARY
OwnerLayer: ALL_LAYERS
ActivationLevel: L0_READ_ONLY_SPINE
MutationAuthorized: false

## Core Boundaries

- Root intake does not prove active job completion.
- Receipt registration does not prove receipt acceptance.
- Receipt acceptance does not authorize future work.
- Human approval does not execute mutation.
- Mutation packet readiness does not prove mutation happened.
- Health pass does not authorize mutation.
- Test pass does not prove future runs will pass.
- Activation pass does not authorize cleanup, deletion, or broad refactor.
- Archive is not disposal.
- Compaction is not deletion.
- Duplicate proof is not delete authority.
- Console display does not create authority.
- Actor output is evidence, not state.
- Stdout is not receipt.
- Legacy evidence is not current authority.
- Schema migration readiness does not prove migration succeeded.
- A generated file does not prove installation where actor reads it.
- Chat memory does not prove external actor enforcement.
- Recovery custody mass is not bloat.
- Presence does not prove semantic protection.

## Rule

Every active view must carry the relevant active DNP directly.
Referencing this library is not enough.

## Does Not Prove

- This library being present does not prove every view preserves DNP.
- This library does not authorize mutation.
```

## 11B.20 Batch 11B Carry Line

`BATCH 11B MAKES THE FILE TEMPLATES BEFORE ANY SCRIPT. EVERY STARTER FILE MUST DECLARE STATUS, ROLE, OWNER, CANONICAL SOURCE, ACTIVATION LEVEL, MUTATION BOUNDARY, DOES_NOT_PROVE, AND NEXT LEGAL ACTION. USER FRONT DOOR COMES FIRST. ASSISTANT BACKSTAGE STAYS BEHIND. STATE FILES START SAFE. LEDGERS START HEADER-ONLY. NO FAKE RECEIPTS. NO OPERATIONAL CLAIMS. NO SCRIPT YET.`

Next: **Batch 11C — Build Harness Design / Safe File Creator / Receipt-First Installer Plan**.














Soft suit carry stays narrow: one active object, one source pointer, one next condition. Current source is the uploaded deep revision, not dead chat. 

Active object: `COMMAND_CENTER_MVP_BUILD_HARNESS_DESIGN_V0_1`
Proof pointer: `OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2 — Deep Revision`
Next condition: design the safe file creator before writing any script.

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11C — Build Harness Design / Safe File Creator / Receipt-First Installer Plan / No Blind File Writer

Batch 11A defined the build packet. Batch 11B defined exact starter file templates. Batch 11C designs the harness that will eventually create those files.

This still does not write the script. This is the harness contract. The next failure would be obvious: after building all the rules, we could accidentally write a broad “create all files” script that overwrites existing work, creates backstage before front door, forgets receipts, skips hashes, or reports success after partial output.

Core rule:

`THE BUILD HARNESS IS A RECEIPT-FIRST FILE CREATOR, NOT A BULK WRITER.`

Carry line:

`NO BLIND WRITES. NO OVERWRITE WITHOUT BACKUP. NO FILE WITHOUT TEMPLATE. NO CREATED FILE WITHOUT HASH. NO BUILD WITHOUT RECEIPT.`

---

## 11C.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_SAFE_FILE_CREATOR_REQUIRES_PREFLIGHT_HASH_RECEIPT_AND_STOP_CONDITIONS_V0_1`

Wording:

`A command-center build harness may create only exact files named by the build packet and template map. It must preflight the lane, detect conflicts, create folders in order, write files atomically, hash outputs, record every created/changed/skipped item, and stop on mismatch without cleanup or improvisation.`

This blocks:

`bulk file spray`

`silent overwrite`

`wrong lane build`

`assistant backstage in front`

`starter files without DNP`

`partial build called complete`

`script creates files not in packet`

`script mutates root intake material`

`script installs automation`

`script runs actor dispatch`

---

## 11C.2 Harness Is an Actor Tool, Not Authority

The future harness is a tool used by an actor, probably `Codex` or a local script runner, but the harness itself does not own authority.

Correct chain:

`BUILD_PACKET -> TEMPLATE_MAP -> HARNESS_PREFLIGHT -> SAFE_WRITE -> HASH -> BUILD_RECEIPT -> JUDGE`

Incorrect chain:

`script ran -> command center installed`

Hard line:

`SCRIPT SUCCESS IS NOT BUILD ACCEPTANCE.`

Failure labels:

`HARNESS_SUCCESS_TREATED_AS_ACCEPTANCE`

`BUILD_RECEIPT_NOT_JUDGED`

`SCRIPT_OUTPUT_TREATED_AS_FINAL_TRUTH`

---

## 11C.3 Harness Scope

Allowed harness work:

`create approved folders`

`create approved starter markdown files`

`create approved starter JSON files`

`create approved CSV header-only ledgers`

`create empty JSONL logs`

`write build receipt`

`write blocker receipt if stopped`

`hash created files`

`record created/changed/skipped files`

Blocked harness work:

`delete`

`move existing user files`

`archive existing material`

`compress`

`restore`

`root intake routing`

`actor dispatch`

`watcher install`

`automation install`

`commit`

`push`

`run tests beyond self-check unless separately packeted`

`modify files not in manifest`

`overwrite existing files without backup/review`

Default:

`MutationAllowed: only exact command-center starter file creation`

---

## 11C.4 Harness Operating Modes

The harness must support modes. Default mode is not write.

Allowed modes:

`PLAN_ONLY`

Reads templates and outputs the proposed file list. No file creation.

`PREFLIGHT_ONLY`

Checks lane, conflicts, folder order, missing templates, DNP presence, and write risk. No file creation.

`DRY_RUN`

Simulates creates and writes a dry-run report. No file creation.

`CREATE_L0_SPINE`

Creates only L0 starter folders/files from approved templates.

`VERIFY_ONLY`

Hashes and validates existing L0 files against manifest.

`RECEIPT_ONLY`

Writes or rebuilds receipt from observed build outputs, but does not claim success if evidence is missing.

Forbidden modes:

`FULL_INSTALL`

`CLEAN_AND_BUILD`

`OVERWRITE_ALL`

`FIX_EXISTING`

`AUTO_REPAIR`

`RUN_EVERYTHING`

Failure:

`HARNESS_FORBIDDEN_MODE`

## 11C.5 Harness Preflight Order

The harness preflight must run before any write.

Order:

```text
1. Confirm working lane.
2. Confirm build packet id.
3. Confirm template map exists.
4. Confirm no forbidden mode.
5. Confirm no automation/watcher target.
6. Confirm folder creation order.
7. Confirm user front door precedes assistant backstage.
8. Confirm receipt folder is first.
9. Confirm every markdown template has DoesNotProve.
10. Confirm every JSON template has schema envelope.
11. Confirm every CSV template is header-only.
12. Confirm every target path is inside allowed lane.
13. Detect existing files.
14. Classify existing-file conflicts.
15. Decide write plan.
16. Produce preflight verdict.
```

No write before step 16.

Hard line:

`PREFLIGHT IS NOT BUILD.`

## 11C.8 Existing File Conflict Policy

Existing files are not automatically bad. They are protected until classified.

If target file exists:

1. Hash existing file.
2. Compare to expected template hash if known.
3. If match: `SKIP_IF_MATCH`.
4. If different: block.
5. Do not overwrite.
6. Write conflict receipt.

Conflict verdicts:

`EXISTING_FILE_MATCH_SKIP`

`EXISTING_FILE_DIFF_BLOCK`

`EXISTING_FOLDER_PRESENT_OK`

`EXISTING_PATH_TYPE_CONFLICT`

`EXISTING_FILE_NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW`

Failure labels:

`HARNESS_OVERWROTE_EXISTING_FILE`

`HARNESS_EXISTING_DIFF_IGNORED`

`HARNESS_PATH_TYPE_CONFLICT`

Hard line:

`DIFFERENT EXISTING FILE IS A BLOCKER, NOT A TARGET.`

---

## 11C.9 Atomic Write Rule

The harness must not write directly to final file if avoidable.

Write sequence:

```text
1. Write temp file beside target or in build staging.
2. Flush/close.
3. Hash temp.
4. Validate required markers.
5. Rename temp to final only if final does not exist.
6. Hash final.
7. Record receipt row.
```

If final exists after preflight but before rename:

`HARNESS_RACE_CONFLICT_BLOCK`

No overwrite fallback.

Failure:

`HARNESS_NON_ATOMIC_WRITE`

## 11C.16 Blocker Receipt

If stopped, write:

```text
# BUILD BLOCKER RECEIPT

Status: BUILD_BLOCKED
BuildPacketId:
BuildRunId:
Mode:
BlockedUtc:
BlockedStep:
BlockedTarget:
BlockedReason:
ObservedState:
ExpectedState:
FilesCreatedBeforeBlock:
ItemReceiptLedger:
RollbackAvailable:
SafeNextAction:

MutationOccurred:
ForbiddenMutationOccurred:

DoesNotProve:
- This blocker receipt does not fix the blocker.
- Partial file creation does not prove L0 install succeeded.
- No further build step may continue until blocker is reviewed.

NextLegalAction:
```

If the harness cannot write blocker receipt:

`HARNESS_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_FAILED`

and the next human/operator action is manual inspection.

## 11C.17 Rollback Boundary

L0 build rollback is limited.

Allowed rollback:

`remove only files created in the same failed build run, if and only if item ledger proves they were created by this run and no external changes occurred`

Blocked rollback:

`delete pre-existing files`

`delete user-created files`

`clean folders broadly`

`remove root material`

`erase receipts`

`hide blocker evidence`

Default:

Do not auto-rollback. Report rollback candidate only.

Failure:

`HARNESS_AUTO_ROLLBACK_DELETED_EVIDENCE`

Hard line:

`ROLLBACK IS A REVIEWED MUTATION, NOT PANIC CLEANUP.`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11C — Build Harness Design / Safe File Creator / Receipt-First Installer Plan / No Blind File Writer

Batch 11A defined the build packet. Batch 11B defined exact starter file templates. Batch 11C designs the harness that will eventually create those files.

This still does not write the script. This is the harness contract. The next failure would be obvious: after building all the rules, we could accidentally write a broad “create all files” script that overwrites existing work, creates backstage before front door, forgets receipts, skips hashes, or reports success after partial output.

Core rule:

`THE BUILD HARNESS IS A RECEIPT-FIRST FILE CREATOR, NOT A BULK WRITER.`

Carry line:

`NO BLIND WRITES. NO OVERWRITE WITHOUT BACKUP. NO FILE WITHOUT TEMPLATE. NO CREATED FILE WITHOUT HASH. NO BUILD WITHOUT RECEIPT.`

---

## 11C.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_SAFE_FILE_CREATOR_REQUIRES_PREFLIGHT_HASH_RECEIPT_AND_STOP_CONDITIONS_V0_1`

Wording:

`A command-center build harness may create only exact files named by the build packet and template map. It must preflight the lane, detect conflicts, create folders in order, write files atomically, hash outputs, record every created/changed/skipped item, and stop on mismatch without cleanup or improvisation.`

This blocks:

`bulk file spray`

`silent overwrite`

`wrong lane build`

`assistant backstage in front`

`starter files without DNP`

`partial build called complete`

`script creates files not in packet`

`script mutates root intake material`

`script installs automation`

`script runs actor dispatch`

---

## 11C.2 Harness Is an Actor Tool, Not Authority

The future harness is a tool used by an actor, probably `Codex` or a local script runner, but the harness itself does not own authority.

Correct chain:

`BUILD_PACKET -> TEMPLATE_MAP -> HARNESS_PREFLIGHT -> SAFE_WRITE -> HASH -> BUILD_RECEIPT -> JUDGE`

Incorrect chain:

`script ran -> command center installed`

Hard line:

`SCRIPT SUCCESS IS NOT BUILD ACCEPTANCE.`

Failure labels:

`HARNESS_SUCCESS_TREATED_AS_ACCEPTANCE`

`BUILD_RECEIPT_NOT_JUDGED`

`SCRIPT_OUTPUT_TREATED_AS_FINAL_TRUTH`

---

## 11C.3 Harness Scope

Allowed harness work:

`create approved folders`

`create approved starter markdown files`

`create approved starter JSON files`

`create approved CSV header-only ledgers`

`create empty JSONL logs`

`write build receipt`

`write blocker receipt if stopped`

`hash created files`

`record created/changed/skipped files`

Blocked harness work:

`delete`

`move existing user files`

`archive existing material`

`compress`

`restore`

`root intake routing`

`actor dispatch`

`watcher install`

`automation install`

`commit`

`push`

`run tests beyond self-check unless separately packeted`

`modify files not in manifest`

`overwrite existing files without backup/review`

Default:

`MutationAllowed: only exact command-center starter file creation`

```json
}
```

## 11C.16 Blocker Receipt

If stopped, write:

```text
# BUILD BLOCKER RECEIPT

Status: BUILD_BLOCKED
BuildPacketId:
BuildRunId:
Mode:
BlockedUtc:
BlockedStep:
BlockedTarget:
BlockedReason:
ObservedState:
ExpectedState:
FilesCreatedBeforeBlock:
ItemReceiptLedger:
RollbackAvailable:
SafeNextAction:

MutationOccurred:
ForbiddenMutationOccurred:

DoesNotProve:
- This blocker receipt does not fix the blocker.
- Partial file creation does not prove L0 install succeeded.
- No further build step may continue until blocker is reviewed.

NextLegalAction:
```

If the harness cannot write blocker receipt:

`HARNESS_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_FAILED`

and the next human/operator action is manual inspection.

---

## 11C.17 Rollback Boundary

L0 build rollback is limited.

Allowed rollback:

`remove only files created in the same failed build run, if and only if item ledger proves they were created by this run and no external changes occurred`

Blocked rollback:

`delete pre-existing files`

`delete user-created files`

`clean folders broadly`

`remove root material`

`erase receipts`

`hide blocker evidence`

Default:

Do not auto-rollback. Report rollback candidate only.

Failure:

`HARNESS_AUTO_ROLLBACK_DELETED_EVIDENCE`

Hard line:

`ROLLBACK IS A REVIEWED MUTATION, NOT PANIC CLEANUP.`

## 11D.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_POWERSHELL_HARNESS_MUST_BE_MANIFEST_DRIVEN_AND_RECEIPTED_V0_1`

Wording:

`The PowerShell harness may not contain free-write logic, cleanup logic, recursive mutation logic, wildcard deletion, automatic overwrite, broad repair, watcher installation, actor dispatch, or activation promotion. It may only execute an approved mode against an approved target manifest and approved template map, then write item-level receipts and final build receipt.`

This blocks:

`New-Item everywhere`

`Set-Content against hardcoded loose paths`

`Remove-Item cleanup after failed write`

`Move-Item old files out of the way`

`Compress-Archive backup then delete source`

`wildcard folder creation outside manifest`

`script reports success without receipt`

`script creates command center and also activates it`

`script installs watcher because we talked about sensors`

`script runs Codex/Mule/Guard after creating files`

## 11D.9 Target Manifest Contract

The script reads target rows. It never invents them.

Manifest columns:

```text
TargetId,TargetPath,FileKind,TemplateId,RequiredOrder,OwnerLayer,AuthorityBoundary,MayOverwrite,IfExistsAction,RequiresDnp,RequiresSchema,RequiresReceipt,DoesNotProve
```

Allowed `FileKind`:

```text
FOLDER
MARKDOWN
JSON
CSV_HEADER_ONLY
JSONL_EMPTY
```

Blocked `FileKind`:

```text
PS1
EXE
BAT
CMD
JS_RUNNER
WATCHER
AUTOMATION
MUTATION_RUNNER
DELETE_SCRIPT
UNKNOWN
```

Allowed `IfExistsAction`:

```text
SKIP_IF_MATCH
BLOCK_IF_DIFFERENT
BLOCK_IF_EXISTS
CREATE_IF_MISSING
```

Blocked:

```text
OVERWRITE
MERGE
APPEND
REPAIR
MOVE_ASIDE
BACKUP_AND_REPLACE
```

Hard line:

`NO MANIFEST ROW, NO FILE.`

Template map must define:

```text
TemplateId
TemplateKind
TemplateSource
ExpectedSHA256
RequiredMarkers
AllowedFileKind
DoesNotProve
```

For embedded script templates, `TemplateSource` may be:

`EMBEDDED_LITERAL`

For external templates:

script must hash and verify them before use.

If template hash mismatch:

`HARNESS_TEMPLATE_HASH_MISMATCH`

If template kind mismatches target file kind:

`HARNESS_TEMPLATE_KIND_MISMATCH`

If markdown template missing `Does Not Prove`:

`HARNESS_TEMPLATE_DNP_MISSING`

If JSON template missing `DoesNotProve`:

`HARNESS_JSON_DNP_MISSING`
