## 11J.8 PowerShell AST Review

Review should not rely only on string search.

Required methods:

`raw text scan`

`PowerShell AST parse`

`command AST extraction`

`function name scan`

`parameter scan`

`literal path scan`

`string pattern scan`

`exit-code scan`

`catch-block scan`

If AST parse fails:

`CODE_REVIEW_BLOCKED_AST_PARSE_FAIL`

If only raw grep was used:

`CODE_REVIEW_WEAK_RAW_SCAN_ONLY`

Raw scan may catch text, but AST confirms executable structure.

## 11J.9 Review Findings Ledger

Create:

```text
CODE_REVIEW_FINDINGS.csv
```

Columns:

```text
FindingId,ScriptName,ScriptSHA256,FindingType,Severity,Line,Column,Observed,Expected,FailureLabel,BlocksSelfTest,BlocksLiveUse,RequiredToClear,DoesNotProve
```

Severity levels:

`INFO`

`WARN`

`BLOCK_SELFTEST`

`BLOCK_LIVE_USE`

`FAIL_CLOSED_REQUIRED`

Any `BLOCK_SELFTEST` blocks sandbox execution.

Any `BLOCK_LIVE_USE` blocks live run even if self-test later passes.

Any forbidden command is at least `BLOCK_SELFTEST`.

---

## 11J.10 Review Verdicts

Allowed verdicts:

`CODE_REVIEW_PASS_FOR_SELFTEST_ONLY`

Script may enter sandbox self-test.

`CODE_REVIEW_PASS_FOR_LIVE_REQUEST_AFTER_SELFTEST`

Script passed review and may request live L0 run only after self-test pass, template freeze, and user approval.

`CODE_REVIEW_WARN_SELFTEST_ALLOWED`

Warnings exist, but no fail-open risk for sandbox.

`CODE_REVIEW_BLOCKED_FOR_SELFTEST`

Script cannot enter sandbox.

`CODE_REVIEW_BLOCKED_FOR_LIVE_USE`

Script may be studied but cannot touch live lane.

`CODE_REVIEW_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_EFFECT`

Reviewer cannot determine effect.

Forbidden verdicts:

`SAFE`

`GOOD`

`READY`

`DONE`

`APPROVED`

Those are too vague.

```text
ReviewMethod:
```

`This review does not prove runtime behavior.`

`This review does not authorize live use.`

`This review does not replace sandbox self-test.`

`This review does not prove command-center behavior works.`

`This review applies only to the exact script hash reviewed.`

If `ScriptSHA256` missing:

receipt invalid.

`CODE_REVIEW_RECEIPT_MISSING_SCRIPT_HASH`

## 11J.12 Review Scope Binding

Review applies only to the exact script hash.

If script changes after review:

`SCRIPT_HASH_DRIFT_AFTER_REVIEW`

Required action:

`invalidate review`

`write revision packet`

`rerun review`

`rerun affected self-tests`

No quiet edit.

Hard line:

`NEW HASH = NEW REVIEW.`

Stop review and block if:

`script file missing`

`script hash missing`

`AST parse fails`

`forbidden command found`

`Invoke-Expression found`

`network call found`

`watcher/automation found`

`actor dispatch found`

`delete/move/archive/restore command found`

`path root inferred from PWD`

`receipt behavior missing`

`DNP missing from receipts`

`exit 0 possible without receipt`

`catch continue exists`

`unknown effect`

On stop:

Do not proceed to self-test.

## 11L.5 Readiness State Vocabulary

Allowed readiness states:

`DESIGNED`

The layer exists as design text.

`DRAFTED`

A draft artifact exists but is not reviewed/frozen/tested.

`MATERIALIZED`

The artifact exists as a file in the correct lane.

`HASHED`

The artifact has recorded SHA256.

`FROZEN`

The artifact is locked by freeze receipt.

`REVIEWED`

The artifact passed review for stated scope.

`SELFTESTED`

The artifact passed sandbox self-test for stated scope.

`APPROVED_FOR_REQUEST`

The artifact chain may request live L0 run.

`APPROVED_FOR_ONE_TIME_LIVE_L0`

Exact one-time live approval exists.

`EXECUTED`

The exact run happened.

`JUDGED`

Receipt was reviewed and accepted/rejected.

Blocked ambiguous words:

`READY`

`DONE`

`SAFE`

`GOOD`

`INSTALLED`

`OPERATIONAL`

unless paired with scope and receipt.

Failure:

`READINESS_WORD_TOO_BROAD`

## 11L.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_BUILD_CHAIN_REQUIRES_CLOSEOUT_INDEX_BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION_V0_1`

Wording:

`Before any command-center implementation packet is created, the full 11A–11K design chain must be indexed into a readiness matrix, artifact ledger, blocker ledger, dependency chain, go/no-go ledger, and DoesNotProve library so no missing gate is hidden by the size of the design.`

This blocks:

`large spec treated as readiness`

`script draft treated as runnable`

`template map treated as frozen`

`self-test design treated as self-test pass`

`code review standard treated as code review receipt`

`live approval packet standard treated as approval`

`operator run note standard treated as execution`

`closeout called done without blocker ledger`

---

## 11L.2 Closeout Is Not Approval

Closeout organizes readiness.

Closeout does not approve live run.

Hard line:

`CLOSEOUT_INDEX = VISIBILITY.`
`CLOSEOUT_INDEX != APPROVAL.`
`CLOSEOUT_INDEX != IMPLEMENTATION.`
`CLOSEOUT_INDEX != LIVE_RUN.`

DoesNotProve:

`A complete closeout index does not prove scripts exist.`

`A complete closeout index does not prove templates are frozen.`

`A complete closeout index does not prove self-tests passed.`

`A complete closeout index does not prove code review passed.`

`A complete closeout index does not authorize live L0 creation.`

---

## 11L.5 Readiness State Vocabulary

Allowed readiness states:

`DESIGNED`

The layer exists as design text.

`DRAFTED`

A draft artifact exists but is not reviewed/frozen/tested.

`MATERIALIZED`

The artifact exists as a file in the correct lane.

`HASHED`

The artifact has recorded SHA256.

`FROZEN`

The artifact is locked by freeze receipt.

`REVIEWED`

The artifact passed review for stated scope.

`SELFTESTED`

The artifact passed sandbox self-test for stated scope.

`APPROVED_FOR_REQUEST`

The artifact chain may request live L0 run.

`APPROVED_FOR_ONE_TIME_LIVE_L0`

Exact one-time live approval exists.

`EXECUTED`

The exact run happened.

`JUDGED`

Receipt was reviewed and accepted/rejected.

Blocked ambiguous words:

`READY`

`DONE`

`SAFE`

`GOOD`

`INSTALLED`

`OPERATIONAL`

unless paired with scope and receipt.

Failure:

`READINESS_WORD_TOO_BROAD`

## 11L.11 Go/No-Go Decision Vocabulary

Allowed:

`GO_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION_PACKET_ONLY`

Means next packet may create files/artifacts, not run them.

`GO_FOR_SELFTEST_REQUEST_ONLY`

Means sandbox self-test may be requested, not live run.

`GO_FOR_LIVE_L0_REQUEST_ONLY`

Means operator may request live run after final preflight.

`GO_FOR_ONE_TIME_LIVE_L0`

Means exact one-time approval exists.

`NO_GO_FOR_SELFTEST`

`NO_GO_FOR_LIVE_L0`

`NO_GO_FOR_ACTIVATION`

`BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_EFFECT`

Forbidden:

`GO`

`READY`

`DONE`

`SAFE`

without scope.

## 11L.13 Implementation Packet Boundary

The next packet after 11L should be an implementation packet, not a live run packet.

Name:

`COMMAND_CENTER_MVP_L0_IMPLEMENTATION_PACKET_V0_1`

It may include:

`create build-harness folder`

`write design artifacts`

`write script draft file`

`write manifest file`

`write template map file`

`write template bundle file`

`write templates`

`write closeout ledgers`

`write receipts`

It must not:

`run CREATE_L0_SPINE live`

`run self-test unless separately approved`

`write live COMMAND_CENTER starter files`

`install watcher`

`install automation`

`dispatch actors`

`delete/move/archive/restore`

`commit/push unless separately packeted and actually performed`

## 11L.14 Closeout DoesNotProve Library

```text
# COMMAND CENTER MVP CLOSEOUT DOES_NOT_PROVE

Status: CLOSEOUT_DNP_LIBRARY

DoesNotProve:
- 11A–11K design chain does not prove files exist.
- Closeout index does not prove implementation exists.
- Manifest design does not prove manifest file exists.
- Template content in chat does not prove template files exist.
- Script draft does not prove script file exists.
- Script file does not prove code review pass.
- Code review pass does not prove runtime behavior.
- Self-test design does not prove self-test pass.
- Self-test pass does not authorize live run.
- Template freeze standard does not prove freeze receipt exists.
- Freeze receipt does not prove target files were created.
- Approval packet template does not approve live run.
- Operator run note does not execute live run.
- Final preflight pass does not prove create mode will succeed.
- Build receipt does not prove user acceptance.
- User L0 acceptance does not activate MVP.
- L0 spine does not authorize watcher, automation, actor dispatch, cleanup, delete, move, archive, restore, commit, or push.
```

## 11N.2 Materialization Is Split into Source Packs

Do not jam every literal template, script, manifest, fixture, and receipt into one giant mush. That causes dropped content and parser mistakes.

Materialization packs:

`11N_CORE_CONTROL_PACK`

Core build-harness control files, implementation packet, target manifest, DNP, next packet request, review/freeze/selftest/live approval templates.

`11O_TEMPLATE_FRONT_DOOR_PACK`

Literal user-facing markdown templates from 11B.

`11P_TEMPLATE_BACKSTAGE_AND_STATE_PACK`

Literal backstage markdown, JSON state, CSV header templates, empty JSONL template.

`11Q_SCRIPT_AND_VALIDATOR_PACK`

Harness script file body, static validator skeleton, and materialization writer notes.

`11R_FIXTURE_SKELETON_PACK`

Self-test fixture skeletons and expected fixture manifests.

`11S_MATERIALIZATION_RECEIPT_AND_HASH_PASS`

Hash ledger, receipt shape, blocker receipt, and materialization closeout.

Rule:

`SPLITTING PACKS IS PRESERVATION, NOT SHORTENING.`

Nothing is dropped. Template bodies are explicitly parked into 11O and 11P so they can be returned as literal file bodies without compressing them.

Failure:

`MATERIALIZATION_PACK_COMPRESSED_CONTENT`

```text
# ASSISTANT COMMAND CENTER / BACKSTAGE README

Status: BACKSTAGE_VIEW_NOT_USER_AUTHORITY
SchemaName: ASSISTANT_BACKSTAGE_README
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: ASSISTANT_CONTROL_PLANE_POINTER
OwnerLayer: ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER
CanonicalSource: ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER_STATE folder
GeneratedFrom: BUILD_PACKET__COMMAND_CENTER_MVP__V0_1
ActivationLevel: L0_READ_ONLY_SPINE
MutationAuthorized: false

This is the assistant backstage control surface.

It tracks:
- actors
- routing
- custody packets
- work tokens
- handoffs
- receipts
- blockers
- guard status
- byte accounting
- root intake
- event logs

It does not own:
- user intent
- final approval
- irreversible decisions
- final acceptance
- mutation authority by itself

Authority comes from USER_COMMAND_CENTER and exact custody/mutation packets.

Assistant Command Center may request.
User Command Center may approve.
Actors may execute only exact packeted work.

## Forbidden From Backstage Alone

- delete
- move
- archive
- restore
- cleanup
- automation
- watcher
- actor dispatch
- commit
- push
- MVP activation

## Does Not Prove

- Backstage status does not prove user approval.
- Backstage receipt registration does not prove receipt acceptance.
- Backstage routing does not prove actor execution.
- Backstage views do not create authority.
- Backstage starter file does not prove live state exists.

## Next Legal Action

Read user front door first, then inspect backstage projections only as subordinate evidence.
```

## 11Q.6 Exact Static Validator Skeleton — `review\STATIC_VALIDATE_COMMAND_CENTER_HARNESS_V0_1.ps1`

```powershell
<#
SCRIPT PURPOSE:
Read and statically inspect a command-center harness script candidate.
Produce candidate findings only.

SCRIPT STATUS:
DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED
READ_ONLY_STATIC_SCAN_CANDIDATE

SCRIPT DOES NOT:
execute the harness, dot-source the harness, run self-tests, approve code review,
approve live L0, mutate live command-center files, mutate live state, delete, move,
archive, restore, install watcher, install automation, dispatch actors, commit, or push.

DOES_NOT_PROVE:
This static validator does not prove runtime behavior.
This static validator does not replace human or assistant code review.
This static validator does not authorize script execution.
This static validator applies only to the exact script path and hash scanned.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ScriptPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$HarnessPackageRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$OutputRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$ScanId = "",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [switch]$Strict = $true
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Findings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

function Get-UtcNow {
    return (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o")
}

function New-ScanId {
    $stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ")
    return "STATIC_SCAN_CC_HARNESS_$stamp"
}

function Get-FullPathStrict {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) {
        throw "STATIC_VALIDATOR_BLANK_PATH"
    }

    if ($Path -match "\.\.") {
        throw "STATIC_VALIDATOR_PATH_TRAVERSAL_RISK: $Path"
    }

    $blocked = @(
        "PASTE_THE_COPIED_PATH_HERE",
        "TODO_PATH",
        "CHANGE_ME",
        "<PATH>",
        "[PATH]",
        "C:\path\to",
        "example",
        "sample"
    )

    foreach ($b in $blocked) {
        if ($Path -like "*$b*") {
            throw "STATIC_VALIDATOR_PLACEHOLDER_PATH: $Path"
        }
    }

    return [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
}

function Test-ChildPathInsideParent {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ChildPath,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ParentPath
    )

    $child = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ChildPath).TrimEnd('\')
    $parent = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($ParentPath).TrimEnd('\')

    if ($child.Equals($parent, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $true
    }

    return $child.StartsWith($parent + "\", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Get-FileSha256Safe {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "STATIC_VALIDATOR_SCRIPT_MISSING: $Path"
    }

    return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
}

function Write-Utf8NoBomFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Text
    )

    $encoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, $encoding)
}

function ConvertTo-CsvSafeValue {
    param([AllowNull()][object]$Value)

    if ($null -eq $Value) {
        return ""
    }

    $text = [string]$Value
    $needsQuotes = $text.Contains(",") -or $text.Contains('"') -or $text.Contains("`n") -or $text.Contains("`r")
    $escaped = $text.Replace('"', '""')

    if ($needsQuotes) {
        return '"' + $escaped + '"'
    }

    return $escaped
}

function Join-CsvLine {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]]$Values)

    $out = foreach ($v in $Values) {
        ConvertTo-CsvSafeValue -Value $v
    }

    return ($out -join ",")
}

function Add-Finding {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$FindingType,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Severity,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][int]$Line = 0,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][int]$Column = 0,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Observed,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Expected,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$FailureLabel,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][bool]$BlocksSelfTest,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][bool]$BlocksLiveUse,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$RequiredToClear = ""
    )

    $script:Findings.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        FindingId = "F" + ($script:Findings.Count + 1).ToString("0000")
        FindingType = $FindingType
        Severity = $Severity
        Line = $Line
        Column = $Column
        Observed = $Observed
        Expected = $Expected
        FailureLabel = $FailureLabel
        BlocksSelfTest = $BlocksSelfTest
        BlocksLiveUse = $BlocksLiveUse
        RequiredToClear = $RequiredToClear
        DoesNotProve = "Finding row does not repair the script."
    })
}

function Get-ForbiddenCommandList {
    return @(
        "Remove-Item",
        "Move-Item",
        "Compress-Archive",
        "Expand-Archive",
        "Start-Process",
        "Start-Job",
        "Register-ObjectEvent",
        "New-ScheduledTask",
        "Register-ScheduledTask",
        "Invoke-WebRequest",
        "Invoke-RestMethod",
        "Invoke-Expression",
        "git commit",
        "git push",
        "git clean",
        "robocopy /MOVE",
        "robocopy /MOV",
        "cmd /c",
        "powershell -Command",
        "pwsh -Command"
    )
}

function Get-ForbiddenAliasList {
    return @(
        "rm",
        "mv",
        "del",
        "erase",
        "rmdir",
        "ri",
        "mi"
    )
}

function Test-RawForbiddenCommands {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Text)

    foreach ($cmd in (Get-ForbiddenCommandList)) {
        if ($Text -match [regex]::Escape($cmd)) {
            Add-Finding `
                -FindingType "FORBIDDEN_COMMAND_RAW" `
                -Severity "BLOCK_SELFTEST" `
                -Observed $cmd `
                -Expected "Forbidden command absent unless separately reviewed and justified." `
                -FailureLabel "CODE_REVIEW_FAIL_FORBIDDEN_COMMAND" `
                -BlocksSelfTest $true `
                -BlocksLiveUse $true `
                -RequiredToClear "Remove command or create explicit reviewed exception."
        }
    }

    foreach ($alias in (Get-ForbiddenAliasList)) {
        $pattern = "(?m)^\s*$([regex]::Escape($alias))\b"
        if ($Text -match $pattern) {
            Add-Finding `
                -FindingType "FORBIDDEN_ALIAS_RAW" `
                -Severity "BLOCK_SELFTEST" `
                -Observed $alias `
                -Expected "Mutation aliases absent." `
                -FailureLabel "CODE_REVIEW_FAIL_ALIAS_MUTATION" `
                -BlocksSelfTest $true `
                -BlocksLiveUse $true `
                -RequiredToClear "Replace alias and review command intent."
        }
    }
}

function Invoke-AstParse {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    $tokens = $null
    $errors = $null
    $ast = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($Path, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$errors)

    if ($errors -and $errors.Count -gt 0) {
        foreach ($e in $errors) {
            Add-Finding `
                -FindingType "AST_PARSE_ERROR" `
                -Severity "BLOCK_SELFTEST" `
                -Line $e.Extent.StartLineNumber `
                -Column $e.Extent.StartColumnNumber `
                -Observed $e.Message `
                -Expected "PowerShell AST parse passes." `
                -FailureLabel "CODE_REVIEW_BLOCKED_AST_PARSE_FAIL" `
                -BlocksSelfTest $true `
                -BlocksLiveUse $true `
                -RequiredToClear "Fix parse error and rerun static scan."
        }
    }

    return $ast
}

function Test-AstCommands {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Ast)

    $commandAsts = $Ast.FindAll({
        param($node)
        $node -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.CommandAst]
    }, $true)

    foreach ($cmdAst in $commandAsts) {
        $name = $cmdAst.GetCommandName()
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($name)) {
            continue
        }

        foreach ($blocked in (Get-ForbiddenCommandList)) {
            if ($name.Equals($blocked, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                Add-Finding `
                    -FindingType "FORBIDDEN_COMMAND_AST" `
                    -Severity "BLOCK_SELFTEST" `
                    -Line $cmdAst.Extent.StartLineNumber `
                    -Column $cmdAst.Extent.StartColumnNumber `
                    -Observed $name `
                    -Expected "Forbidden executable command absent." `
                    -FailureLabel "CODE_REVIEW_FAIL_FORBIDDEN_COMMAND" `
                    -BlocksSelfTest $true `
                    -BlocksLiveUse $true `
                    -RequiredToClear "Remove forbidden command or route through separate reviewed exception."
            }
        }

        foreach ($alias in (Get-ForbiddenAliasList)) {
            if ($name.Equals($alias, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
                Add-Finding `
                    -FindingType "FORBIDDEN_ALIAS_AST" `
                    -Severity "BLOCK_SELFTEST" `
                    -Line $cmdAst.Extent.StartLineNumber `
                    -Column $cmdAst.Extent.StartColumnNumber `
                    -Observed $name `
                    -Expected "Mutation aliases absent." `
                    -FailureLabel "CODE_REVIEW_FAIL_ALIAS_MUTATION" `
                    -BlocksSelfTest $true `
                    -BlocksLiveUse $true `
                    -RequiredToClear "Replace alias and review intent."
            }
        }
    }
}

function Test-RequiredBoundaryText {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Text)

    $required = @(
        "SCRIPT PURPOSE:",
        "SCRIPT DOES NOT:",
        "FAILURE POLICY:",
        "DOES_NOT_PROVE",
        "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest",
        '$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"',
        "MutationAuthorized",
        "DoesNotProve",
        "NextLegalAction",
        "BUILD_BLOCKER_RECEIPT",
        "BUILD RECEIPT"
    )

    foreach ($marker in $required) {
        if (-not $Text.Contains($marker)) {
            Add-Finding `
                -FindingType "REQUIRED_BOUNDARY_MARKER_MISSING" `
                -Severity "BLOCK_SELFTEST" `
                -Observed "Missing marker: $marker" `
                -Expected "Required script boundary marker present." `
                -FailureLabel "CODE_REVIEW_FAIL_RECEIPT_GAP" `
                -BlocksSelfTest $true `
                -BlocksLiveUse $true `
                -RequiredToClear "Restore required marker and rerun review."
        }
    }
}

function Test-PathSafetyPatterns {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Text)

    $badPatterns = @(
        "Get-Location",
        '$PWD',
        "Set-Location",
        "..\",
        "../",
        "PASTE_THE_COPIED_PATH_HERE",
        "TODO_PATH",
        "CHANGE_ME"
    )

    foreach ($p in $badPatterns) {
        if ($Text.Contains($p)) {
            Add-Finding `
                -FindingType "PATH_SAFETY_PATTERN" `
                -Severity "WARN" `
                -Observed $p `
                -Expected "Path pattern absent or explicitly justified." `
                -FailureLabel "CODE_REVIEW_FAIL_PATH_ESCAPE_RISK" `
                -BlocksSelfTest $false `
                -BlocksLiveUse $true `
                -RequiredToClear "Review path usage manually."
        }
    }
}

function Test-CatchContinue {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Text)

    if ($Text -match "catch\s*\{[^}]*continue") {
        Add-Finding `
            -FindingType "CATCH_CONTINUE" `
            -Severity "BLOCK_SELFTEST" `
            -Observed "catch block contains continue" `
            -Expected "No catch continue without receipt and stop." `
            -FailureLabel "CODE_REVIEW_FAIL_ERROR_HANDLING_GAP" `
            -BlocksSelfTest $true `
            -BlocksLiveUse $true `
            -RequiredToClear "Replace catch-continue with receipted failure."
    }
}

function Write-FindingsLedger {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$OutputDirectory,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ScanId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ScriptName,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ScriptSHA256
    )

    $path = Join-Path $OutputDirectory ("STATIC_CODE_REVIEW_FINDINGS_" + $ScanId + ".csv")

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("FindingId,ScriptName,ScriptSHA256,FindingType,Severity,Line,Column,Observed,Expected,FailureLabel,BlocksSelfTest,BlocksLiveUse,RequiredToClear,DoesNotProve")

    foreach ($f in $script:Findings) {
        $lines.Add((Join-CsvLine @(
            $f.FindingId,
            $ScriptName,
            $ScriptSHA256,
            $f.FindingType,
            $f.Severity,
            $f.Line,
            $f.Column,
            $f.Observed,
            $f.Expected,
            $f.FailureLabel,
            $f.BlocksSelfTest,
            $f.BlocksLiveUse,
            $f.RequiredToClear,
            $f.DoesNotProve
        )))
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBomFile -Path $path -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    return $path
}

function Write-StaticValidatorReport {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$OutputDirectory,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ScanId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ScriptName,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ScriptPathResolved,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ScriptSHA256,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$FindingsLedger
    )

    $blockSelfTest = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.BlocksSelfTest -eq $true }).Count
    $blockLive = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.BlocksLiveUse -eq $true }).Count

    $verdict = if ($blockSelfTest -gt 0) {
        "STATIC_SCAN_BLOCKED_FINDINGS"
    }
    elseif ($blockLive -gt 0) {
        "STATIC_SCAN_WARN_BLOCKS_LIVE_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
    }
    else {
        "STATIC_SCAN_NO_BLOCKERS_REVIEW_STILL_REQUIRED"
    }

    $text = @"
# STATIC VALIDATOR REPORT

Status: STATIC_SCAN_REPORT_NOT_CODE_REVIEW_RECEIPT
ScanId: $ScanId
CreatedUtc: $(Get-UtcNow)

ScriptName: $ScriptName
ScriptPath: $ScriptPathResolved
ScriptSHA256: $ScriptSHA256

FindingsLedger: $FindingsLedger
FindingsTotal: $($script:Findings.Count)
BlockSelfTestCount: $blockSelfTest
BlockLiveUseCount: $blockLive

FinalVerdict: $verdict

DoesNotProve:
- This report does not prove runtime behavior.
- This report does not replace code review.
- This report does not authorize self-test by itself.
- This report does not authorize live L0.
- This report applies only to the exact script hash scanned.

NextLegalAction:
Use this report as input to CODE_REVIEW_PACKET, not as a substitute for CODE_REVIEW_RECEIPT.
"@

    $path = Join-Path $OutputDirectory ("STATIC_VALIDATOR_REPORT_" + $ScanId + ".md")
    Write-Utf8NoBomFile -Path $path -Text $text
    return $path
}

function Invoke-Main {
    $resolvedScript = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $ScriptPath
    $resolvedPackage = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $HarnessPackageRoot
    $resolvedOutput = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $OutputRoot

    if (-not (Test-ChildPathInsideParent -ChildPath $resolvedScript -ParentPath $resolvedPackage)) {
        throw "STATIC_VALIDATOR_SCRIPT_OUTSIDE_PACKAGE"
    }

    if (-not (Test-ChildPathInsideParent -ChildPath $resolvedOutput -ParentPath $resolvedPackage)) {
        throw "STATIC_VALIDATOR_OUTPUT_OUTSIDE_PACKAGE"
    }

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($resolvedScript)) {
        throw "STATIC_VALIDATOR_SCRIPT_MISSING"
    }

    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($resolvedOutput) | Out-Null

    $id = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ScanId)) { New-ScanId } else { $ScanId }
    $scriptName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($resolvedScript)
    $hash = Get-FileSha256Safe -Path $resolvedScript
    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($resolvedScript)

    Test-RawForbiddenCommands -Text $text
    $ast = Invoke-AstParse -Path $resolvedScript
    Test-AstCommands -Ast $ast
    Test-RequiredBoundaryText -Text $text
    Test-PathSafetyPatterns -Text $text
    Test-CatchContinue -Text $text

    $ledger = Write-FindingsLedger `
        -OutputDirectory $resolvedOutput `
        -ScanId $id `
        -ScriptName $scriptName `
        -ScriptSHA256 $hash

    $report = Write-StaticValidatorReport `
        -OutputDirectory $resolvedOutput `
        -ScanId $id `
        -ScriptName $scriptName `
        -ScriptPathResolved $resolvedScript `
        -ScriptSHA256 $hash `
        -FindingsLedger $ledger

    Write-Output "SCAN_ID: $id"
    Write-Output "SCRIPT_SHA256: $hash"
    Write-Output "FINDINGS: $($script:Findings.Count)"
    Write-Output "LEDGER: $ledger"
    Write-Output "REPORT: $report"
    Write-Output "NEXT: CREATE_CODE_REVIEW_PACKET"
}

try {
    Invoke-Main
    exit 0
}
catch {
    Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    exit 30
}
```

## 11Q.11 Script and Validator Validation Rules

The script pack is valid only if:

`harness script source is exactly bound to 11E`

`static validator has boundary header`

`static validator does not execute target script`

`static validator uses AST parse`

`static validator writes findings as candidate evidence only`

`static validator does not write CODE_REVIEW_RECEIPT pass`

`forbidden command list exists`

`review checklist exists`

`writer notes exist`

`DNP appears in every markdown/support file`

`all files are under BUILD_HARNESS lane`

`no live COMMAND_CENTER target`

`no live assistant state target`

`no root loose file`

## 11R.4 Fixture Folder Shape

Each fixture folder must use this shape:

```text
fixtures\<FixtureId>\
  README.md
  expected.json
  package\
    manifest.csv
    template_map.csv
    templates\
  lane\
  receipts\
```

Rules:

`package` contains fixture-specific manifests/templates.

`lane` is the future fake working lane for the harness.

`receipts` is where future fixture harness receipts may land.

`expected.json` defines expected outcome only.

`README.md` explains the fixture intent.

`observed.json`

`BUILD_RECEIPT` claiming actual run

`stdout pretending an execution happened`

## 11R.6 Exact Fixture README — `fixtures\README_FIXTURES.md`

```text
# HARNESS SELF-TEST FIXTURES

Status: FIXTURE_SKELETONS_ONLY
SchemaName: HARNESS_SELFTEST_FIXTURE_INDEX
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: SELFTEST_FIXTURE_SOURCE_GUIDE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

## Purpose

These fixture folders define the bad and good cases that a future self-test runner must execute against the command-center L0 build harness.

They are source fixtures only.

They do not prove:
- the harness was run
- a failure label was observed
- a blocker receipt exists
- happy path passed
- self-test suite passed
- live L0 is approved

## Fixture Order

Negative fixtures must run before happy path:

1. 11G_001_WRONG_LANE
2. 11G_002_PATH_ESCAPE
3. 11G_003_PLACEHOLDER_PATH
4. 11G_004_EXISTING_DIFF
5. 11G_005_MISSING_DNP
6. 11G_006_JSON_MISSING_SCHEMA
7. 11G_007_CSV_FAKE_ROW
8. 11G_008_BACKSTAGE_FIRST
9. 11G_009_FORBIDDEN_TARGET
10. 11G_010_UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE
11. 11G_011_PARTIAL_BUILD_BLOCK
12. 11G_012_RECEIPTLESS_SUCCESS
13. 11G_013_HAPPY_PATH_SANDBOX

## Rules

- Fixture skeletons do not equal self-test results.
- expected.json does not equal observed.json.
- No fixture may write to live COMMAND_CENTER.
- No fixture may write to live assistant state.
- No fixture may claim pass before execution.
- No self-test report may be created by fixture materialization.

## DoesNotProve

- This README does not run tests.
- Fixture files do not prove harness safety.
- Fixture files do not authorize self-test execution.
- Fixture files do not authorize live L0.
- Happy path fixture definition does not prove happy path pass.

## NextLegalAction

After materialization, review the self-test runner and then run the full suite only after template freeze and code review gates pass.
```

`COMMAND_CENTER_MATERIALIZATION_MUST_CLOSE_WITH_HASH_LEDGER_AND_RECEIPT_V0_1`

`USER ACCEPTANCE = SEPARATE.`

`Implementation receipt does not prove code review pass.`

`Implementation receipt does not prove template freeze pass.`

`Implementation receipt does not prove live L0 creation.`

`Implementation receipt does not activate MVP.`

## 11S.14 Hash Pass Completeness Rules

Hash pass is complete only when:

`every file planned in implementation manifest has either created row, exists-match row, or blocked row`

`every created file has SHA256`

`every exists-match file has pre and post SHA256`

`every blocked file has blocker reason`

`hash ledger row count matches planned file target count`

`no planned file is invisible`

`no unplanned file is created`

`no file outside build-harness lane is created`

Failure labels:

`HASH_PASS_PLANNED_FILE_INVISIBLE`

`HASH_PASS_UNPLANNED_FILE_CREATED`

`HASH_PASS_ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH`

`HASH_PASS_BLOCKED_FILE_NO_REASON`

`HASH_PASS_EXISTING_MATCH_NO_PRE_POST_HASH`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11U — Source Package Writer Script Draft / Manifest-Driven File Creator / Still No Live L0 Run

Batch 11T defined the actual file-creation packet. Batch 11U defines the first writer script draft that can materialize the build-harness source package.

Important correction bridge before the script:

The source package may include header-only template files named `IMPLEMENTATION_HASH_LEDGER.csv`, `IMPLEMENTATION_RECEIPT.md`, and `IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT.md`, but actual run evidence must be written as run-id suffixed files in the receipt lane. Otherwise the writer would have to overwrite its own source-package templates during the same run, which violates the no-overwrite rule.

So 11U locks this distinction:

`SOURCE TEMPLATE FILES LIVE UNDER BUILD_HARNESS.`
`RUN EVIDENCE LIVES UNDER BUILD_RECEIPTS WITH RUN ID.`

This preserves 11S. It does not drop those files. It separates template artifacts from proof artifacts.

Core rule:

`WRITER CREATES SOURCE PACKAGE FILES ONLY.`
`WRITER DOES NOT RUN THE HARNESS.`
`WRITER DOES NOT RUN SELFTEST.`
`WRITER DOES NOT FREEZE TEMPLATES.`
`WRITER DOES NOT WRITE REVIEW PASS.`
`WRITER DOES NOT TOUCH LIVE COMMAND_CENTER.`

`COMMAND_CENTER_SOURCE_PACKAGE_WRITER_MUST_BE_MANIFEST_AND_BODY_BUNDLE_DRIVEN_V0_1`

`writer writes live command center`

`writer runs newly created scripts`

`writer overwrites different existing files`

`writer claims code review passed`

`writer claims self-tests passed`

`writer claims templates are frozen`

```json
  "Status": "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_NOT_EXECUTED",

  "SourceDesign": "OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2 / Batches 11N-11S",
  "DoesNotProve": [

    "Source body bundle does not prove code review.",

```

`SOURCE_WRITER_SOURCE_BATCH_MISMATCH`

`SOURCE_WRITER_BODY_BLANK`

JSONL empty templates may intentionally decode to empty content.

## 11U.5 Exact Writer Script Draft

```powershell
<#
SCRIPT PURPOSE:
Create the Command Center build-harness source package from an implementation manifest
and source body bundle.

SCRIPT STATUS:
SCRIPT_DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED

SCRIPT DOES NOT:
create live command-center files, create live assistant state, execute created scripts,
run tests, freeze templates, perform code review, approve live L0, dispatch actors,
install watchers, install automation, modify git history, clean project files, or perform
broad mutation.

MUTATION BOUNDARY:
Create missing source-package files only under the approved BUILD_HARNESS target lane.
Write run evidence only under the approved BUILD_RECEIPTS receipt lane.

FAILURE POLICY:
Fail closed. Block existing different files. Do not overwrite. Do not auto-clean partial work.
Return a blocker receipt when possible.

DOES_NOT_PROVE:
This writer does not prove script safety.
This writer does not prove runtime behavior beyond its own receipt.
This writer does not prove template freeze.
This writer does not prove code review.
This writer does not prove self-test pass.
This writer does not authorize live L0.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateSet("PLAN_ONLY", "PREFLIGHT_ONLY", "CREATE_SOURCE_PACKAGE", "VERIFY_SOURCE_PACKAGE")]
    [string]$Mode,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$WorkingLane,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$TargetLane,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ReceiptLane,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ImplementationManifestPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$SourceBodyBundlePath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$PacketId,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$RunId = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Planned = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:HashRows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:FoldersCreated = 0
$script:FoldersMatched = 0
$script:FilesCreated = 0
$script:FilesSkippedMatch = 0
$script:FilesBlocked = 0
$script:StopConditions = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$script:BlockedTarget = ""
$script:BlockedReason = ""
$script:FailureLabel = ""

function Get-UtcNow {
    return (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o")
}

function New-RunId {
    $stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ")
    return "CC_SOURCE_PACKAGE_WRITE_$stamp"
}

function Resolve-FullPathStrict {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_BLANK_PATH"
    }

    if ($Path -match "\.\.") {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_PATH_TRAVERSAL_RISK: $Path"
    }

    $blocked = @("PASTE_THE_COPIED_PATH_HERE", "TODO_PATH", "CHANGE_ME", "<PATH>", "[PATH]", "C:\path\to")
    foreach ($b in $blocked) {
        if ($Path -like "*$b*") {
            throw "SOURCE_WRITER_PLACEHOLDER_PATH: $Path"
        }
    }

    return [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
}

function Test-InsidePath {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Child,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Parent
    )

    $c = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Child).TrimEnd('\')
    $p = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Parent).TrimEnd('\')

    if ($c.Equals($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $true
    }

    return $c.StartsWith($p + "\", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Get-Sha256ForText {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Text)

    $encoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    $bytes = $encoding.GetBytes($Text)
    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    try {
        $hashBytes = $sha.ComputeHash($bytes)
        return ([BitConverter]::ToString($hashBytes)).Replace("-", "")
    }
    finally {
        $sha.Dispose()
    }
}

function Get-Sha256ForFile {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_HASH_FILE_MISSING: $Path"
    }

    return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [AllowNull()][string]$Text
    )

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    $encoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, $encoding)
}

function ConvertTo-CsvCell {
    param([AllowNull()][object]$Value)

    if ($null -eq $Value) {
        return ""
    }

    $text = [string]$Value
    $escaped = $text.Replace('"', '""')
    $needsQuotes = $escaped.Contains(",") -or $escaped.Contains('"') -or $escaped.Contains("`n") -or $escaped.Contains("`r")

    if ($needsQuotes) {
        return '"' + $escaped + '"'
    }

    return $escaped
}

function New-CsvLine {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]]$Values)

    $cells = foreach ($v in $Values) {
        ConvertTo-CsvCell -Value $v
    }

    return ($cells -join ",")
}

function Add-Stop {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$FailureLabel,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Target,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Reason
    )

    $script:FailureLabel = $FailureLabel
    $script:BlockedTarget = $Target
    $script:BlockedReason = $Reason
    $script:StopConditions.Add("$FailureLabel :: $Target :: $Reason")
}

function Decode-Base64Utf8 {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Base64Text)

    if ($null -eq $Base64Text) {
        return ""
    }

    if ($Base64Text.Length -eq 0) {
        return ""
    }

    try {
        $bytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String($Base64Text)
        return [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)
    }
    catch {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_BODY_BASE64_INVALID"
    }
}

function Read-SourceBodyBundle {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_MISSING"
    }

    $json = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
    $bundle = $json | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ($bundle.SchemaName -ne "COMMAND_CENTER_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE") {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_INVALID"
    }

    if ($null -eq $bundle.Bodies) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_EMPTY"
    }

    $map = @{}
    foreach ($b in $bundle.Bodies) {
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($b.TargetId)) {
            throw "SOURCE_WRITER_BODY_TARGET_ID_MISSING"
        }

        if ($map.ContainsKey($b.TargetId)) {
            throw "SOURCE_WRITER_BODY_DUPLICATE_TARGET_ID: $($b.TargetId)"
        }

        $map[$b.TargetId] = $b
    }

    return $map
}

function Test-MarkdownMarkers {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Content,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId
    )

    $markers = @("Status:", "SchemaName:", "SchemaVersion: V0_1", "Role:", "OwnerLayer:", "ActivationLevel:", "MutationAuthorized:")

    foreach ($m in $markers) {
        if (-not $Content.Contains($m)) {
            return "BLOCKED_MARKER_MISSING:$m"
        }
    }

    if ((-not $Content.Contains("DoesNotProve")) -and (-not $Content.Contains("Does Not Prove"))) {
        return "BLOCKED_DNP_MISSING"
    }

    if ((-not $Content.Contains("NextLegalAction")) -and (-not $Content.Contains("Next Legal Action"))) {
        return "BLOCKED_NEXT_LEGAL_ACTION_MISSING"
    }

    return "PASS"
}

function Test-JsonBody {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Content,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId
    )

    try {
        $obj = $Content | ConvertFrom-Json
    }
    catch {
        return "BLOCKED_JSON_INVALID"
    }

    if ($null -eq $obj.SchemaName) {
        return "BLOCKED_SCHEMA_MISSING"
    }

    if ($null -eq $obj.DoesNotProve) {
        return "BLOCKED_DNP_MISSING"
    }

    if ($null -eq $obj.NextLegalAction) {
        return "BLOCKED_NEXT_LEGAL_ACTION_MISSING"
    }

    if ($obj.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains "MutationAuthorized") {
        if ($obj.MutationAuthorized -eq $true) {
            return "BLOCKED_MUTATION_TRUE"
        }
    }

    return "PASS"
}

function Test-CsvBody {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Content,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId
    )

    $normalized = $Content.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")
    $lines = @($normalized.Split("`n") | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 })

    if ($lines.Count -ne 1) {
        return "BLOCKED_CSV_NOT_HEADER_ONLY"
    }

    return "PASS"
}

function Test-JsonlBody {
    param(
        [AllowNull()][string]$Content,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId
    )

    if ($null -eq $Content) {
        return "PASS"
    }

    if ($Content.Length -ne 0) {
        return "BLOCKED_JSONL_NOT_EMPTY"
    }

    return "PASS"
}

function Test-PowerShellBoundary {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Content,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId
    )

    $markers = @("SCRIPT PURPOSE:", "SCRIPT STATUS:", "SCRIPT DOES NOT:", "DOES_NOT_PROVE")

    foreach ($m in $markers) {
        if (-not $Content.Contains($m)) {
            return "BLOCKED_SCRIPT_BOUNDARY_MISSING:$m"
        }
    }

    return "PASS"
}

function Test-FalseClaims {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Content,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId
    )

    $blocked = @(
        "code review passed",
        "templates frozen",
        "self-test passed",
        "selftest passed",
        "live L0 created",
        "MVP active",
        "Status: INSTALLED",
        "Status: OPERATIONAL",
        "Status: LIVE_READY",
        "Status: SAFE",
        "Status: DONE"
    )

    foreach ($b in $blocked) {
        if ($Content.IndexOf($b, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
            return "BLOCKED_FALSE_CLAIM:$b"
        }
    }

    return "PASS"
}

function Get-MarkerVerdict {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ArtifactKind,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [AllowNull()][string]$Content,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId
    )

    if ($null -eq $Content) {
        $Content = ""
    }

    $falseClaim = Test-FalseClaims -Content $Content -TargetId $TargetId
    if ($falseClaim -ne "PASS") {
        return $falseClaim
    }

    $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($Path).ToLowerInvariant()

    if ($ext -eq ".md") {
        return Test-MarkdownMarkers -Content $Content -TargetId $TargetId
    }

    if ($ext -eq ".json") {
        return Test-JsonBody -Content $Content -TargetId $TargetId
    }

    if ($ext -eq ".csv") {
        return Test-CsvBody -Content $Content -TargetId $TargetId
    }

    if ($ext -eq ".jsonl") {
        return Test-JsonlBody -Content $Content -TargetId $TargetId
    }

    if ($ext -eq ".ps1") {
        return Test-PowerShellBoundary -Content $Content -TargetId $TargetId
    }

    return "PASS"
}

function Read-ImplementationManifest {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST_MISSING"
    }

    $rows = Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path
    if ($null -eq $rows -or @($rows).Count -eq 0) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST_EMPTY"
    }

    return @($rows)
}

function Build-Plan {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]]$ManifestRows,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$BodyMap,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ResolvedWorkingLane,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ResolvedTargetLane
    )

    foreach ($row in $ManifestRows) {
        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($row.TargetId)) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_MANIFEST_TARGET_ID_MISSING" -Target "" -Reason "TargetId missing"
            return
        }

        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($row.TargetPath)) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_MANIFEST_TARGET_PATH_MISSING" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason "TargetPath missing"
            return
        }

        if ($row.LiveLaneTouchAllowed -ne "false") {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_LIVE_TOUCH_ALLOWED" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason "LiveLaneTouchAllowed must be false"
            return
        }

        if ($row.MayOverwrite -ne "false") {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_OVERWRITE_TRUE" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason "MayOverwrite must be false"
            return
        }

        if (-not $BodyMap.ContainsKey($row.TargetId)) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_BODY_MISSING" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason "No source body bundle entry"
            return
        }

        $body = $BodyMap[$row.TargetId]

        if ($body.TargetPath -ne $row.TargetPath) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_BODY_TARGET_MISMATCH" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason "Body target path differs from manifest"
            return
        }

        if ($body.SourceBatch -ne $row.SourceBatch) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_SOURCE_BATCH_MISMATCH" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason "Body source batch differs from manifest"
            return
        }

        $absoluteTarget = Resolve-FullPathStrict -Path (Join-Path $ResolvedWorkingLane $row.TargetPath)

        if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $absoluteTarget -Parent $ResolvedTargetLane)) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_TARGET_OUTSIDE_BUILD_HARNESS" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason $absoluteTarget
            return
        }

        if ($absoluteTarget -like "*\COMMAND_CENTER\*") {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_LIVE_COMMAND_CENTER_TARGET" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason $absoluteTarget
            return
        }

        if ($absoluteTarget -like "*\_LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS\ASSISTANT_COMMAND_CENTER_STATE\ACTIVE_OBJECT.json") {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_LIVE_STATE_TARGET" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason $absoluteTarget
            return
        }

        $content = Decode-Base64Utf8 -Base64Text $body.ContentUtf8Base64

        if ($content.Length -eq 0 -and ($absoluteTarget.ToLowerInvariant().EndsWith(".jsonl") -eq $false)) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_BODY_BLANK" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason "Non-jsonl body decoded blank"
            return
        }

        $marker = Get-MarkerVerdict -ArtifactKind $row.ArtifactKind -Path $absoluteTarget -Content $content -TargetId $row.TargetId
        if ($marker -ne "PASS") {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_MARKER_BLOCK" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason $marker
            return
        }

        $expectedHash = Get-Sha256ForText -Text $content
        $exists = [System.IO.File]::Exists($absoluteTarget)
        $preHash = ""

        if ($exists) {
            $preHash = Get-Sha256ForFile -Path $absoluteTarget
            if ($preHash -ne $expectedHash) {
                Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_EXISTING_DIFF_BLOCK" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason $absoluteTarget
                return
            }
        }

        if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($absoluteTarget)) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_PATH_TYPE_CONFLICT" -Target $row.TargetId -Reason $absoluteTarget
            return
        }

        $script:Planned.Add([pscustomobject]@{
            TargetId = $row.TargetId
            TargetPath = $row.TargetPath
            AbsolutePath = $absoluteTarget
            ArtifactKind = $row.ArtifactKind
            SourceBatch = $row.SourceBatch
            Content = $content
            ExpectedSHA256 = $expectedHash
            PreExisting = $exists
            PreSHA256 = $preHash
            MarkerVerdict = $marker
        })
    }
}

function Ensure-ParentFolder {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    $parent = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($Path)
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($parent)) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_PARENT_FOLDER_MISSING"
    }

    if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($parent)) {
        $script:FoldersMatched++
        return
    }

    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($parent) | Out-Null
    $script:FoldersCreated++
}

function Add-HashRow {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Plan,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$CreatedOrMatched,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$PostSHA256
    )

    $script:HashRows.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        ImplementationRunId = $script:RunId
        TargetId = $Plan.TargetId
        TargetPath = $Plan.TargetPath
        ArtifactKind = $Plan.ArtifactKind
        SourceBatch = $Plan.SourceBatch
        Bytes = ([System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)).GetBytes($Plan.Content).Length
        SHA256 = $PostSHA256
        CreatedOrMatched = $CreatedOrMatched
        PreExisting = $Plan.PreExisting
        PreSHA256 = $Plan.PreSHA256
        PostSHA256 = $PostSHA256
        MarkerVerdict = $Plan.MarkerVerdict
        PathBoundaryVerdict = "PASS_BUILD_HARNESS_ONLY"
        LiveTouchVerdict = "NO_LIVE_TOUCH"
        ReceiptVerdict = "PENDING_RECEIPT"
        DoesNotProve = "Hash row does not prove code review, template freeze, self-test, live L0, or MVP activation."
    })
}

function Create-SourcePackage {
    foreach ($p in $script:Planned) {
        Ensure-ParentFolder -Path $p.AbsolutePath

        if ($p.PreExisting -eq $true) {
            $script:FilesSkippedMatch++
            Add-HashRow -Plan $p -CreatedOrMatched "EXISTS_MATCH_SKIPPED" -PostSHA256 $p.PreSHA256
            continue
        }

        Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $p.AbsolutePath -Text $p.Content
        $script:FilesCreated++

        $postHash = Get-Sha256ForFile -Path $p.AbsolutePath
        if ($postHash -ne $p.ExpectedSHA256) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_POST_HASH_MISMATCH" -Target $p.TargetId -Reason $p.AbsolutePath
            return
        }

        Add-HashRow -Plan $p -CreatedOrMatched "CREATED" -PostSHA256 $postHash
    }
}

function Write-HashLedger {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ReceiptRoot)

    $path = Join-Path $ReceiptRoot ("IMPLEMENTATION_HASH_LEDGER_" + $script:RunId + ".csv")

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("ImplementationRunId,TargetId,TargetPath,ArtifactKind,SourceBatch,Bytes,SHA256,CreatedOrMatched,PreExisting,PreSHA256,PostSHA256,MarkerVerdict,PathBoundaryVerdict,LiveTouchVerdict,ReceiptVerdict,DoesNotProve")

    foreach ($r in $script:HashRows) {
        $lines.Add((New-CsvLine @(
            $r.ImplementationRunId,
            $r.TargetId,
            $r.TargetPath,
            $r.ArtifactKind,
            $r.SourceBatch,
            $r.Bytes,
            $r.SHA256,
            $r.CreatedOrMatched,
            $r.PreExisting,
            $r.PreSHA256,
            $r.PostSHA256,
            $r.MarkerVerdict,
            $r.PathBoundaryVerdict,
            $r.LiveTouchVerdict,
            $r.ReceiptVerdict,
            $r.DoesNotProve
        )))
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $path -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    return $path
}

function Write-ImplementationReceipt {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ReceiptRoot,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$HashLedgerPath,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$FinalVerdict
    )

    $path = Join-Path $ReceiptRoot ("IMPLEMENTATION_RECEIPT_" + $script:RunId + ".md")

    $text = @"
# IMPLEMENTATION RECEIPT / COMMAND CENTER BUILD-HARNESS SOURCE PACKAGE

Status: $FinalVerdict
SchemaName: IMPLEMENTATION_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: MATERIALIZATION_RETURN_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

ImplementationPacketId: $PacketId
ImplementationRunId: $($script:RunId)
CreatedUtc: $($script:StartedUtc)
FinishedUtc: $(Get-UtcNow)
WorkingLane: $($script:ResolvedWorkingLane)
BuildHarnessLane: $($script:ResolvedTargetLane)
ReceiptLane: $($script:ResolvedReceiptLane)

FilesPlanned: $($script:Planned.Count)
FilesCreated: $($script:FilesCreated)
FilesSkippedMatch: $($script:FilesSkippedMatch)
FilesBlocked: $($script:FilesBlocked)
FoldersCreated: $($script:FoldersCreated)
FoldersMatched: $($script:FoldersMatched)
ExistingDiffs: 0
HashesRecorded: $($script:HashRows.Count)

HashLedger: $HashLedgerPath
TargetManifest: $($script:ResolvedManifest)

LiveCommandCenterTouched: false
LiveStateTouched: false
HarnessExecuted: false
SelfTestExecuted: false
TemplateFreezeExecuted: false
CodeReviewExecuted: false
LiveL0Executed: false
ActorDispatched: false
WatcherInstalled: false
AutomationInstalled: false
Deleted: false
Moved: false
Archived: false
Compressed: false
RestoredInPlace: false
Committed: false
Pushed: false

StopConditionsHit: $($script:StopConditions.Count)
OpenBlockers:

FinalVerdict: $FinalVerdict

DoesNotProve:
- This receipt does not prove code review pass.
- This receipt does not prove template freeze.
- This receipt does not prove self-test pass.
- This receipt does not prove live L0 creation.
- This receipt does not authorize actor dispatch, watcher, automation, cleanup, deletion, move, archive, restore, commit, or push.
- This receipt must still be judged.

NextLegalAction:
Judge implementation receipt, then request code review for exact script hashes.
"@

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $path -Text $text
    return $path
}

function Write-BlockerReceipt {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ReceiptRoot)

    $path = Join-Path $ReceiptRoot ("IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_" + $script:RunId + ".md")

    $text = @"
# IMPLEMENTATION BLOCKER RECEIPT / COMMAND CENTER BUILD-HARNESS SOURCE PACKAGE

Status: IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED
SchemaName: IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

ImplementationPacketId: $PacketId
ImplementationRunId: $($script:RunId)
BlockedUtc: $(Get-UtcNow)
WorkingLane: $($script:ResolvedWorkingLane)
BuildHarnessLane: $($script:ResolvedTargetLane)
ReceiptLane: $($script:ResolvedReceiptLane)

BlockedStep: SOURCE_PACKAGE_WRITE
BlockedTarget: $($script:BlockedTarget)
BlockedReason: $($script:BlockedReason)
FailureLabel: $($script:FailureLabel)

FilesCreatedBeforeBlock: $($script:FilesCreated)
FoldersCreatedBeforeBlock: $($script:FoldersCreated)
HashRowsBeforeBlock: $($script:HashRows.Count)

LiveCommandCenterTouched: false
LiveStateTouched: false
HarnessExecuted: false
SelfTestExecuted: false
TemplateFreezeExecuted: false
CodeReviewExecuted: false
LiveL0Executed: false
ActorDispatched: false
WatcherInstalled: false
AutomationInstalled: false
Deleted: false
Moved: false
Archived: false
Compressed: false
RestoredInPlace: false
Committed: false
Pushed: false

DoesNotProve:
- This blocker receipt does not fix the blocker.
- Partial materialization does not prove source-package readiness.
- No self-test, template freeze, code review pass, or live L0 may proceed from a blocked implementation.

NextLegalAction:
Judge blocker receipt, then create repair packet or controlled retry packet. Do not rerun blindly.
"@

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $path -Text $text
    return $path
}

function Invoke-Main {
    $script:StartedUtc = Get-UtcNow
    $script:RunId = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-RunId } else { $RunId }

    $script:ResolvedWorkingLane = Resolve-FullPathStrict -Path $WorkingLane
    $script:ResolvedTargetLane = Resolve-FullPathStrict -Path $TargetLane
    $script:ResolvedReceiptLane = Resolve-FullPathStrict -Path $ReceiptLane
    $script:ResolvedManifest = Resolve-FullPathStrict -Path $ImplementationManifestPath
    $script:ResolvedBundle = Resolve-FullPathStrict -Path $SourceBodyBundlePath

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $script:ResolvedTargetLane -Parent $script:ResolvedWorkingLane)) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_TARGET_LANE_OUTSIDE_WORKING_LANE"
    }

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $script:ResolvedReceiptLane -Parent $script:ResolvedWorkingLane)) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_RECEIPT_LANE_OUTSIDE_WORKING_LANE"
    }

    if (-not ($script:ResolvedTargetLane.EndsWith("\HOUSE_WORK\PROJECT_COMMAND_CENTER_UI_LANE\BUILD_HARNESS", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or
              $script:ResolvedTargetLane.EndsWith("\HOUSE_WORK\PROJECT_COMMAND_CENTER_UI_LANE\BUILD_HARNESS\", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase))) {
        throw "SOURCE_WRITER_TARGET_LANE_NOT_BUILD_HARNESS"
    }

    if (-not [System.IO.Directory]::Exists($script:ResolvedReceiptLane)) {
        [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedReceiptLane) | Out-Null
    }

    $rows = Read-ImplementationManifest -Path $script:ResolvedManifest
    $bodyMap = Read-SourceBodyBundle -Path $script:ResolvedBundle

    Build-Plan `
        -ManifestRows $rows `
        -BodyMap $bodyMap `
        -ResolvedWorkingLane $script:ResolvedWorkingLane `
        -ResolvedTargetLane $script:ResolvedTargetLane

    if ($script:StopConditions.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-BlockerReceipt -ReceiptRoot $script:ResolvedReceiptLane | Out-Null
        Write-Output "STATUS: IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED"
        Write-Output "FAILURE_LABEL: $($script:FailureLabel)"
        Write-Output "BLOCKED_TARGET: $($script:BlockedTarget)"
        exit 20
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "PLAN_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PLAN_ONLY_NO_FILES_CREATED"
        Write-Output "RUN_ID: $($script:RunId)"
        Write-Output "PLANNED_FILES: $($script:Planned.Count)"
        Write-Output "NEXT: PREFLIGHT_ONLY"
        exit 0
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "PREFLIGHT_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PREFLIGHT_PASS_NO_FILES_CREATED"
        Write-Output "RUN_ID: $($script:RunId)"
        Write-Output "PLANNED_FILES: $($script:Planned.Count)"
        Write-Output "NEXT: CREATE_SOURCE_PACKAGE"
        exit 0
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "CREATE_SOURCE_PACKAGE") {
        Create-SourcePackage

        if ($script:StopConditions.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-BlockerReceipt -ReceiptRoot $script:ResolvedReceiptLane | Out-Null
            Write-Output "STATUS: IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED_PARTIAL_RECEIPTED"
            Write-Output "FAILURE_LABEL: $($script:FailureLabel)"
            exit 21
        }

        $ledger = Write-HashLedger -ReceiptRoot $script:ResolvedReceiptLane
        $receipt = Write-ImplementationReceipt `
            -ReceiptRoot $script:ResolvedReceiptLane `
            -HashLedgerPath $ledger `
            -FinalVerdict "IMPLEMENTATION_MATERIALIZED_BUILD_HARNESS_PACKAGE_PENDING_REVIEW"

        Write-Output "STATUS: IMPLEMENTATION_MATERIALIZED_BUILD_HARNESS_PACKAGE_PENDING_REVIEW"
        Write-Output "RUN_ID: $($script:RunId)"
        Write-Output "HASH_LEDGER: $ledger"
        Write-Output "RECEIPT: $receipt"
        Write-Output "NEXT: JUDGE_IMPLEMENTATION_RECEIPT"
        exit 0
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "VERIFY_SOURCE_PACKAGE") {
        foreach ($p in $script:Planned) {
            if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($p.AbsolutePath)) {
                Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_VERIFY_FILE_MISSING" -Target $p.TargetId -Reason $p.AbsolutePath
                break
            }

            $actual = Get-Sha256ForFile -Path $p.AbsolutePath
            if ($actual -ne $p.ExpectedSHA256) {
                Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_VERIFY_HASH_MISMATCH" -Target $p.TargetId -Reason $p.AbsolutePath
                break
            }
        }

        if ($script:StopConditions.Count -gt 0) {
            Write-BlockerReceipt -ReceiptRoot $script:ResolvedReceiptLane | Out-Null
            Write-Output "STATUS: VERIFY_BLOCKED"
            Write-Output "FAILURE_LABEL: $($script:FailureLabel)"
            exit 22
        }

        Write-Output "STATUS: VERIFY_SOURCE_PACKAGE_PASS_PENDING_RECEIPT_JUDGMENT"
        Write-Output "RUN_ID: $($script:RunId)"
        Write-Output "NEXT: JUDGE_IMPLEMENTATION_RECEIPT"
        exit 0
    }

    throw "SOURCE_WRITER_UNREACHABLE_MODE"
}

try {
    Invoke-Main
}
catch {
    try {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($script:ResolvedReceiptLane)) {
            Add-Stop -FailureLabel "SOURCE_WRITER_EXCEPTION_BLOCK" -Target "" -Reason $_.Exception.Message
            Write-BlockerReceipt -ReceiptRoot $script:ResolvedReceiptLane | Out-Null
        }
    }
    catch {
    }

    Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    exit 30
}
```

`BATCH 11U DEFINES THE SOURCE PACKAGE WRITER SCRIPT DRAFT. THE WRITER IS MANIFEST-DRIVEN AND SOURCE-BODY-BUNDLE-DRIVEN. IT CREATES ONLY MISSING BUILD-HARNESS SOURCE FILES, SKIPS EXACT MATCHES, BLOCKS EXISTING DIFFERENT FILES, HASHES CREATED/MATCHED FILES, AND WRITES RUN-ID RECEIPTS TO THE RECEIPT LANE. IT DOES NOT EMBED THE FULL SOURCE BODIES; THAT IS 11V. IT DOES NOT RUN THE L0 HARNESS, DOES NOT RUN SELFTEST, DOES NOT FREEZE TEMPLATES, DOES NOT CLAIM CODE REVIEW, DOES NOT CREATE LIVE COMMAND_CENTER, DOES NOT TOUCH LIVE STATE, DOES NOT DISPATCH ACTORS, DOES NOT INSTALL WATCHERS OR AUTOMATION, AND DOES NOT CLAIM INSTALLATION.`

Next: **Batch 11V — Source Body Bundle Pack / Exact Body Map / Base64-Safe File Content Carrier**.







Soft suit carry: one active object, one proof pointer, one next condition.

Proof pointer: `11U writer requires SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE__COMMAND_CENTER_BUILD_HARNESS_SOURCE_PACKAGE_V0_1.json and refuses to invent file bodies.`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11V — Source Body Bundle Pack / Exact Body Map / Base64-Safe File Content Carrier

Batch 11U drafted the manifest-driven writer. Batch 11V defines the source-body bundle that feeds that writer.

This bundle is the content carrier. It is not a script. It does not create files. It does not run the writer. It does not prove the body files exist. It does not approve live L0.

Core rule:

`THE WRITER MAY NOT INVENT CONTENT.`
`THE WRITER MAY NOT PULL CONTENT FROM MEMORY.`
`THE WRITER MAY ONLY WRITE TARGETS WHOSE BODY IS IN THE SOURCE BODY BUNDLE.`
`THE SOURCE BODY BUNDLE CARRIES EXACT FILE CONTENT, NOT SUMMARIES.`

Important boundary:

Do not paste giant base64 blobs into the working spec by hand. The exact body text remains owned by 11N–11S. The bundle pack defines the required JSON carrier and the exact body map. The actual base64 values must be produced mechanically from the locked literal bodies, then hashed and validated. Manual base64 transcription is a corruption risk, not preservation.

Carry line:

`11V DEFINES THE SOURCE BODY BUNDLE AS THE FILE-CONTENT CARRIER FOR THE BUILD-HARNESS SOURCE PACKAGE. EVERY TARGET ID MUST MAP TO ONE EXACT BODY, ONE SOURCE BATCH, ONE TARGET PATH, ONE ARTIFACT KIND, ONE EXPECTED TEXT SHA256, AND ONE BASE64 UTF-8 CONTENT FIELD. BLANK BODY IS ALLOWED ONLY FOR EMPTY JSONL TEMPLATES.`

---

`COMMAND_CENTER_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SOURCE_WRITER_RUN_V0_1`

`writer writes an unplanned body`

`writer inserts fake review/freeze/selftest receipts`

Rules:

`TargetId` must match implementation manifest.

`MayBeBlank=true` only for intentionally empty JSONL templates.

`DoesNotProve` cannot be empty.

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11W — Source Body Bundle Generator Script Draft / Encode Locked Bodies / Validate Bundle / No File Creation

Batch 11V defined the source-body bundle. Batch 11W defines the generator script that creates that bundle.

Parent leak found before the script:

If the source-body bundle generator reads the final build-harness target files, the chain becomes circular. The writer needs the bundle to create the files, but the generator would need the files to create the bundle.

So 11W locks the corrected route:

`LOCKED SOURCE BODIES -> STAGING CARRIER -> SOURCE BODY BUNDLE -> SOURCE WRITER -> BUILD-HARNESS SOURCE FILES`

The generator reads from a staging carrier, not from the final target package. It writes only the bundle, validation ledger, body map report, and blocker receipt. It does not create the actual source-package target files.

Core rule:

`GENERATOR CREATES CONTENT BUNDLE ONLY.`
`GENERATOR DOES NOT CREATE TARGET SOURCE PACKAGE FILES.`
`GENERATOR DOES NOT RUN WRITER.`
`GENERATOR DOES NOT RUN HARNESS.`
`GENERATOR DOES NOT FREEZE, REVIEW, SELFTEST, OR APPROVE LIVE L0.`

---

## 11W.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_MUST_USE_STAGING_CARRIER_NOT_TARGET_FILES_V0_1`

`The source-body bundle generator may only read locked body text from an approved staging carrier, validate it against the implementation manifest and source body map ledger, encode it as UTF-8 base64, calculate body hashes, and write bundle/report/validation outputs. It may not create final build-harness source package files, may not use missing target files as input, and may not infer content from memory.`

This blocks:

`generator reads final target package before target package exists`

`generator invents missing body text`

`generator fills blank body for non-JSONL`

`generator uses summaries as content`

`generator writes build-harness target files directly`

`generator runs source writer after bundle creation`

`generator treats valid bundle as code review pass`
