## 11W.6 Generator Script Draft

```powershell
<#
SCRIPT PURPOSE:
Generate the Command Center source-body bundle from locked source-body staging files.

SCRIPT STATUS:
SCRIPT_DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED

SCRIPT DOES NOT:
create final build-harness source-package target files, run the source writer,
run the L0 harness, run self-tests, freeze templates, perform code review,
approve live L0, create live COMMAND_CENTER files, create live assistant state,
dispatch actors, install watcher, install automation, delete, move, archive,
restore, commit, or push.

MUTATION BOUNDARY:
Write source-body bundle outputs only under the approved source_body_bundle output root.
Optionally copy the validated bundle JSON to the approved build-harness lane.

FAILURE POLICY:
Fail closed. If manifest, body map, staging file, hash, marker, path, JSON, CSV,
JSONL, PowerShell boundary, or false-claim validation fails, write blocker receipt
where possible and do not produce a validated bundle.

DOES_NOT_PROVE:
This generator does not create source package files.
This generator does not prove code review.
This generator does not prove template freeze.
This generator does not prove self-test pass.
This generator does not authorize live L0.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateSet("PLAN_ONLY", "PREFLIGHT_ONLY", "GENERATE_BUNDLE", "VALIDATE_BUNDLE")]
    [string]$Mode,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$WorkingLane,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$BuildHarnessLane,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$StagingRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ImplementationManifestPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$SourceBodyMapLedgerPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$OutputRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$BundleId,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$RunId = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Findings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:Bodies = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:StartedUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o")

function New-RunId {
    return "CC_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_" + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ")
}

function Get-FullPathStrict {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) {
        throw "SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_BLANK_PATH"
    }

    if ($Path -match "\.\.") {
        throw "SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_PATH_TRAVERSAL_RISK: $Path"
    }

    $blocked = @("PASTE_THE_COPIED_PATH_HERE", "TODO_PATH", "CHANGE_ME", "<PATH>", "[PATH]", "C:\path\to")
    foreach ($b in $blocked) {
        if ($Path -like "*$b*") {
            throw "SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_PLACEHOLDER_PATH: $Path"
        }
    }

    return [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
}

function Test-Inside {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Child,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Parent
    )

    $c = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Child).TrimEnd('\')
    $p = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Parent).TrimEnd('\')

    if ($c.Equals($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $true
    }

    return $c.StartsWith($p + "\", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [AllowNull()][string]$Text
    )

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    $encoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, $encoding)
}

function Get-TextSha256 {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    $encoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    $bytes = $encoding.GetBytes($Text)
    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    try {
        return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($bytes))).Replace("-", "")
    }
    finally {
        $sha.Dispose()
    }
}

function Get-ByteCount {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    return ([System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)).GetBytes($Text).Length
}

function Get-LineCount {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text -or $Text.Length -eq 0) {
        return 0
    }

    $normalized = $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")
    return $normalized.Split("`n").Count
}

function To-Base64Utf8 {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    $bytes = ([System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)).GetBytes($Text)
    return [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
}

function CsvCell {
    param([AllowNull()][object]$Value)

    if ($null -eq $Value) {
        return ""
    }

    $text = [string]$Value
    $escaped = $text.Replace('"', '""')
    $needs = $escaped.Contains(",") -or $escaped.Contains('"') -or $escaped.Contains("`n") -or $escaped.Contains("`r")

    if ($needs) {
        return '"' + $escaped + '"'
    }

    return $escaped
}

function CsvLine {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]]$Values)

    $cells = foreach ($v in $Values) {
        CsvCell -Value $v
    }

    return ($cells -join ",")
}

function Add-Finding {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$ValidationType,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Expected,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Observed,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][bool]$Pass,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$FailureLabel,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][bool]$BlocksWriter,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)][string]$NextLegalAction = ""
    )

    $script:Findings.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        ValidationId = "V" + ($script:Findings.Count + 1).ToString("0000")
        TargetId = $TargetId
        ValidationType = $ValidationType
        Expected = $Expected
        Observed = $Observed
        Pass = $Pass
        FailureLabel = $FailureLabel
        BlocksWriter = $BlocksWriter
        DoesNotProve = "Validation row does not create files or approve live L0."
        NextLegalAction = $NextLegalAction
    })
}

function Test-FalseClaims {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$TargetId,
        [AllowNull()][string]$Text
    )

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    $lines = $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n").Split("`n")

    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        $trim = $line.Trim()

        if ($trim -match "^Status:\s*(INSTALLED|OPERATIONAL|LIVE_READY|SAFE|DONE|SELFTESTED|REVIEWED|FROZEN|MVP_ACTIVE)\s*$") {
            Add-Finding $TargetId "FALSE_CLAIM_ABSENT" "No false status claim" $trim $false "SOURCE_BODY_FALSE_SAFE_DONE_CLAIM" $true "Repair body status."
            return $false
        }

        $affirmativePatterns = @(
            "code review passed",
            "templates frozen",
            "freeze pass",
            "self-test passed",
            "selftest passed",
            "harness tested",
            "live approved",
            "live L0 created",
            "MVP active"
        )

        foreach ($p in $affirmativePatterns) {
            if ($trim.IndexOf($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
                if ($trim.IndexOf("does not prove", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or
                    $trim.IndexOf("does not authorize", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or
                    $trim.IndexOf("not ", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
                    continue
                }

                Add-Finding $TargetId "FALSE_CLAIM_ABSENT" "No affirmative false claim" $trim $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_FALSE_CLAIM" $true "Repair body claim."
                return $false
            }
        }
    }

    Add-Finding $TargetId "FALSE_CLAIM_ABSENT" "No false claim" "No false claim detected" $true "" $false ""
    return $true
}

function Test-MarkdownBody {
    param([string]$TargetId, [string]$Text)

    $required = @("Status:", "SchemaName:", "SchemaVersion: V0_1", "Role:", "OwnerLayer:")
    foreach ($m in $required) {
        if (-not $Text.Contains($m)) {
            Add-Finding $TargetId "REQUIRED_MARKERS_PRESENT" $m "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Restore marker."
            return $false
        }
    }

    if ((-not $Text.Contains("DoesNotProve")) -and (-not $Text.Contains("Does Not Prove"))) {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "DNP_PRESENT" "DNP marker" "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Restore DNP."
        return $false
    }

    if ((-not $Text.Contains("NextLegalAction")) -and (-not $Text.Contains("Next Legal Action"))) {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "NEXT_LEGAL_ACTION_PRESENT" "NextLegalAction marker" "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Restore next legal action."
        return $false
    }

    Add-Finding $TargetId "REQUIRED_MARKERS_PRESENT" "markdown markers" "present" $true "" $false ""
    return $true
}

function Test-JsonBody {
    param([string]$TargetId, [string]$Text)

    try {
        $obj = $Text | ConvertFrom-Json
    }
    catch {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "JSON_PARSE" "valid JSON" $_.Exception.Message $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Repair JSON."
        return $false
    }

    if ($null -eq $obj.SchemaName) {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "REQUIRED_MARKERS_PRESENT" "SchemaName" "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Restore SchemaName."
        return $false
    }

    if ($null -eq $obj.DoesNotProve -and $TargetId -ne "I062") {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "DNP_PRESENT" "DoesNotProve" "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Restore DoesNotProve."
        return $false
    }

    Add-Finding $TargetId "JSON_PARSE" "valid JSON" "valid" $true "" $false ""
    return $true
}

function Test-CsvBody {
    param([string]$TargetId, [string]$Text)

    $normalized = $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")
    $lines = @($normalized.Split("`n") | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 0 })

    if ($lines.Count -lt 1) {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "CSV_HEADER_ONLY" "one header row" "blank" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Restore header."
        return $false
    }

    if ($lines.Count -gt 1 -and $TargetId -ge "I080") {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "CSV_HEADER_ONLY" "one header row only" "$($lines.Count) rows" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Remove fake rows."
        return $false
    }

    Add-Finding $TargetId "CSV_HEADER_ONLY" "header rule" "pass" $true "" $false ""
    return $true
}

function Test-PowerShellBody {
    param([string]$TargetId, [string]$Text)

    $required = @("SCRIPT PURPOSE:", "SCRIPT STATUS:", "SCRIPT DOES NOT:", "DOES_NOT_PROVE")
    foreach ($m in $required) {
        if (-not $Text.Contains($m)) {
            Add-Finding $TargetId "POWERSHELL_BOUNDARY_PRESENT" $m "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" $true "Restore PowerShell boundary."
            return $false
        }
    }

    Add-Finding $TargetId "POWERSHELL_BOUNDARY_PRESENT" "PowerShell boundary markers" "present" $true "" $false ""
    return $true
}

function Test-BodyByKind {
    param(
        [string]$TargetId,
        [string]$TargetPath,
        [string]$ArtifactKind,
        [string]$Text,
        [bool]$MayBeBlank
    )

    if ($Text.Length -eq 0) {
        if ($MayBeBlank -and $TargetPath.ToLowerInvariant().EndsWith(".jsonl")) {
            Add-Finding $TargetId "BODY_NOT_BLANK" "blank allowed only JSONL" "blank JSONL allowed" $true "" $false ""
            return $true
        }

        Add-Finding $TargetId "BODY_NOT_BLANK" "nonblank body" "blank" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BLANK_NOT_ALLOWED" $true "Restore body."
        return $false
    }

    if ($TargetPath.ToLowerInvariant().EndsWith(".jsonl")) {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "JSONL_EMPTY" "empty JSONL" "nonblank" $false "SOURCE_BODY_JSONL_NOT_BLANK" $true "Empty JSONL body."
        return $false
    }

    $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($TargetPath).ToLowerInvariant()
    if ($ext -eq ".md") { return (Test-MarkdownBody $TargetId $Text) }
    if ($ext -eq ".json") { return (Test-JsonBody $TargetId $Text) }
    if ($ext -eq ".csv") { return (Test-CsvBody $TargetId $Text) }
    if ($ext -eq ".ps1") { return (Test-PowerShellBody $TargetId $Text) }

    Add-Finding $TargetId "REQUIRED_MARKERS_PRESENT" "known extension validation" "not applicable" $true "" $false ""
    return $true
}

function Read-ManifestRows {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_MANIFEST_MISSING"
    }

    return @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)
}

function Read-BodyMapRows {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "SOURCE_BODY_MAP_LEDGER_MISSING"
    }

    return @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)
}

function Build-BodyBundle {
    param(
        [object[]]$ManifestRows,
        [object[]]$MapRows,
        [string]$StagingRootResolved
    )

    $manifestById = @{}
    foreach ($m in $ManifestRows) {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($m.TargetId)) {
            $manifestById[$m.TargetId] = $m
        }
    }

    foreach ($map in $MapRows) {
        $targetId = $map.TargetId

        if (-not $manifestById.ContainsKey($targetId)) {
            Add-Finding $targetId "MANIFEST_ROW_EXISTS" "manifest row exists" "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_EXTRA_BODY" $true "Remove extra body map row."
            continue
        }

        $manifest = $manifestById[$targetId]

        if ($manifest.TargetPath -ne $map.TargetPath) {
            Add-Finding $targetId "TARGET_PATH_MATCH" $manifest.TargetPath $map.TargetPath $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_PATH_MISMATCH" $true "Repair body map target path."
            continue
        }

        if ($manifest.ArtifactKind -ne $map.ArtifactKind) {
            Add-Finding $targetId "ARTIFACT_KIND_MATCH" $manifest.ArtifactKind $map.ArtifactKind $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BODY_ROW_INVALID" $true "Repair artifact kind."
            continue
        }

        if ($manifest.SourceBatch -ne $map.SourceBatch) {
            Add-Finding $targetId "SOURCE_BATCH_MATCH" $manifest.SourceBatch $map.SourceBatch $false "SOURCE_WRITER_SOURCE_BATCH_MISMATCH" $true "Repair source batch."
            continue
        }

        $stagingPath = Join-Path $StagingRootResolved ($targetId + ".body")
        if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($stagingPath)) {
            Add-Finding $targetId "BODY_ROW_EXISTS" "staging file exists" "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MISSING_BODY" $true "Create staging body file."
            continue
        }

        $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($stagingPath)
        $mayBeBlank = ([string]$map.MayBeBlank).ToLowerInvariant() -eq "true"

        $validByKind = Test-BodyByKind -TargetId $targetId -TargetPath $map.TargetPath -ArtifactKind $map.ArtifactKind -Text $text -MayBeBlank $mayBeBlank
        $claimsOk = Test-FalseClaims -TargetId $targetId -Text $text

        if (-not $validByKind -or -not $claimsOk) {
            continue
        }

        $hash = Get-TextSha256 -Text $text
        $bytes = Get-ByteCount -Text $text
        $lines = Get-LineCount -Text $text
        $base64 = To-Base64Utf8 -Text $text

        Add-Finding $targetId "EXPECTED_HASH_MATCH" "computed hash recorded" $hash $true "" $false ""

        $requiredMarkers = @()
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($map.RequiredMarkers)) {
            $requiredMarkers = @($map.RequiredMarkers -split "\|")
        }

        $script:Bodies.Add([pscustomobject]@{
            TargetId = $targetId
            TargetPath = $map.TargetPath
            ArtifactKind = $map.ArtifactKind
            SourceBatch = $map.SourceBatch
            SourceObject = $map.SourceObject
            ContentRole = $map.ContentRole
            BodyEncoding = "UTF8_BASE64"
            ContentUtf8Base64 = $base64
            ExpectedTextSHA256 = $hash
            ExpectedByteCount = $bytes
            ExpectedLineCount = $lines
            MayBeBlank = $mayBeBlank
            RequiredMarkers = $requiredMarkers
            DoesNotProve = @(
                "Body entry does not create files.",
                "Body entry does not prove code review, template freeze, self-test, live L0, or MVP activation."
            )
        })
    }

    foreach ($m in $ManifestRows) {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($m.TargetId)) {
            $found = $false
            foreach ($map in $MapRows) {
                if ($map.TargetId -eq $m.TargetId) {
                    $found = $true
                    break
                }
            }

            if (-not $found) {
                Add-Finding $m.TargetId "BODY_ROW_EXISTS" "body map row exists" "missing" $false "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MISSING_BODY" $true "Add body map row."
            }
        }
    }
}

function Write-ValidationLedger {
    param([string]$OutputRootResolved, [string]$RunIdValue)

    $path = Join-Path $OutputRootResolved ("SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_VALIDATION_LEDGER_" + $RunIdValue + ".csv")
    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("ValidationId,TargetId,ValidationType,Expected,Observed,Pass,FailureLabel,BlocksWriter,DoesNotProve,NextLegalAction")

    foreach ($f in $script:Findings) {
        $lines.Add((CsvLine @(
            $f.ValidationId,
            $f.TargetId,
            $f.ValidationType,
            $f.Expected,
            $f.Observed,
            $f.Pass,
            $f.FailureLabel,
            $f.BlocksWriter,
            $f.DoesNotProve,
            $f.NextLegalAction
        )))
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $path -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
    return $path
}

function Write-BundleJson {
    param([string]$OutputRootResolved, [string]$RunIdValue, [string]$ManifestPathResolved)

    $bundle = [ordered]@{
        SchemaName = "COMMAND_CENTER_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE"
        SchemaVersion = "V0_1"
        Status = "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_NOT_EXECUTED"
        BundleId = $BundleId
        CreatedUtc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o")
        SourceDesign = "OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2 / Batches 11N-11S"
        Encoding = "UTF8_BASE64"
        LineEndingPolicy = "STAGING_BODY_EXACT_RECORDED"
        BlankBodyPolicy = "ONLY_JSONL_EMPTY_TEMPLATES"
        BodyCountExpected = $script:Bodies.Count
        BodyCountObserved = $script:Bodies.Count
        ManifestPath = $ManifestPathResolved
        DoesNotProve = @(
            "Source body bundle does not create files.",
            "Source body bundle does not prove code review.",
            "Source body bundle does not prove template freeze.",
            "Source body bundle does not prove self-test pass.",
            "Source body bundle does not authorize live L0."
        )
        Bodies = @($script:Bodies)
    }

    $json = $bundle | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12
    $path = Join-Path $OutputRootResolved ($BundleId + ".json")
    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $path -Text $json
    return $path
}

function Write-Report {
    param(
        [string]$OutputRootResolved,
        [string]$RunIdValue,
        [string]$BundlePath,
        [string]$ValidationLedger,
        [string]$FinalVerdict
    )

    $blocking = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.BlocksWriter -eq $true })
    $missing = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.FailureLabel -eq "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MISSING_BODY" }).Count
    $pathMismatch = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.FailureLabel -eq "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_PATH_MISMATCH" }).Count
    $marker = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.FailureLabel -eq "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_MARKER_FAILURE" }).Count
    $falseClaim = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.FailureLabel -eq "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_FALSE_CLAIM" }).Count

    $text = @"
# SOURCE BODY BUNDLE REPORT

Status: $FinalVerdict
BundleId: $BundleId
CreatedUtc: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o"))

ManifestPath: $($script:ResolvedManifest)
BodyBundlePath: $BundlePath
BodyMapLedger: $($script:ResolvedBodyMap)
ValidationLedger: $ValidationLedger

BodyRowsObserved: $($script:Bodies.Count)
BlockingFindings: $($blocking.Count)
MissingBodies: $missing
PathMismatches: $pathMismatch
MarkerFailures: $marker
FalseClaimFailures: $falseClaim

FinalVerdict: $FinalVerdict

DoesNotProve:
- This report does not create files.
- This report does not prove code review.
- This report does not prove template freeze.
- This report does not prove self-test pass.
- This report does not authorize live L0.

NextLegalAction:
If validated, use the bundle only as input to the source package writer.
"@

    $path = Join-Path $OutputRootResolved ("SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_REPORT_" + $RunIdValue + ".md")
    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $path -Text $text
    return $path
}

function Write-BlockerReceipt {
    param(
        [string]$OutputRootResolved,
        [string]$RunIdValue,
        [string]$ValidationLedger
    )

    $first = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.BlocksWriter -eq $true } | Select-Object -First 1)
    $target = ""
    $failure = "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_EFFECT"
    $validation = ""

    if ($first.Count -gt 0) {
        $target = $first[0].TargetId
        $failure = $first[0].FailureLabel
        $validation = $first[0].ValidationType
    }

    $text = @"
# SOURCE BODY BUNDLE BLOCKER RECEIPT

Status: SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED
BlockerId: SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKER_$RunIdValue
BlockedUtc: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o"))
BundleId: $BundleId
BlockedTargetId: $target
BlockedValidation: $validation
FailureLabel: $failure
ValidationLedger: $ValidationLedger
FilesChanged: bundle outputs only
WriterRunAttempted: false

DoesNotProve:
- This blocker receipt does not fix the bundle.
- No source writer may run from a blocked body bundle.
- Partial bundle validation does not prove body integrity.

NextLegalAction:
Repair source body staging, body map, or manifest, then rerun full validation.
"@

    $path = Join-Path $OutputRootResolved ("SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_" + $RunIdValue + ".md")
    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $path -Text $text
    return $path
}

function Invoke-Main {
    $rid = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-RunId } else { $RunId }

    $script:ResolvedWorking = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $WorkingLane
    $script:ResolvedHarness = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $BuildHarnessLane
    $script:ResolvedStaging = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $StagingRoot
    $script:ResolvedManifest = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $ImplementationManifestPath
    $script:ResolvedBodyMap = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $SourceBodyMapLedgerPath
    $script:ResolvedOutput = Get-FullPathStrict -Path $OutputRoot

    if (-not (Test-Inside -Child $script:ResolvedHarness -Parent $script:ResolvedWorking)) {
        throw "SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_HARNESS_OUTSIDE_WORKING_LANE"
    }

    if (-not (Test-Inside -Child $script:ResolvedStaging -Parent $script:ResolvedHarness)) {
        throw "SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_STAGING_OUTSIDE_HARNESS"
    }

    if (-not (Test-Inside -Child $script:ResolvedOutput -Parent $script:ResolvedHarness)) {
        throw "SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_OUTPUT_OUTSIDE_HARNESS"
    }

    if ($script:ResolvedOutput -like "*\COMMAND_CENTER\*") {
        throw "SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_OUTPUT_LIVE_COMMAND_CENTER"
    }

    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedOutput) | Out-Null

    $manifestRows = Read-ManifestRows -Path $script:ResolvedManifest
    $bodyMapRows = Read-BodyMapRows -Path $script:ResolvedBodyMap

    if ($Mode -eq "PLAN_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PLAN_ONLY_NO_BUNDLE_CREATED"
        Write-Output "MANIFEST_ROWS: $($manifestRows.Count)"
        Write-Output "BODY_MAP_ROWS: $($bodyMapRows.Count)"
        Write-Output "NEXT: PREFLIGHT_ONLY"
        exit 0
    }

    Build-BodyBundle -ManifestRows $manifestRows -MapRows $bodyMapRows -StagingRootResolved $script:ResolvedStaging

    $ledger = Write-ValidationLedger -OutputRootResolved $script:ResolvedOutput -RunIdValue $rid
    $blocking = @($script:Findings | Where-Object { $_.BlocksWriter -eq $true })

    if ($blocking.Count -gt 0) {
        $blocker = Write-BlockerReceipt -OutputRootResolved $script:ResolvedOutput -RunIdValue $rid -ValidationLedger $ledger
        $report = Write-Report -OutputRootResolved $script:ResolvedOutput -RunIdValue $rid -BundlePath "" -ValidationLedger $ledger -FinalVerdict "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_EFFECT"

        Write-Output "STATUS: SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_BLOCKED"
        Write-Output "VALIDATION_LEDGER: $ledger"
        Write-Output "BLOCKER_RECEIPT: $blocker"
        Write-Output "REPORT: $report"
        exit 20
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "PREFLIGHT_ONLY") {
        $report = Write-Report -OutputRootResolved $script:ResolvedOutput -RunIdValue $rid -BundlePath "" -ValidationLedger $ledger -FinalVerdict "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_PREFLIGHT_PASS_NO_BUNDLE_CREATED"
        Write-Output "STATUS: SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_PREFLIGHT_PASS_NO_BUNDLE_CREATED"
        Write-Output "VALIDATION_LEDGER: $ledger"
        Write-Output "REPORT: $report"
        Write-Output "NEXT: GENERATE_BUNDLE"
        exit 0
    }

    $bundlePath = Write-BundleJson -OutputRootResolved $script:ResolvedOutput -RunIdValue $rid -ManifestPathResolved $script:ResolvedManifest
    $finalVerdict = "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_GENERATED_PENDING_VALIDATION"

    if ($Mode -eq "VALIDATE_BUNDLE") {
        $finalVerdict = "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_VALIDATED_FOR_WRITER_INPUT"
    }

    $reportPath = Write-Report -OutputRootResolved $script:ResolvedOutput -RunIdValue $rid -BundlePath $bundlePath -ValidationLedger $ledger -FinalVerdict $finalVerdict

    Write-Output "STATUS: $finalVerdict"
    Write-Output "RUN_ID: $rid"
    Write-Output "BUNDLE: $bundlePath"
    Write-Output "VALIDATION_LEDGER: $ledger"
    Write-Output "REPORT: $reportPath"
    Write-Output "NEXT: SOURCE_WRITER_PREFLIGHT_ONLY"
    exit 0
}

try {
    Invoke-Main
}
catch {
    Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    exit 30
}
```

---

## 11W.7 Known Draft Limits

Known limits are explicit:

`SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_FILES_NOT_YET_DEFINED_AS_LITERAL_PACKET`

`SOURCE_BODY_MAP_LEDGER_FULL_BODY_ROWS_EXIST_IN_11V_BUT NOT YET MATERIALIZED`

`IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST_FULL_SINGLE_FILE_NOT YET MATERIALIZED`

`GENERATOR_SCRIPT_NOT_CODE_REVIEWED`

`GENERATOR_SCRIPT_NOT_SELFTESTED`

`NO BUNDLE GENERATED IN CHAT`

These are not failures in 11W. They define the next layer.

Hard line:

`11W DEFINES THE GENERATOR. 11X MUST DEFINE THE STAGING PACKET THAT FEEDS IT.`

---

## 11W.8 Generator Validation Rules

The generator draft is acceptable only if:

`script status says SCRIPT_DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED`

`script requires explicit WorkingLane`

`script requires explicit BuildHarnessLane`

`script requires explicit StagingRoot`

`script requires explicit ImplementationManifestPath`

`script requires explicit SourceBodyMapLedgerPath`

`script requires explicit OutputRoot`

`script writes only bundle outputs`

`script does not create final target source files`

`script does not run writer`

`script does not run harness`

`script does not run self-test`

`script blocks output outside build-harness`

`script validates manifest/body map match`

`script validates staging body existence`

`script validates blank policy`

`script validates body hashes`

`script validates markers`

`script validates false claims`

`script writes blocker receipt on validation block`

Failure labels:

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_DRAFT_STATUS_MISSING`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_INFERRED_PATH`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_STAGING_NOT_REQUIRED`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_BODY_MAP_NOT_REQUIRED`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_WRITES_TARGET_FILES`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_RUNS_WRITER`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_RUNS_HARNESS`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_RUNS_SELFTEST`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_OUTPUT_OUTSIDE_HARNESS`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_VALIDATION_GAP`

`SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATOR_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_GAP`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11X — Source Body Staging Pack / Literal Body Extraction Ledger / Generator Input Carrier / No Writer Run

Batch 11W defined the source-body bundle generator. Batch 11X defines the staging pack that feeds that generator.

This is the missing middle layer:

`locked batch text -> staging .body files -> source body bundle -> source writer -> build-harness source package`

The staging pack is not the final build-harness package. It is the decoded content carrier used to create the base64 bundle. It exists so the generator does not invent content, scrape from memory, or read target files that do not exist yet.

Core rule:

`STAGING BODY FILES ARE INPUT CARRIER FILES.`
`STAGING BODY FILES ARE NOT FINAL PACKAGE FILES.`
`STAGING BODY FILES DO NOT PROVE WRITER EXECUTION.`
`STAGING BODY FILES DO NOT PROVE CODE REVIEW, FREEZE, SELFTEST, OR LIVE L0.`

---

`COMMAND_CENTER_SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_REQUIRED_BEFORE_BUNDLE_GENERATION_V0_1`

The staging pack may not create final source-package targets and may not be treated as writer output.`

`MVP active`

not:

Batch 11X-D now stages the ledger/template body family: activation ledgers, trace ledgers, routing/custody ledgers, receipt/human review ledgers, byte/root/UI ledgers, schema/semantic ledgers, gate/health/retention ledgers, and test/certification ledgers.

These are staging bodies only. They are not live ledgers. They are not evidence rows. They are not receipts. They are not proof that a test, route, receipt, health check, retention action, or certification happened.

Core rule:

`CSV STAGING BODY != LEDGER EVIDENCE.`
`CSV HEADER != ROW PROOF.`
`EMPTY JSONL != NO EVENTS HAPPENED.`
`NO FAKE ROWS IN HEADER-ONLY TEMPLATES.`
`NO RUNTIME PROOF INSIDE STAGING HEADERS.`

---

## 11X-D.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_CSV_JSONL_BODIES_MUST_BE_STAGED_BEFORE_SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATION_V0_1`

Wording:

`The CSV header bodies I080-I089 and I091-I115, plus empty JSONL bodies I090 and I095, must be extracted into exact TargetId.body staging files before source-body bundle generation. CSV bodies must preserve header-only template status unless explicitly designed otherwise, and JSONL bodies must remain empty. No staged CSV or JSONL body may contain fake evidence rows, runtime receipts, test pass rows, actor events, handoff events, health pass findings, retention actions, certification claims, live state, code review pass, template freeze pass, self-test pass, live L0, or MVP activation.`

This blocks:

`CSV header template becomes fake ledger`

`JSONL empty template gains invented events`

`receipt index contains accepted receipt row`

`test run ledger contains fake pass`

`certification ledger claims certification`

`retention action ledger authorizes cleanup`

`root intake queue claims root clear`

`semantic registry claims enforcement`

`schema registry claims compatibility proved`

## 11X-D.5 Literal Body Assembly Contract

For CSV/JSONL staging, “literal” means:

`copy the exact CSV header line from 11P.21 into the matching TargetId.body`

or for JSONL:

`create an intentionally empty body file for I090 and I095`

not:

`add sample rows`

not:

`add fake receipts`

not:

`add fake test runs`

not:

`add fake health findings`

not:

`add fake root intake detections`

not:

`add fake semantic registry rows`

not:

`add fake retention actions`

not:

`add comments under the CSV header`

not:

`write "empty" into JSONL`

not:

`use same as above`

Allowed extraction methods:

`PASTED_LOCKED_BODY_VERBATIM`

`SCRIPT_EXTRACT_FROM_LOCKED_MARKDOWN`

`INTENTIONALLY_EMPTY_JSONL_BODY`

Blocked extraction methods:

`FROM_MEMORY`

`FROM_SUMMARY`

`FROM_FILENAME`

`FROM_TEMPLATE_GUESS`

`FROM_LIVE_LEDGER`

`FROM_FINAL_TARGET_FILE`

Failure labels:

`CSV_JSONL_BODY_FROM_MEMORY`

`CSV_JSONL_BODY_FROM_SUMMARY`

`CSV_JSONL_BODY_FROM_FILENAME`

`CSV_JSONL_BODY_FROM_TEMPLATE_GUESS`

`CSV_JSONL_BODY_FROM_LIVE_LEDGER`

`CSV_JSONL_BODY_FROM_FINAL_TARGET_FILE`

## 11X-D.6 Body File Cards

CSV family cards use this exact card shape:

```text
TargetId: <I080-I115 except I090/I095>
BodyFile: <TargetId>.body
FinalTargetPath: HOUSE_WORK\PROJECT_COMMAND_CENTER_UI_LANE\BUILD_HARNESS\templates\<TemplateName>.csv
SourceBatch: 11P
SourceSection: 11P.21
ExpectedValidation: CSV_HEADER_ONLY_PASS
MayBeBlank: false
RequiredMarkers: <required header fields from staging index>
DoesNotProve: CSV header body does not prove runtime evidence exists.
```

JSONL cards:

```text
TargetId: I090
BodyFile: I090.body
FinalTargetPath: HOUSE_WORK\PROJECT_COMMAND_CENTER_UI_LANE\BUILD_HARNESS\templates\T_HANDOFF_TRACE.jsonl
SourceBatch: 11P
SourceSection: 11P.21
ExpectedValidation: JSONL_EMPTY_PASS
MayBeBlank: true
RequiredMarkers: EMPTY_JSONL
DoesNotProve: Empty handoff trace staging body does not prove no handoffs occurred.

TargetId: I095
BodyFile: I095.body
FinalTargetPath: HOUSE_WORK\PROJECT_COMMAND_CENTER_UI_LANE\BUILD_HARNESS\templates\T_UI_EVENT_LOG.jsonl
SourceBatch: 11P
SourceSection: 11P.21
ExpectedValidation: JSONL_EMPTY_PASS
MayBeBlank: true
RequiredMarkers: EMPTY_JSONL
DoesNotProve: Empty UI event log staging body does not prove no UI events occurred.
```

Hard rule:

`I090.body and I095.body must contain zero bytes or an explicitly approved empty-text representation that hashes as empty decoded content. They must not contain [], {}, null, EMPTY, or comments.`

Failure labels:

`CSV_JSONL_JSONL_HAS_TEXT`

`CSV_JSONL_JSONL_FAKE_EMPTY_TOKEN`

## 11X-D.7 CSV Validation Rules

Every CSV staged body except `I090` and `I095` must:

`contain exactly one nonblank line`

`parse as CSV header`

`contain no data rows`

`contain no comments`

`contain no quoted fake row`

`contain no runtime receipt`

`contain no pass verdict row`

`contain no active actor row`

`contain no cleanup action row`

`contain no root-intake detected file row`

`contain no health finding row`

`contain no certification row`

`include DoesNotProve where required by the header map`

`include NextLegalAction where required by the header map`

`CSV_STAGING_NOT_HEADER_ONLY`

`CSV_STAGING_FAKE_DATA_ROW`

`CSV_STAGING_COMMENT_ROW`

`CSV_STAGING_FAKE_RECEIPT_ROW`

`CSV_STAGING_FAKE_PASS_VERDICT`

`CSV_STAGING_FAKE_ACTOR_ROW`

`CSV_STAGING_FAKE_CLEANUP_ACTION`

`CSV_STAGING_FAKE_ROOT_INTAKE_ROW`

`CSV_STAGING_FAKE_HEALTH_FINDING`

`CSV_STAGING_FAKE_CERTIFICATION`

`CSV_STAGING_DNP_COLUMN_MISSING`

`CSV_STAGING_NEXT_LEGAL_ACTION_COLUMN_MISSING`

`MayBeBlank must be true`

`ExpectedValidation must be JSONL_EMPTY_PASS`

`no events`

`no brackets`

`no empty object`

`no null`

`no comment`

`no newline required`

`requirements satisfied`

`route decided`

`receipt accepted`

`human review clear`

`no handoffs`

`gate active`

`no findings`

`retention action complete`

`test passed`

`coverage complete`

`certified`

`code review passed`

`templates frozen`

`self-test passed`

`live L0 created`

`MVP active`

`safe`

`done`

`does not prove`

`header does not prove`

## 11X-E.5 Literal Body Assembly Contract

For script/review staging, “literal” means:

`copy the exact script or support-body content from the owning batch`

not:

`replace script with pseudocode`

not:

`replace script with a safer-looking stub`

not:

`repair the script during staging`

not:

`drop functions to shorten it`

not:

`copy only the header`

not:

`copy only forbidden-command names without DNP`

not:

`fill review checklist as completed`

not:

`write validator output`

not:

`claim scan pass`

not:

`use same as above`

Allowed extraction methods:

`PASTED_LOCKED_BODY_VERBATIM`

`SCRIPT_EXTRACT_FROM_LOCKED_MARKDOWN`

Blocked extraction methods:

`FROM_MEMORY`

`FROM_SUMMARY`

`FROM_FILENAME`

`FROM_TEMPLATE_GUESS`

`FROM_FINAL_TARGET_FILE`

`FROM_EXECUTED_SCRIPT_OUTPUT`

## 11X-E.7 Script Body Validation Rules

For `I120` and `I121`, staged script bodies must include:

`SCRIPT PURPOSE:`

`SCRIPT STATUS:`

`SCRIPT DOES NOT:`

`MUTATION BOUNDARY:` or equivalent boundary section

`FAILURE POLICY:`

`DOES_NOT_PROVE`

`Set-StrictMode`

`$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"`

The staged script bodies must not claim:

`SCRIPT REVIEWED`

`CODE_REVIEW_PASS`

`SELFTEST_PASS`

`TEMPLATE_FREEZE_PASS`

`LIVE_APPROVED`

`LIVE_READY`

`INSTALLED`

`OPERATIONAL`

`SAFE`

`DONE`

For `I120`, the harness draft may contain code that creates future L0 files only when later reviewed and used by its own gate. Staging does not authorize that use.

For `I121`, the static validator draft may scan and write candidate findings only when later executed under its gate. Staging does not authorize that execution.

`SCRIPT_STAGING_BOUNDARY_MISSING`

`SCRIPT_STAGING_STATUS_FALSE_REVIEWED`

`SCRIPT_STAGING_FALSE_CODE_REVIEW_PASS`

`SCRIPT_STAGING_FALSE_SELFTEST_PASS`

`SCRIPT_STAGING_FALSE_FREEZE_PASS`

`SCRIPT_STAGING_FALSE_LIVE_APPROVAL`

`SCRIPT_STAGING_ERROR_POLICY_MISSING`

## 11X-F.5 Literal Body Assembly Contract

For fixture staging, “literal” means:

`copy the exact fixture manifest from 11R.5`

`copy the exact fixture README from 11R.6`

`copy each exact expected.json body from 11R.7 through 11R.19`

not:

`write observed results`

not:

`mark a fixture passed`

not:

`change expected labels after the fact`

not:

`remove failure-label alternatives`

not:

`remove DoesNotProve`

not:

`convert expected.json into self-test report`

not:

`make happy path a pass receipt`

not:

`insert actual runtime timestamps`

not:

`use same as above`

Allowed extraction methods:

`PASTED_LOCKED_BODY_VERBATIM`

`SCRIPT_EXTRACT_FROM_LOCKED_MARKDOWN`

Blocked extraction methods:

`FROM_MEMORY`

`FROM_SUMMARY`

`FROM_FILENAME`

`FROM_TEMPLATE_GUESS`

`FROM_SELFTEST_OUTPUT`

`FROM_OBSERVED_RESULT`

`FROM_FINAL_TARGET_FILE`

## 11X-G.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_RECEIPT_CLOSEOUT_BODIES_MUST_BE_STAGED_BEFORE_SOURCE_BUNDLE_GENERATION_V0_1`

`Receipt, hash-ledger, blocker, closeout, and file-creation-request bodies I150-I154 must be extracted into exact TargetId.body staging files before source-body bundle generation. `blocker receipt template treated as real blocker`

`receipt body generated from memory`

`receipt body copied from future run evidence`

## 11Y.7 Materialization Modes

Allowed modes:

`PLAN_ONLY`

`PREFLIGHT_ONLY`

`CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS`

`VERIFY_STAGING_INPUTS`

`RECEIPT_ONLY`

Blocked modes:

`GENERATE_BUNDLE`

`VALIDATE_BUNDLE`

`CREATE_SOURCE_PACKAGE`

`RUN_SOURCE_WRITER`

`RUN_HARNESS`

`RUN_STATIC_VALIDATOR`

`RUN_SELFTEST`

`MOVE`

`ARCHIVE`

`RESTORE`

`COMMIT`

`PUSH`

Failure label:

`STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_FORBIDDEN_MODE`

Mode meanings:

`PLAN_ONLY` lists intended files and counts. It writes nothing.

`PREFLIGHT_ONLY` checks source availability, target boundary, blocked path absence, and exact TargetId count. It writes only preflight report if allowed.

`CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS` creates staging-control files and `.body` files under staging root only.

`VERIFY_STAGING_INPUTS` checks created staging files, hashes, counts, blank policy, and forbidden path mutation.

`RECEIPT_ONLY` writes a receipt for the staging materialization result but does not create new body files.

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11Z — Staging Materializer Script Draft / Manifest-Driven Source Body Staging Creator / No Bundle Generation

Batch 11Y defined the staging materialization packet. Batch 11Z defines the script draft that would carry out that packet.

Parent leak first:

A staging materializer cannot invent the exact body text. It also cannot read final build-harness target files, because those are not created yet. Therefore the staging materializer needs a separate bootstrap input carrier.

Correct chain:

`locked batch bodies -> staging body input bundle -> staging materializer -> source_body_staging/*.body -> staging rollup -> source-body bundle generator -> source-body bundle -> source writer`

This is not circular. The bootstrap input bundle is not the final source-body bundle. It is only a temporary body-input carrier used to create decoded `.body` staging files.

Core rule:

`STAGING MATERIALIZER WRITES ONLY SOURCE_BODY_STAGING FILES.`
`STAGING MATERIALIZER DOES NOT GENERATE SOURCE BODY BUNDLE.`
`STAGING MATERIALIZER DOES NOT WRITE FINAL BUILD-HARNESS SOURCE PACKAGE FILES.`
`STAGING MATERIALIZER DOES NOT RUN WRITER, HARNESS, VALIDATOR, OR SELFTEST.`
`STAGING MATERIALIZER MAY NOT INVENT, SUMMARIZE, OR REPAIR BODY CONTENT.`

## 11Z.5 Script Draft

```powershell
<#
SCRIPT PURPOSE:
Materialize Command Center source-body staging inputs from an approved staging materialization manifest
and exact bootstrap body input bundle.

SCRIPT STATUS:
SCRIPT_DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED

SCRIPT DOES NOT:
generate the source body bundle, create final build-harness source package files, run the source writer,
run the L0 harness, run static validator, run self-test, freeze templates, perform code review,
approve live L0, create live COMMAND_CENTER files, create live assistant state, dispatch actors,
install watcher, install automation, delete, move, archive, restore, commit, or push.

MUTATION BOUNDARY:
May write only approved files under BUILD_HARNESS\source_body_staging\ and run receipts/hash ledgers
under the approved receipt root.

FAILURE POLICY:
Fail closed. Existing different files block. No overwrite, no backup, no move-aside, no merge, no append.

DOES_NOT_PROVE:
This script does not generate the source body bundle.
This script does not create final source package files.
This script does not prove code review.
This script does not prove template freeze.
This script does not prove self-test pass.
This script does not authorize live L0.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateSet("PLAN_ONLY", "PREFLIGHT_ONLY", "CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS", "VERIFY_STAGING_INPUTS", "RECEIPT_ONLY")]
    [string]$Mode,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$WorkingLane,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$BuildHarnessLane,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$StagingRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ReceiptRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$StagingMaterializationManifestPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$BootstrapBodyInputBundlePath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$PacketId,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$RunId = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Findings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:HashRows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:Created = 0
$script:Matched = 0
$script:Blocked = 0

function New-RunId {
    return "CC_STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_" + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ")
}

function Resolve-FullPathStrict {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) {
        throw "STAGING_MATERIALIZER_BLANK_PATH"
    }

    if ($Path -match "\.\.") {
        throw "STAGING_MATERIALIZER_PATH_TRAVERSAL_RISK: $Path"
    }

    $placeholders = @("PASTE_THE_COPIED_PATH_HERE", "TODO_PATH", "CHANGE_ME", "<PATH>", "[PATH]", "C:\path\to")
    foreach ($p in $placeholders) {
        if ($Path -like "*$p*") {
            throw "STAGING_MATERIALIZER_PLACEHOLDER_PATH: $Path"
        }
    }

    return [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
}

function Test-InsidePath {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Child,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Parent
    )

    $c = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Child).TrimEnd('\')
    $p = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Parent).TrimEnd('\')

    if ($c.Equals($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $true
    }

    return $c.StartsWith($p + "\", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Get-Sha256Bytes {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][byte[]]$Bytes)

    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    try {
        return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($Bytes))).Replace("-", "")
    }
    finally {
        $sha.Dispose()
    }
}

function Get-FileSha256 {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    return Get-Sha256Bytes -Bytes $bytes
}

function Get-Utf8Bytes {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text) { $Text = "" }
    return ([System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)).GetBytes($Text)
}

function Get-LineCount {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text -or $Text.Length -eq 0) {
        return 0
    }

    $normalized = $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n")
    return $normalized.Split("`n").Count
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [AllowNull()][string]$Text
    )

    if ($null -eq $Text) { $Text = "" }
    $encoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, $encoding)
}

function CsvCell {
    param([AllowNull()][object]$Value)

    if ($null -eq $Value) { return "" }
    $text = [string]$Value
    $escaped = $text.Replace('"', '""')
    if ($escaped.Contains(",") -or $escaped.Contains('"') -or $escaped.Contains("`r") -or $escaped.Contains("`n")) {
        return '"' + $escaped + '"'
    }
    return $escaped
}

function CsvLine {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]]$Values)
    return (($Values | ForEach-Object { CsvCell $_ }) -join ",")
}

function Add-Finding {
    param(
        [string]$TargetId,
        [string]$Check,
        [string]$FailureLabel,
        [string]$Observed,
        [string]$Expected,
        [bool]$Blocks
    )

    $script:Findings.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        TargetId = $TargetId
        Check = $Check
        FailureLabel = $FailureLabel
        Observed = $Observed
        Expected = $Expected
        Blocks = $Blocks
    })

    if ($Blocks) {
        $script:Blocked++
    }
}

function Decode-BodyContent {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$BodyRow
    )

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($BodyRow.ContentUtf8Base64)) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_BODY_BASE64_MISSING: $($BodyRow.TargetId)"
    }

    try {
        $bytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String([string]$BodyRow.ContentUtf8Base64)
        $text = ([System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)).GetString($bytes)
        return [pscustomobject]@{
            Text = $text
            Bytes = $bytes
            Sha256 = Get-Sha256Bytes -Bytes $bytes
            ByteCount = $bytes.Length
            LineCount = Get-LineCount -Text $text
        }
    }
    catch {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_BAD_BASE64: $($BodyRow.TargetId)"
    }
}

function Test-PlannedTargetId {
    param([string]$TargetId)

    if ($TargetId -match "^I(00[1-9]|01[0-3])$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I03[0-8]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I04[0-9]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -eq "I050") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I06[0-5]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I08[0-9]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I09[0-9]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I10[0-9]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I11[0-5]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I12[0-5]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I13[0-9]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I14[0-4]$") { return $true }
    if ($TargetId -match "^I15[0-4]$") { return $true }
    return $false
}

function Test-BlankPolicy {
    param([string]$TargetId, [string]$Text, [bool]$MayBeBlank)

    if ($Text.Length -eq 0) {
        if (($TargetId -eq "I090" -or $TargetId -eq "I095") -and $MayBeBlank) {
            return $true
        }

        Add-Finding $TargetId "BLANK_POLICY" "STAGING_BODY_BLANK_NOT_ALLOWED" "blank" "nonblank unless I090/I095" $true
        return $false
    }

    if (($TargetId -eq "I090" -or $TargetId -eq "I095") -and $Text.Length -gt 0) {
        Add-Finding $TargetId "BLANK_POLICY" "STAGING_BODY_JSONL_NOT_EMPTY" "nonblank" "empty JSONL" $true
        return $false
    }

    return $true
}

function Test-FalseClaim {
    param([string]$TargetId, [string]$Text)

    $patterns = @(
        "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_CREATED",
        "SOURCE_PACKAGE_CREATED",
        "WRITER_RAN",
        "HARNESS_RAN",
        "SELFTEST_PASS",
        "CODE_REVIEW_PASS",
        "TEMPLATE_FREEZE_PASS",
        "LIVE_L0_APPROVED",
        "MVP_ACTIVE",
        "Status: SAFE",
        "Status: DONE",
        "installed",
        "operational"
    )

    foreach ($p in $patterns) {
        if ($Text.IndexOf($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
            $boundary = (
                $Text.IndexOf("does not prove", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or
                $Text.IndexOf("does not authorize", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or
                $Text.IndexOf("not installed", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or
                $Text.IndexOf("not operational", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0
            )

            if (-not $boundary) {
                Add-Finding $TargetId "FALSE_CLAIM" "STAGING_BODY_FALSE_CLAIM_SCAN_FAIL" $p "No false execution/status claim" $true
                return $false
            }
        }
    }

    return $true
}

function Test-I120NotStub {
    param([string]$Text)

    if ($Text.Length -lt 2000) {
        Add-Finding "I120" "I120_STUB_CHECK" "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_STUB_USED" "body too short" "exact 11E harness body" $true
        return $false
    }

    $markers = @("SCRIPT PURPOSE:", "SCRIPT STATUS:", "SCRIPT DOES NOT:", "DOES_NOT_PROVE")
    foreach ($m in $markers) {
        if (-not $Text.Contains($m)) {
            Add-Finding "I120" "I120_MARKER_CHECK" "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_STUB_USED" "missing $m" "exact 11E harness body markers" $true
            return $false
        }
    }

    return $true
}

function Test-I002CompositeManifest {
    param([string]$Text)

    $required = @("I001", "I013", "I030", "I038", "I040", "I065", "I080", "I115", "I120", "I125", "I130", "I144", "I150", "I154")
    foreach ($r in $required) {
        if (-not $Text.Contains($r)) {
            Add-Finding "I002" "I002_COMPOSITE_MANIFEST" "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_EXACT_BODY_MISSING" "missing $r" "all manifest segments I001-I154" $true
            return $false
        }
    }

    return $true
}

function Read-Manifest {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_MANIFEST_MISSING"
    }

    return @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)
}

function Read-BootstrapBundle {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_MISSING"
    }

    $json = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ($json.SchemaName -ne "COMMAND_CENTER_STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_BODY_INPUT") {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID"
    }

    if ($json.BodyCountExpected -ne 101) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_COUNT_MISMATCH"
    }

    if ($null -eq $json.Bodies -or @($json.Bodies).Count -ne 101) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_COUNT_MISMATCH"
    }

    return $json
}

function New-ControlFileContent {
    param([string]$Name)

    return @"
# $Name

Status: STAGING_CONTROL_TEMPLATE_NOT_EXECUTED
SchemaName: $Name
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_CONTROL
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

DoesNotProve:
- This control file does not generate the source body bundle.
- This control file does not create final build-harness source package files.
- This control file does not run writer, harness, validator, or self-test.
- This control file does not prove review, freeze, live L0, or MVP activation.

NextLegalAction:
Use this file only inside staging rollup and generator gate.
"@
}

function Write-HashLedger {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$RunIdValue
    )

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("RunId,TargetId,OutputPath,OutputKind,FamilyId,SourceBatch,Bytes,SHA256,LineCount,CreatedOrMatched,PreExisting,PreSHA256,PostSHA256,MarkerVerdict,FalseClaimVerdict,BlankPolicyVerdict,PathBoundaryVerdict,DoesNotProve")

    foreach ($r in $script:HashRows) {
        $lines.Add((CsvLine @(
            $RunIdValue,
            $r.TargetId,
            $r.OutputPath,
            $r.OutputKind,
            $r.FamilyId,
            $r.SourceBatch,
            $r.Bytes,
            $r.SHA256,
            $r.LineCount,
            $r.CreatedOrMatched,
            $r.PreExisting,
            $r.PreSHA256,
            $r.PostSHA256,
            $r.MarkerVerdict,
            $r.FalseClaimVerdict,
            $r.BlankPolicyVerdict,
            $r.PathBoundaryVerdict,
            "Hash ledger row does not prove bundle generation, writer run, harness run, review, freeze, live L0, or MVP activation."
        )))
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
}

function Write-Receipt {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$RunIdValue,
        [string]$FinalVerdict
    )

    $text = @"
# STAGING MATERIALIZATION RECEIPT

Status: $FinalVerdict
SchemaName: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: STAGING_INPUT_CREATION_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

RunId: $RunIdValue
CreatedUtc: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o"))
PacketId: $PacketId
StagingRoot: $($script:ResolvedStagingRoot)
ReceiptRoot: $($script:ResolvedReceiptRoot)

ExpectedTargetBodyFiles: 101
ObservedTargetBodyFiles: $($script:HashRows | Where-Object { $_.OutputKind -eq "BODY_FILE" } | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count)
ExpectedControlFiles: 11
ObservedControlFiles: $($script:HashRows | Where-Object { $_.OutputKind -eq "CONTROL_FILE" } | Measure-Object | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Count)

CreatedFiles: $script:Created
MatchedFiles: $script:Matched
BlockedFiles: $script:Blocked

BundleGenerated: false
BundleGeneratorRunAttempted: false
SourceWriterRunAttempted: false
HarnessRunAttempted: false
StaticValidatorRunAttempted: false
SelfTestRunAttempted: false
TemplateFreezeAttempted: false
CodeReviewPassClaimed: false
LiveL0ApprovalAttempted: false
ActorDispatchAttempted: false
WatcherInstallAttempted: false
AutomationInstallAttempted: false

FinalVerdict: $FinalVerdict

DoesNotProve:
- This receipt does not generate the source body bundle.
- This receipt does not create final build-harness source files.
- This receipt does not run the writer.
- This receipt does not run the harness.
- This receipt does not run self-test.
- This receipt does not prove code review or template freeze.
- This receipt does not approve live L0 or MVP activation.

NextLegalAction:
Run staging rollup and generator gate. Do not generate bundle until rollup gate passes.
"@

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $text
}

function Write-BlockerReceipt {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$RunIdValue,
        [string]$FailureLabel,
        [string]$Observed,
        [string]$Expected
    )

    $text = @"
# STAGING MATERIALIZATION BLOCKER RECEIPT

Status: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED
SchemaName: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

RunId: $RunIdValue
BlockedUtc: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o"))
PacketId: $PacketId
FailureLabel: $FailureLabel
Observed: $Observed
Expected: $Expected
RollbackAttempted: false
GeneratorRunAttempted: false
WriterRunAttempted: false
HarnessRunAttempted: false
SelfTestRunAttempted: false

DoesNotProve:
- This blocker receipt does not repair staging.
- This blocker receipt does not prove source body bundle generation.
- This blocker receipt does not authorize continuing with partial staging.
- No generator may run after blocked staging materialization.

NextLegalAction:
Repair exact body source, target manifest, staging index, or boundary rule. Rerun materialization from a clean reviewed plan.
"@

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $text
}

function Add-HashRow {
    param(
        [string]$TargetId,
        [string]$OutputPath,
        [string]$OutputKind,
        [string]$FamilyId,
        [string]$SourceBatch,
        [int]$Bytes,
        [string]$Sha256,
        [int]$LineCount,
        [string]$CreatedOrMatched,
        [bool]$PreExisting,
        [string]$PreSha,
        [string]$PostSha,
        [string]$MarkerVerdict,
        [string]$FalseClaimVerdict,
        [string]$BlankPolicyVerdict,
        [string]$PathBoundaryVerdict
    )

    $script:HashRows.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        TargetId = $TargetId
        OutputPath = $OutputPath
        OutputKind = $OutputKind
        FamilyId = $FamilyId
        SourceBatch = $SourceBatch
        Bytes = $Bytes
        SHA256 = $Sha256
        LineCount = $LineCount
        CreatedOrMatched = $CreatedOrMatched
        PreExisting = $PreExisting
        PreSHA256 = $PreSha
        PostSHA256 = $PostSha
        MarkerVerdict = $MarkerVerdict
        FalseClaimVerdict = $FalseClaimVerdict
        BlankPolicyVerdict = $BlankPolicyVerdict
        PathBoundaryVerdict = $PathBoundaryVerdict
    })
}

function Create-Or-MatchTextFile {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Text,
        [string]$TargetId,
        [string]$OutputKind,
        [string]$FamilyId,
        [string]$SourceBatch
    )

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $Path -Parent $script:ResolvedStagingRoot)) {
        throw "STAGING_HASH_LEDGER_PATH_BOUNDARY_FAIL: $Path"
    }

    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes -Text $Text
    $sha = Get-Sha256Bytes -Bytes $bytes
    $preExisting = [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)
    $preSha = ""

    if ($preExisting) {
        $preSha = Get-FileSha256 -Path $Path
        if ($preSha -ne $sha) {
            throw "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_EXISTING_DIFF_BLOCK: $Path"
        }

        $script:Matched++
        $createdOrMatched = "SKIP_EXACT_MATCH"
    }
    else {
        [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($Path)) | Out-Null
        Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $Text
        $script:Created++
        $createdOrMatched = "CREATE"
    }

    $postSha = Get-FileSha256 -Path $Path
    if ($postSha -ne $sha) {
        throw "STAGING_HASH_LEDGER_HASH_MISMATCH: $Path"
    }

    Add-HashRow -TargetId $TargetId -OutputPath $Path -OutputKind $OutputKind -FamilyId $FamilyId -SourceBatch $SourceBatch -Bytes $bytes.Length -Sha256 $sha -LineCount (Get-LineCount $Text) -CreatedOrMatched $createdOrMatched -PreExisting $preExisting -PreSha $preSha -PostSha $postSha -MarkerVerdict "RECORDED" -FalseClaimVerdict "RECORDED" -BlankPolicyVerdict "RECORDED" -PathBoundaryVerdict "INSIDE_SOURCE_BODY_STAGING"
}

function Invoke-Main {
    $rid = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-RunId } else { $RunId }

    $script:ResolvedWorkingLane = Resolve-FullPathStrict $WorkingLane
    $script:ResolvedBuildHarness = Resolve-FullPathStrict $BuildHarnessLane
    $script:ResolvedStagingRoot = Resolve-FullPathStrict $StagingRoot
    $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReceiptRoot
    $resolvedManifest = Resolve-FullPathStrict $StagingMaterializationManifestPath
    $resolvedBootstrap = Resolve-FullPathStrict $BootstrapBodyInputBundlePath

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $script:ResolvedBuildHarness -Parent $script:ResolvedWorkingLane)) {
        throw "STAGING_MATERIALIZER_HARNESS_OUTSIDE_WORKING_LANE"
    }

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $script:ResolvedStagingRoot -Parent $script:ResolvedBuildHarness)) {
        throw "STAGING_MATERIALIZER_STAGING_OUTSIDE_HARNESS"
    }

    if ($script:ResolvedStagingRoot -like "*\COMMAND_CENTER\*") {
        throw "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_LIVE_TARGET_TOUCH"
    }

    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedReceiptRoot) | Out-Null

    $manifest = Read-Manifest $resolvedManifest
    $bundle = Read-BootstrapBundle $resolvedBootstrap
    $bodies = @($bundle.Bodies)

    if ($Mode -eq "PLAN_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PLAN_ONLY_NO_FILES_CREATED"
        Write-Output "BODY_ROWS: $($bodies.Count)"
        Write-Output "MANIFEST_ROWS: $($manifest.Count)"
        Write-Output "NEXT: PREFLIGHT_ONLY"
        exit 0
    }

    foreach ($body in $bodies) {
        $targetId = [string]$body.TargetId
        if (-not (Test-PlannedTargetId $targetId)) {
            throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_UNPLANNED_TARGET: $targetId"
        }

        if ([string]$body.BodyFile -ne ($targetId + ".body")) {
            throw "STAGING_BODY_FILENAME_MISMATCH: $targetId"
        }

        $decoded = Decode-BodyContent $body

        if ($decoded.Sha256 -ne [string]$body.ExpectedSHA256) {
            throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_HASH_MISMATCH: $targetId"
        }

        if ($decoded.ByteCount -ne [int]$body.ExpectedByteCount) {
            throw "STAGING_BODY_BYTE_COUNT_NOT_RECORDED: $targetId"
        }

        if ($decoded.LineCount -ne [int]$body.ExpectedLineCount) {
            throw "STAGING_BODY_LINE_COUNT_NOT_RECORDED: $targetId"
        }

        $blankOk = Test-BlankPolicy -TargetId $targetId -Text $decoded.Text -MayBeBlank ([bool]$body.MayBeBlank)
        $claimOk = Test-FalseClaim -TargetId $targetId -Text $decoded.Text

        if (-not $blankOk -or -not $claimOk) {
            throw "STAGING_BODY_VALIDATION_BLOCK: $targetId"
        }

        if ($targetId -eq "I120") {
            [void](Test-I120NotStub -Text $decoded.Text)
        }

        if ($targetId -eq "I002") {
            [void](Test-I002CompositeManifest -Text $decoded.Text)
        }
    }

    if ($script:Findings.Count -gt 0) {
        $first = $script:Findings[0]
        $blockerPath = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_" + $rid + ".md")
        Write-BlockerReceipt -Path $blockerPath -RunIdValue $rid -FailureLabel $first.FailureLabel -Observed $first.Observed -Expected $first.Expected
        Write-Output "STATUS: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED"
        Write-Output "BLOCKER_RECEIPT: $blockerPath"
        exit 20
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "PREFLIGHT_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PREFLIGHT_PASS_NO_FILES_CREATED"
        Write-Output "NEXT: CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS"
        exit 0
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS" -or $Mode -eq "VERIFY_STAGING_INPUTS" -or $Mode -eq "RECEIPT_ONLY") {
        [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedStagingRoot) | Out-Null

        if ($Mode -ne "RECEIPT_ONLY") {
            $controlFiles = @(
                "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_PACKET__COMMAND_CENTER_SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_V0_1.md",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_INDEX.csv",
                "SOURCE_BODY_EXTRACTION_LEDGER.csv",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_VALIDATION_LEDGER.csv",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_DOES_NOT_PROVE.md",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_FAMILY_MATRIX.csv",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_INTENTIONAL_GAPS.csv",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_ROLLUP_LEDGER.csv",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_GENERATOR_GATE.md",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_ROLLUP_REPORT.md",
                "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_ROLLUP_BLOCKER_RECEIPT.md"
            )

            foreach ($cf in $controlFiles) {
                $path = Join-Path $script:ResolvedStagingRoot $cf
                Create-Or-MatchTextFile -Path $path -Text (New-ControlFileContent $cf) -TargetId $cf -OutputKind "CONTROL_FILE" -FamilyId "STAGING_CONTROL" -SourceBatch "11Y-11Z"
            }

            foreach ($body in $bodies) {
                $targetId = [string]$body.TargetId
                $decoded = Decode-BodyContent $body
                $path = Join-Path $script:ResolvedStagingRoot ([string]$body.BodyFile)
                Create-Or-MatchTextFile -Path $path -Text $decoded.Text -TargetId $targetId -OutputKind "BODY_FILE" -FamilyId ([string]$body.FamilyId) -SourceBatch ([string]$body.SourceBatch)
            }
        }

        $hashLedger = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_HASH_LEDGER_" + $rid + ".csv")
        Write-HashLedger -Path $hashLedger -RunIdValue $rid

        $verdict = if ($script:Created -eq 0) { "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_NOOP_EXACT_MATCH_PENDING_ROLLUP" } else { "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_CREATED_PENDING_ROLLUP" }
        $receipt = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_RECEIPT_" + $rid + ".md")
        Write-Receipt -Path $receipt -RunIdValue $rid -FinalVerdict $verdict

        Write-Output "STATUS: $verdict"
        Write-Output "RUN_ID: $rid"
        Write-Output "HASH_LEDGER: $hashLedger"
        Write-Output "RECEIPT: $receipt"
        Write-Output "NEXT: RUN_STAGING_ROLLUP_AND_GENERATOR_GATE"
        exit 0
    }
}

try {
    Invoke-Main
}
catch {
    $rid = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-RunId } else { $RunId }
    try {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ReceiptRoot)) {
            $receiptRootResolved = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReceiptRoot
            [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($receiptRootResolved) | Out-Null
            $blockerPath = Join-Path $receiptRootResolved ("STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_" + $rid + ".md")
            Write-BlockerReceipt -Path $blockerPath -RunIdValue $rid -FailureLabel "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED" -Observed $_.Exception.Message -Expected "Clean staging materialization preconditions"
            Write-Output "STATUS: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED"
            Write-Output "BLOCKER_RECEIPT: $blockerPath"
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    }

    Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    exit 30
}
```

---

## 11Z.6 Known Draft Limits

Known limits are explicit:

`BOOTSTRAP_BODY_INPUT_BUNDLE_NOT_YET_MATERIALIZED`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_TARGET_MANIFEST_NOT_YET_MATERIALIZED`

`CONTROL_FILE_CONTENTS_ARE_PLACEHOLDER_CONTROL_BODIES_IN_DRAFT_SCRIPT`

`SCRIPT_DRAFT_NOT_CODE_REVIEWED`

`SCRIPT_NOT_SELFTESTED`

`NO LOCAL FILES CREATED IN CHAT`

The placeholder control-body generator is acceptable only as a draft placeholder for 11Z. It must be replaced by exact 11X-H / 11Y control file bodies before live use.

Failure if left unchanged for live use:

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_BODY_PLACEHOLDER_LEFT_FOR_USE`

Hard line:

`11Z DEFINES THE MATERIALIZER DRAFT. 11AA MUST DEFINE THE BOOTSTRAP BODY INPUT BUNDLE PACK AND REPLACE PLACEHOLDER CONTROL BODY CONTENT.`

---

## 11Z.7 Script Validation Rules

The script draft is acceptable only if:

`status says SCRIPT_DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED`

`modes are restricted to staging-only modes`

`required paths are explicit`

`staging root must be inside build harness`

`live COMMAND_CENTER path is blocked`

`source_body_bundle creation is absent`

`writer execution is absent`

`harness execution is absent`

`static validator execution is absent`

`self-test execution is absent`

`delete/move/archive/commit/push actions are absent`

`existing different files block`

`no overwrite/append/merge behavior exists`

`receipt records no-execution fields`

`hash ledger records post-write hash`

`I090/I095 blank policy is enforced`

`I120 stub check exists`

`I002 composite check exists`

Failure labels:

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_DRAFT_STATUS_MISSING`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_MODE_SCOPE_TOO_BROAD`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_PATH_SCOPE_TOO_BROAD`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_LIVE_PATH_NOT_BLOCKED`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_BUNDLE_CREATION_PRESENT`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_WRITER_EXECUTION_PRESENT`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_HARNESS_EXECUTION_PRESENT`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_SELFTEST_EXECUTION_PRESENT`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_DESTRUCTIVE_ACTION_PRESENT`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_EXISTING_DIFF_NOT_BLOCKED`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_NO_EXECUTION_FIELDS_MISSING`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_HASH_LEDGER_WEAK`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_BLANK_POLICY_WEAK`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_I120_STUB_CHECK_MISSING`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_I002_COMPOSITE_CHECK_MISSING`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AA — Bootstrap Body Input Bundle Pack / Exact Body Carrier for Staging Materializer / No Staging Execution

Batch 11Z exposed the next parent leak: the staging materializer draft can create `.body` files only if it has exact source text. It also had placeholder control-file content. That placeholder is acceptable in a draft, but illegal for actual use.

Batch 11AA repairs that boundary.

Core rule:

`THE STAGING MATERIALIZER MAY NOT INVENT BODY FILES.`
`THE STAGING MATERIALIZER MAY NOT INVENT CONTROL FILES.`
`THE BOOTSTRAP INPUT MUST CARRY EXACT CONTENT FOR BOTH.`
`BOOTSTRAP INPUT != STAGING MATERIALIZATION.`
`BOOTSTRAP INPUT != SOURCE BODY BUNDLE.`

---

## 11AA.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_BOOTSTRAP_BODY_INPUT_MUST_CARRY_EXACT_STAGING_CONTENT_V0_1`

Wording:

`Before the staging materializer may run CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS, the bootstrap body input bundle must contain exact UTF-8 base64 content for all 101 planned TargetId.body files and all 11 staging-control files. It may not summarize, infer, stub, repair, compress, or replace source content. It proves only that a candidate input carrier exists; it does not create staging files, generate the source-body bundle, create final source-package files, run scripts, or approve live L0.`

This blocks:

`placeholder control body left for actual use`

`body content generated from memory`

`body content summarized`

`I120 replaced with short script stub`

`I002 assembled partially`

`control ledgers created with fake pass rows`

`bootstrap input treated as staging receipt`

`bootstrap input treated as final source-body bundle`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AC — Materializer Revision Spec / Consume Bootstrap Bodies and Controls / Remove Placeholder Control Generation

Batch 11AB defined the bootstrap input builder packet. Batch 11AC now revises the staging materializer contract.

The parent leak is clear:

`11Z materializer could create body files from Bodies[], but control files were still generated from New-ControlFileContent placeholder text.`

That is illegal for actual use because the control files are part of the staged input custody system. They cannot be generic. They must be exact staged control bodies from the bootstrap input.

Core rule:

`CONTROL FILES ARE SOURCE INPUTS, NOT SCRIPT INVENTIONS.`
`MATERIALIZER MUST CONSUME Bodies[] AND Controls[] EXACTLY.`
`NO PLACEHOLDER CONTROL BODY MAY SURVIVE INTO USE.`
`MATERIALIZER REVISION != MATERIALIZER EXECUTION.`
`REVISED MATERIALIZER STILL DOES NOT GENERATE BUNDLE OR FINAL PACKAGE.`

## 11AC.1 Parent Rule

`COMMAND_CENTER_MATERIALIZER_MUST_CONSUME_BOOTSTRAP_BODIES_AND_CONTROLS_EXACTLY_V0_1`

Wording:

`The staging materializer may create source_body_staging outputs only from exact decoded entries in the validated bootstrap input bundle. TargetId.body files must come from Bodies[]. Staging-control files must come from Controls[]. The script must not generate generic control files, infer missing content, use placeholder bodies, repair source content, write final build-harness files, generate the source body bundle, run the source writer, run the harness, run validation scripts, run self-tests, or claim review/freeze/live approval.`

This blocks:

`New-ControlFileContent used during actual materialization`

`generic staging-control markdown written as if exact`

`control CSVs created without full rows`

`rollup ledger missing 101 rows`

`staging index missing target families`

`materializer chains into generator`

`materializer writes final BUILD_HARNESS files`

## 11AC.8 Revised Read-BootstrapBundle Function Contract

The revised `Read-BootstrapBundle` must enforce:

```text
SchemaName == COMMAND_CENTER_STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_BODY_INPUT
SchemaVersion == V0_1
Encoding == UTF8_BASE64
BodyCountExpected == 101
ControlCountExpected == 11
FamilyCountExpected == 8
IntentionalGapCountExpected == 7
Bodies exists
Controls exists
Bodies.Count == 101
Controls.Count == 11
DoesNotProve exists and nonempty
Status is not a false execution status
```

It must reject:

`BOOTSTRAP_BODY_INPUT_NOT_EXECUTED` only if the selected mode requires prevalidated status? No. In builder flow, this status can still be candidate before materializer if validation receipt proves it. Therefore status alone is not enough. The materializer must also require validation proof or explicit operator override gate.

`BootstrapValidationReportPath` or `BootstrapValidationLedgerPath`

`-BootstrapValidationLedgerPath`

`-BootstrapValidationReportPath`

## 11AC.11 Revised Control Write Loop

Old draft behavior:

```text
foreach control file name:
    content = New-ControlFileContent(name)
    write content
```

Required revised behavior:

```text
foreach control entry in Controls[]:
    validate ControlId
    validate ControlFile
    decode ContentUtf8Base64
    verify hash
    verify byte count
    verify line count
    verify markers
    verify DNP
    verify false-claim scan
    write exact decoded text to source_body_staging\ControlFile
    record hash row
```

Forbidden:

`New-ControlFileContent`

`default generated content`

`fallback generated content`

`empty generated control`

`partial control file`

`MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_FALLBACK_USED`

`MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_PARTIAL_WRITE`

`MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_VALIDATION_SKIPPED`

## 11AC.12 Revised Body Write Loop

Required body write behavior:

```text
foreach body entry in Bodies[]:
    validate TargetId planned
    validate BodyFile == TargetId.body
    decode ContentUtf8Base64
    verify hash
    verify byte count
    verify line count
    verify blank policy
    verify markers
    verify DNP
    verify false-claim scan
    apply I002 hard check if TargetId == I002
    apply I120 hard check if TargetId == I120
    write exact decoded text to source_body_staging\BodyFile
    record hash row
```

Forbidden:

`body generated from RequiredMarkers`

`body generated from TargetId`

`body generated from SourceBatch`

`body generated from file extension`

`body repaired during write`

`MATERIALIZER_BODY_FROM_METADATA`

`MATERIALIZER_BODY_REPAIRED_DURING_WRITE`

`MATERIALIZER_BODY_REQUIRED_MARKER_TEMPLATE_USED`

## 11AC.13 Revised Existing File Policy

Existing file policy remains strict:

If output path does not exist:

`CREATE`

If output path exists and post-decoded hash matches:

`SKIP_EXACT_MATCH`

If output path exists and hash differs:

`BLOCK`

No overwrite.

No backup.

No move-aside.

No merge.

No append.

No “fix in place.”

This applies equally to:

`Bodies[] outputs`

`Controls[] outputs`

`MATERIALIZER_EXISTING_BODY_DIFF_BLOCK`

## 11AC.16 Revised Blocker Receipt Requirements

If blocked, blocker receipt must include:

```text
BlockedEntryKind: BODY or CONTROL or VALIDATION_GATE or PATH_BOUNDARY
BlockedEntryId:
BlockedFileName:
BlockedCheck:
FailureLabel:
Observed:
Expected:
BootstrapInput:
BootstrapValidationLedger:
FilesCreatedBeforeBlock:
RollbackAttempted: false
GeneratorRunAttempted: false
WriterRunAttempted: false
HarnessRunAttempted: false
SelfTestRunAttempted: false
```

If the block occurs before any write, `FilesCreatedBeforeBlock` must be `0`.

If a partial write occurred before a later block, it must not autoclean. It must receipt the partial state and block rollup.

Failure labels:

`MATERIALIZER_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_MISSING_ENTRY_KIND`

`MATERIALIZER_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_MISSING_BOOTSTRAP_POINTER`

`MATERIALIZER_BLOCKER_AUTOCLEAN_ATTEMPT`

## 11AC.19 Revised Sequence

Required sequence:

```text
001 Load materializer script parameters.
002 Resolve and normalize WorkingLane.
003 Resolve and normalize BuildHarnessLane.
004 Resolve and normalize StagingRoot.
005 Resolve and normalize ReceiptRoot.
006 Confirm BuildHarnessLane is inside WorkingLane.

008 Confirm StagingRoot path ends with source_body_staging or approved equivalent.
009 Confirm no target path points to final BUILD_HARNESS templates, fixtures, review, source_body_bundle, COMMAND_CENTER, or live state.
010 Load staging materialization manifest.
011 Load bootstrap validation ledger.
012 Confirm bootstrap validation gate passes.
013 Load bootstrap input JSON.
014 Confirm Bodies.Count = 101.
015 Confirm Controls.Count = 11.
016 Validate every Bodies[] entry.
017 Validate every Controls[] entry.
018 Confirm no intentional gaps included.
019 Confirm I090/I095 empty.
020 Confirm I002 composite complete.
021 Confirm I120 not stub.
022 Confirm C002/C003/C008 complete.
023 If PLAN_ONLY: write nothing.
024 If PREFLIGHT_ONLY: write nothing except approved preflight report if separately allowed.
025 If CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS: create/exact-match control files from Controls[].
026 Create/exact-match body files from Bodies[].
027 Hash all 112 outputs.
028 Write hash ledger.
029 Write receipt.
030 If blocked: write blocker receipt and stop.
031 Do not run generator.
032 Do not run writer.
033 Do not run harness.
034 Do not run validator.
035 Do not run self-test.
036 Hand off to staging rollup.
```
