```powershell
function Read-Manifest {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_STAGING_MANIFEST_MISSING"
    }

    return @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)
}

function Read-BootstrapValidationLedger {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION_LEDGER_REQUIRED"
    }

    $rows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)
    if ($rows.Count -eq 0) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION_LEDGER_MISSING"
    }

    foreach ($row in $rows) {
        $blocks = Convert-ToBoolStrict $row.BlocksMaterializer
        $pass = Convert-ToBoolStrict $row.Pass
        if ($blocks -and -not $pass) {
            throw "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION_BLOCKED: $($row.ValidationType) $($row.FailureLabel)"
        }
    }

    $requiredTypes = @(
        "BODY_COUNT_101",
        "CONTROL_COUNT_11",
        "I002_COMPOSITE_COMPLETE",
        "I120_NOT_STUB",
        "CONTROL_INDEX_COMPLETE",
        "CONTROL_EXTRACTION_LEDGER_COMPLETE",
        "CONTROL_ROLLUP_LEDGER_COMPLETE",
        "FALSE_CLAIM_ABSENT",
        "NO_STAGING_BODY_FILES_WRITTEN",
        "NO_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_WRITTEN",
        "NO_EXECUTION_CHAIN_STARTED"
    )

    foreach ($t in $requiredTypes) {
        $hit = $rows | Where-Object {
            ([string]$_.ValidationType).Equals($t, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -and
            (Convert-ToBoolStrict $_.Pass)
        }

        if ($null -eq $hit -or @($hit).Count -eq 0) {
            throw "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION_BLOCKED: missing pass row $t"
        }
    }

    $script:ValidationGateVerdict = "BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION_GATE_PASS"
    return $rows
}

function Read-BootstrapBundle {
    param([string]$Path)

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_MISSING"
    }

    $json = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    if ($json.SchemaName -ne "COMMAND_CENTER_STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_BODY_INPUT") {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID"
    }

    if ($json.SchemaVersion -ne "V0_1") {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID"
    }

    if ($json.Encoding -ne "UTF8_BASE64") {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID"
    }

    if ($json.BodyCountExpected -ne 101) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_COUNT_MISMATCH"
    }

    if ($null -eq $json.ControlCountExpected) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_CONTROL_COUNT_MISSING"
    }

    if ($json.ControlCountExpected -ne 11) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_CONTROL_COUNT_MISMATCH"
    }

    if ($json.FamilyCountExpected -ne 8) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID"
    }

    if ($json.IntentionalGapCountExpected -ne 7) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID"
    }

    if ($null -eq $json.Bodies -or @($json.Bodies).Count -ne 101) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_COUNT_MISMATCH"
    }

    if ($null -eq $json.Controls) {
        throw "BOOTSTRAP_CONTROL_ENTRIES_MISSING"
    }

    if (@($json.Controls).Count -ne 11) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_CONTROL_COUNT_MISMATCH"
    }

    if ($null -eq $json.DoesNotProve -or @($json.DoesNotProve).Count -eq 0) {
        throw "STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID"
    }

    $falseStatuses = @("STAGING_FILES_CREATED", "SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_CREATED", "SOURCE_PACKAGE_CREATED", "WRITER_RAN", "HARNESS_RAN", "SELFTEST_PASS", "CODE_REVIEW_PASS", "TEMPLATE_FREEZE_PASS", "LIVE_L0_APPROVED", "MVP_ACTIVE", "SAFE", "DONE")
    foreach ($s in $falseStatuses) {
        if (([string]$json.Status).Equals($s, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
            throw "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_STATUS_FALSE_EXECUTION: $s"
        }
    }

    return $json
}

function Validate-BodyEntry {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Entry)

    $targetId = [string]$Entry.TargetId
    $fileName = [string]$Entry.BodyFile
    $ok = $true

    if (-not (Test-PlannedTargetId $targetId)) {
        Add-Finding "BODY" $targetId $fileName "TARGET_ID" "MATERIALIZER_BODY_TARGET_UNPLANNED" $targetId "planned TargetId" $true
        $ok = $false
    }

    if ($fileName -ne ($targetId + ".body")) {
        Add-Finding "BODY" $targetId $fileName "BODY_FILE" "MATERIALIZER_BODY_FILE_MISMATCH" $fileName ($targetId + ".body") $true
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-FileNameNoSeparator "BODY" $targetId $fileName)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    $decoded = Decode-EntryContent "BODY" $targetId $fileName $Entry

    if (-not (Test-EntryHashAndCounts "BODY" $targetId $fileName $Entry $decoded)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    $mayBlank = Convert-ToBoolStrict $Entry.MayBeBlank
    if (-not (Test-BlankPolicy "BODY" $targetId $fileName $decoded.Text $mayBlank)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-DnpPresent "BODY" $targetId $fileName $Entry $decoded.Text)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-RequiredMarkers "BODY" $targetId $fileName $Entry $decoded.Text)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-FalseClaim "BODY" $targetId $fileName $decoded.Text)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if ($targetId -eq "I120") {
        if (-not (Test-I120NotStub $decoded.Text)) {
            $ok = $false
        }
    }

    if ($targetId -eq "I002") {
        if (-not (Test-I002CompositeManifest $decoded.Text)) {
            $ok = $false
        }
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Ok = $ok
        EntryKind = "BODY"
        EntryId = $targetId
        FileName = $fileName
        FamilyId = Get-FamilyIdForTarget $targetId
        SourceBatch = [string]$Entry.SourceBatch
        Text = $decoded.Text
        Bytes = $decoded.Bytes
        Sha256 = $decoded.Sha256
        ByteCount = $decoded.ByteCount
        LineCount = $decoded.LineCount
    }
}

function Validate-ControlEntry {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Entry,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$ControlMap
    )

    $controlId = [string]$Entry.ControlId
    $fileName = [string]$Entry.ControlFile
    $ok = $true

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($controlId)) {
        Add-Finding "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName "CONTROL_ID" "MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_ID_MISSING" "blank" "C001-C011" $true
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not $ControlMap.ContainsKey($controlId)) {
        Add-Finding "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName "CONTROL_ID" "MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_ID_UNKNOWN" $controlId "C001-C011" $true
        $ok = $false
    }
    else {
        $expectedFile = [string]$ControlMap[$controlId]
        if ($fileName -ne $expectedFile) {
            Add-Finding "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName "CONTROL_FILE" "MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_FILE_MISMATCH" $fileName $expectedFile $true
            $ok = $false
        }
    }

    if (-not (Test-FileNameNoSeparator "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (Convert-ToBoolStrict $Entry.MayBeBlank) {
        Add-Finding "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName "BLANK_POLICY" "MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_BLANK_NOT_ALLOWED" "MayBeBlank true" "false" $true
        $ok = $false
    }

    $decoded = Decode-EntryContent "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName $Entry

    if (-not (Test-EntryHashAndCounts "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName $Entry $decoded)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-BlankPolicy "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName $decoded.Text $false)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-DnpPresent "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName $Entry $decoded.Text)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-RequiredMarkers "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName $Entry $decoded.Text)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-ControlCompleteness $controlId $decoded.Text)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    if (-not (Test-FalseClaim "CONTROL" $controlId $fileName $decoded.Text)) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Ok = $ok
        EntryKind = "CONTROL"
        EntryId = $controlId
        FileName = $fileName
        FamilyId = "STAGING_CONTROL"
        SourceBatch = [string]$Entry.SourceBatch
        Text = $decoded.Text
        Bytes = $decoded.Bytes
        Sha256 = $decoded.Sha256
        ByteCount = $decoded.ByteCount
        LineCount = $decoded.LineCount
    }
}

function Add-HashRow {
    param(
        [string]$InputEntryKind,
        [string]$InputEntryId,
        [string]$OutputPath,
        [string]$OutputKind,
        [string]$FamilyId,
        [string]$SourceBatch,
        [int]$Bytes,
        [string]$Sha256,
        [int]$LineCount,
        [string]$CreatedOrMatched,
        [bool]$PreExisting,
        [string]$PreSha,
        [string]$PostSha,
        [string]$WriteVerdict
    )

    $script:HashRows.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        InputEntryKind = $InputEntryKind
        InputEntryId = $InputEntryId
        OutputPath = $OutputPath
        OutputKind = $OutputKind
        FamilyId = $FamilyId
        SourceBatch = $SourceBatch
        Bytes = $Bytes
        SHA256 = $Sha256
        LineCount = $LineCount
        CreatedOrMatched = $CreatedOrMatched
        PreExisting = $PreExisting
        PreSHA256 = $PreSha
        PostSHA256 = $PostSha
        InputExpectedSHA256 = $Sha256
        DecodedSHA256 = $Sha256
        WriteVerdict = $WriteVerdict
        ExactInputUsed = "true"
        PlaceholderUsed = "false"
        ValidationGateVerdict = $script:ValidationGateVerdict
        PathBoundaryVerdict = "INSIDE_SOURCE_BODY_STAGING"
        DoesNotProve = "Hash ledger row does not prove bundle generation, writer run, harness run, review, freeze, live L0, or MVP activation."
    })
}

function Create-Or-MatchTextFile {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$ValidatedEntry,
        [string]$OutputKind
    )

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $Path -Parent $script:ResolvedStagingRoot)) {
        throw "STAGING_HASH_LEDGER_PATH_BOUNDARY_FAIL: $Path"
    }

    $sha = $ValidatedEntry.Sha256
    $preExisting = [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)
    $preSha = ""

    if ($preExisting) {
        $preSha = Get-FileSha256 -Path $Path
        if ($preSha -ne $sha) {
            $failure = if ($OutputKind -eq "CONTROL_FILE") { "MATERIALIZER_EXISTING_CONTROL_DIFF_BLOCK" } else { "MATERIALIZER_EXISTING_BODY_DIFF_BLOCK" }
            throw "$failure`: $Path"
        }

        $script:Matched++
        $createdOrMatched = "SKIP_EXACT_MATCH"
    }
    else {
        [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($Path)) | Out-Null
        Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $ValidatedEntry.Text
        $script:Created++
        $createdOrMatched = "CREATE"
    }

    $postSha = Get-FileSha256 -Path $Path
    if ($postSha -ne $sha) {
        throw "STAGING_HASH_LEDGER_HASH_MISMATCH: $Path"
    }

    Add-HashRow -InputEntryKind $ValidatedEntry.EntryKind -InputEntryId $ValidatedEntry.EntryId -OutputPath $Path -OutputKind $OutputKind -FamilyId $ValidatedEntry.FamilyId -SourceBatch $ValidatedEntry.SourceBatch -Bytes $ValidatedEntry.ByteCount -Sha256 $sha -LineCount $ValidatedEntry.LineCount -CreatedOrMatched $createdOrMatched -PreExisting $preExisting -PreSha $preSha -PostSha $postSha -WriteVerdict "EXACT_INPUT_WRITTEN_OR_MATCHED"
}

function Write-HashLedger {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$RunIdValue
    )

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("RunId,InputEntryKind,InputEntryId,OutputPath,OutputKind,FamilyId,SourceBatch,Bytes,SHA256,LineCount,CreatedOrMatched,PreExisting,PreSHA256,PostSHA256,InputExpectedSHA256,DecodedSHA256,WriteVerdict,ExactInputUsed,PlaceholderUsed,ValidationGateVerdict,PathBoundaryVerdict,DoesNotProve")

    foreach ($r in $script:HashRows) {
        $lines.Add((CsvLine @(
            $RunIdValue,
            $r.InputEntryKind,
            $r.InputEntryId,
            $r.OutputPath,
            $r.OutputKind,
            $r.FamilyId,
            $r.SourceBatch,
            $r.Bytes,
            $r.SHA256,
            $r.LineCount,
            $r.CreatedOrMatched,
            $r.PreExisting,
            $r.PreSHA256,
            $r.PostSHA256,
            $r.InputExpectedSHA256,
            $r.DecodedSHA256,
            $r.WriteVerdict,
            $r.ExactInputUsed,
            $r.PlaceholderUsed,
            $r.ValidationGateVerdict,
            $r.PathBoundaryVerdict,
            $r.DoesNotProve
        )))
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
}

function Write-Receipt {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$RunIdValue,
        [string]$FinalVerdict
    )

    $bodyRows = @($script:HashRows | Where-Object { $_.OutputKind -eq "BODY_FILE" })
    $controlRows = @($script:HashRows | Where-Object { $_.OutputKind -eq "CONTROL_FILE" })

    $text = @"
# STAGING MATERIALIZATION RECEIPT

Status: $FinalVerdict
SchemaName: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: STAGING_INPUT_CREATION_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

RunId: $RunIdValue
CreatedUtc: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o"))
PacketId: $PacketId
StagingRoot: $($script:ResolvedStagingRoot)
ReceiptRoot: $($script:ResolvedReceiptRoot)

BootstrapInput: $($script:ResolvedBootstrapInput)
BootstrapValidationLedger: $($script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationLedger)
BootstrapValidationReport: $($script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationReport)

ExpectedBodyEntries: 101
ObservedBodyEntries: $($script:ObservedBodyEntries)
ExpectedControlEntries: 11
ObservedControlEntries: $($script:ObservedControlEntries)
ObservedBodyFiles: $($bodyRows.Count)
ObservedControlFiles: $($controlRows.Count)
ExpectedHashLedgerRows: 112
HashLedgerRows: $($script:HashRows.Count)

CreatedFiles: $script:Created
MatchedFiles: $script:Matched
BlockedFiles: $script:Blocked

ExactInputUsed: true
PlaceholderControlGenerationUsed: false
GeneratedControlFunctionCalled: false

BundleGenerated: false
BundleGeneratorRunAttempted: false
SourceWriterRunAttempted: false
HarnessRunAttempted: false
StaticValidatorRunAttempted: false
SelfTestRunAttempted: false
TemplateFreezeAttempted: false
CodeReviewPassClaimed: false
LiveL0ApprovalAttempted: false
ActorDispatchAttempted: false
WatcherInstallAttempted: false
AutomationInstallAttempted: false

FinalVerdict: $FinalVerdict

DoesNotProve:
- This receipt does not generate the source body bundle.
- This receipt does not create final build-harness source files.
- This receipt does not run the writer.
- This receipt does not run the harness.
- This receipt does not run self-test.
- This receipt does not prove code review or template freeze.
- This receipt does not approve live L0 or MVP activation.

NextLegalAction:
Run staging rollup and generator gate. Do not generate bundle until rollup gate passes.
"@

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $text
}

function Write-BlockerReceipt {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$RunIdValue,
        [string]$EntryKind,
        [string]$EntryId,
        [string]$FileName,
        [string]$FailureLabel,
        [string]$Observed,
        [string]$Expected
    )

    $text = @"
# STAGING MATERIALIZATION BLOCKER RECEIPT

Status: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED
SchemaName: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

RunId: $RunIdValue
BlockedUtc: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o"))
PacketId: $PacketId
BlockedEntryKind: $EntryKind
BlockedEntryId: $EntryId
BlockedFileName: $FileName
FailureLabel: $FailureLabel
Observed: $Observed
Expected: $Expected

BootstrapInput: $($script:ResolvedBootstrapInput)
BootstrapValidationLedger: $($script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationLedger)

FilesCreatedBeforeBlock: $script:Created
RollbackAttempted: false
GeneratorRunAttempted: false
WriterRunAttempted: false
HarnessRunAttempted: false
SelfTestRunAttempted: false

DoesNotProve:
- This blocker receipt does not repair staging.
- This blocker receipt does not prove source body bundle generation.
- This blocker receipt does not authorize continuing with partial staging.
- No generator may run after blocked staging materialization.

NextLegalAction:
Repair exact body/control source, bootstrap input, validation ledger, or path boundary. Rerun materialization from a clean reviewed plan.
"@

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $text
}

function Invoke-Main {
    $rid = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-RunId } else { $RunId }

    $script:ResolvedWorkingLane = Resolve-FullPathStrict $WorkingLane
    $script:ResolvedBuildHarness = Resolve-FullPathStrict $BuildHarnessLane
    $script:ResolvedStagingRoot = Resolve-FullPathStrict $StagingRoot
    $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReceiptRoot
    $script:ResolvedManifest = Resolve-FullPathStrict $StagingMaterializationManifestPath
    $script:ResolvedBootstrapInput = Resolve-FullPathStrict $BootstrapBodyInputBundlePath
    $script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationLedger = Resolve-FullPathStrict $BootstrapValidationLedgerPath
    $script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationReport = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($BootstrapValidationReportPath)) { "" } else { Resolve-FullPathStrict $BootstrapValidationReportPath }

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $script:ResolvedBuildHarness -Parent $script:ResolvedWorkingLane)) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_HARNESS_OUTSIDE_WORKING_LANE"
    }

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $script:ResolvedStagingRoot -Parent $script:ResolvedBuildHarness)) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_STAGING_OUTSIDE_HARNESS"
    }

    $leaf = Split-Path -Leaf $script:ResolvedStagingRoot.TrimEnd('\')
    if (-not $leaf.Equals("source_body_staging", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        throw "MATERIALIZER_STAGING_ROOT_NAME_NOT_APPROVED"
    }

    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedReceiptRoot) | Out-Null

    $manifest = Read-Manifest $script:ResolvedManifest

    if ($Mode -eq "PLAN_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PLAN_ONLY_NO_FILES_CREATED"
        Write-Output "NEXT: PREFLIGHT_ONLY"
        exit 0
    }

    [void](Read-BootstrapValidationLedger $script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationLedger)
    $bundle = Read-BootstrapBundle $script:ResolvedBootstrapInput

    $bodies = @($bundle.Bodies)
    $controls = @($bundle.Controls)
    $script:ObservedBodyEntries = $bodies.Count
    $script:ObservedControlEntries = $controls.Count

    $controlMap = Get-ControlMap
    $validatedControls = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    $validatedBodies = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

    $seenControls = @{}
    foreach ($control in $controls) {
        $validated = Validate-ControlEntry -Entry $control -ControlMap $controlMap
        if ($seenControls.ContainsKey($validated.EntryId)) {
            Add-Finding "CONTROL" $validated.EntryId $validated.FileName "DUPLICATE_CONTROL" "MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_ID_UNKNOWN" "duplicate" "unique C001-C011" $true
        }
        else {
            $seenControls[$validated.EntryId] = $true
        }
        $validatedControls.Add($validated)
    }

    foreach ($cid in $controlMap.Keys) {
        if (-not $seenControls.ContainsKey($cid)) {
            Add-Finding "CONTROL" $cid ([string]$controlMap[$cid]) "CONTROL_PRESENT" "MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_ID_MISSING" "missing" "present" $true
        }
    }

    $seenBodies = @{}
    foreach ($body in $bodies) {
        $validated = Validate-BodyEntry -Entry $body
        if ($seenBodies.ContainsKey($validated.EntryId)) {
            Add-Finding "BODY" $validated.EntryId $validated.FileName "DUPLICATE_BODY" "MATERIALIZER_BODY_TARGET_UNPLANNED" "duplicate" "unique planned target" $true
        }
        else {
            $seenBodies[$validated.EntryId] = $true
        }
        $validatedBodies.Add($validated)
    }

    if ($script:Findings.Count -gt 0) {
        $first = $script:Findings[0]
        $blockerPath = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_" + $rid + ".md")
        Write-BlockerReceipt -Path $blockerPath -RunIdValue $rid -EntryKind $first.EntryKind -EntryId $first.EntryId -FileName $first.FileName -FailureLabel $first.FailureLabel -Observed $first.Observed -Expected $first.Expected
        Write-Output "STATUS: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED"
        Write-Output "BLOCKER_RECEIPT: $blockerPath"
        exit 20
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "PREFLIGHT_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PREFLIGHT_PASS_NO_FILES_CREATED"
        Write-Output "BODY_ENTRIES: $($validatedBodies.Count)"
        Write-Output "CONTROL_ENTRIES: $($validatedControls.Count)"
        Write-Output "VALIDATION_GATE: $script:ValidationGateVerdict"
        Write-Output "NEXT: CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS"
        exit 0
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "CREATE_STAGING_INPUTS" -or $Mode -eq "VERIFY_STAGING_INPUTS" -or $Mode -eq "RECEIPT_ONLY") {
        [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedStagingRoot) | Out-Null

        if ($Mode -ne "RECEIPT_ONLY") {
            foreach ($entry in $validatedControls) {
                $path = Join-Path $script:ResolvedStagingRoot $entry.FileName
                Create-Or-MatchTextFile -Path $path -ValidatedEntry $entry -OutputKind "CONTROL_FILE"
            }

            foreach ($entry in $validatedBodies) {
                $path = Join-Path $script:ResolvedStagingRoot $entry.FileName
                Create-Or-MatchTextFile -Path $path -ValidatedEntry $entry -OutputKind "BODY_FILE"
            }
        }

        if ($script:HashRows.Count -ne 112 -and $Mode -ne "RECEIPT_ONLY") {
            throw "MATERIALIZER_HASH_LEDGER_ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH: $($script:HashRows.Count)"
        }

        $hashLedger = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_HASH_LEDGER_" + $rid + ".csv")
        Write-HashLedger -Path $hashLedger -RunIdValue $rid

        $verdict = if ($script:Created -eq 0) { "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_NOOP_EXACT_MATCH_PENDING_ROLLUP" } else { "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_CREATED_PENDING_ROLLUP" }
        $receipt = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_RECEIPT_" + $rid + ".md")
        Write-Receipt -Path $receipt -RunIdValue $rid -FinalVerdict $verdict

        Write-Output "STATUS: $verdict"
        Write-Output "RUN_ID: $rid"
        Write-Output "HASH_LEDGER: $hashLedger"
        Write-Output "RECEIPT: $receipt"
        Write-Output "NEXT: RUN_STAGING_ROLLUP_AND_GENERATOR_GATE"
        exit 0
    }
}

try {
    Invoke-Main
}
catch {
    $rid = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-RunId } else { $RunId }

    try {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ReceiptRoot)) {
            $receiptRootResolved = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReceiptRoot
            [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($receiptRootResolved) | Out-Null
            $blockerPath = Join-Path $receiptRootResolved ("STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_" + $rid + ".md")

            $script:ResolvedBootstrapInput = if ($script:ResolvedBootstrapInput) { $script:ResolvedBootstrapInput } else { $BootstrapBodyInputBundlePath }
            $script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationLedger = if ($script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationLedger) { $script:ResolvedBootstrapValidationLedger } else { $BootstrapValidationLedgerPath }

            Write-BlockerReceipt -Path $blockerPath -RunIdValue $rid -EntryKind "UNKNOWN" -EntryId "" -FileName "" -FailureLabel "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED" -Observed $_.Exception.Message -Expected "Clean revised materializer preconditions"
            Write-Output "STATUS: STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKED"
            Write-Output "BLOCKER_RECEIPT: $blockerPath"
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    }

    Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    exit 30
```
```json
}
```

## 11AF.6 Static Review Engine Contract

Static review has two layers:

`text scan`

`structure/path scan`

The text scan checks forbidden and required pattern ledgers.

The structure/path scan checks sequence and write-boundary logic. It must confirm:

```text
BootstrapValidationLedgerPath parameter exists.
Read-BootstrapValidationLedger is called before any Create-Or-MatchTextFile call.
Read-BootstrapBundle requires Controls[].
Controls[] loop writes control files.
Bodies[] loop writes body files.
No New-ControlFileContent active function exists.
No source_body_bundle write path exists.
No final package target write exists.
No live target write exists.
No execution-chain commands exist.
Receipt contains placeholder-control proof fields.
Hash ledger expects 112 rows.
```

Allowed static review verdicts:

`STATIC_REVIEW_NOT_RUN`

`STATIC_REVIEW_BLOCKED`

`STATIC_REVIEW_PASSED_FOR_SANDBOX_SELFTEST_ONLY`

Forbidden static review verdicts:

`SCRIPT_APPROVED_FOR_USE`

`MATERIALIZER_SAFE`

`LIVE_APPROVED`

`DONE`

Failure labels:

`REVIEW_RUNNER_STATIC_TEXT_SCAN_MISSING`

`REVIEW_RUNNER_STATIC_STRUCTURE_SCAN_MISSING`

`REVIEW_RUNNER_STATIC_REVIEW_OVERCLAIM`

## 11AF.8 Sandbox Fixture Court Contract

Fixture execution may happen only under:

`review\sandbox\<RunId>\`

Each fixture gets its own isolated directory:

```text
review\sandbox\<RunId>\fixtures\<FixtureId>\
  working_lane\
  build_harness\
  source_body_staging\
  receipts\
  inputs\
  observed\
```

The materializer may be invoked only with:

`WorkingLane = fixture working_lane`

`BuildHarnessLane = fixture build_harness`

`StagingRoot = fixture build_harness\source_body_staging`

`ReceiptRoot = fixture receipts`

No fixture may pass real project paths.

`REVIEW_RUNNER_FIXTURE_USES_REAL_WORKING_LANE`

`REVIEW_RUNNER_FIXTURE_USES_REAL_STAGING_ROOT`

`REVIEW_RUNNER_FIXTURE_USES_REAL_RECEIPT_ROOT`

## 11AG.3 Draft Script Body

```powershell
<#
SCRIPT PURPOSE:
Run the revised materializer review court:
1. Static scan the revised materializer script.
2. Build sandbox-only fixture workspaces.
3. Run negative fixtures before happy path.
4. Write review court reports, findings, hash ledger, and blocker receipt.
5. Never use the real source_body_staging root.
6. Never approve live materializer use.

SCRIPT STATUS:
SCRIPT_DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED

SCRIPT DOES NOT:
- run the materializer against the real staging root
- generate source body bundle
- run source writer
- run L0 harness
- run live static validator
- run live self-test
- create final source package files
- touch live COMMAND_CENTER
- touch live assistant state
- approve live L0
- activate MVP
- delete, move, archive, restore, commit, or push

DOES_NOT_PROVE:
This runner draft does not prove the runner is safe.
This runner draft does not prove static review passed.
This runner draft does not prove self-test passed.
This runner draft does not approve live use.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateSet(
        "PLAN_ONLY",
        "STATIC_REVIEW_ONLY",
        "BUILD_FIXTURE_SANDBOX_ONLY",
        "RUN_NEGATIVE_FIXTURES_ONLY",
        "RUN_HAPPY_PATH_SANDBOX_ONLY",
        "RUN_FULL_COURT_SANDBOX_ONLY",
        "REPORT_ONLY"
    )]
    [string]$Mode,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$RevisedMaterializerScriptPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ForbiddenPatternLedgerPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$RequiredPatternLedgerPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ReviewPackPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$FixtureManifestPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ExpectedResultsPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$SandboxRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ReceiptRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ReviewReportPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$SelfTestReportPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$BlockerReceiptPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$RunId = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:Findings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:HashRows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:StaticReviewPassed = $false
$script:NegativeFixturesPassed = $false
$script:HappyPathPassed = $false
$script:ForbiddenOutputObserved = $false

function New-ReviewCourtRunId {
    return "REVISED_MATERIALIZER_REVIEW_COURT_" + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ")
}

function Resolve-FullPathStrict {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) {
        throw "REVIEW_RUNNER_BLANK_PATH"
    }

    if ($Path -match "\.\.") {
        throw "REVIEW_RUNNER_PATH_TRAVERSAL_RISK: $Path"
    }

    $bad = @("PASTE_THE_COPIED_PATH_HERE", "TODO_PATH", "CHANGE_ME", "<PATH>", "[PATH]", "C:\path\to")
    foreach ($b in $bad) {
        if ($Path -like "*$b*") {
            throw "REVIEW_RUNNER_PLACEHOLDER_PATH: $Path"
        }
    }

    return [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
}

function Test-InsidePath {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Child,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Parent
    )

    $c = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Child).TrimEnd('\')
    $p = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Parent).TrimEnd('\')

    if ($c.Equals($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $true
    }

    return $c.StartsWith($p + "\", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Get-Sha256Bytes {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][byte[]]$Bytes)

    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    try {
        return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($Bytes))).Replace("-", "")
    }
    finally {
        $sha.Dispose()
    }
}

function Get-FileSha256 {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
    return Get-Sha256Bytes -Bytes $bytes
}

function Get-LineCount {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text -or $Text.Length -eq 0) {
        return 0
    }

    return $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n").Split("`n").Count
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [AllowNull()][string]$Text
    )

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    $dir = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($Path)
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($dir)) {
        [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($dir) | Out-Null
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
}

function CsvCell {
    param([AllowNull()][object]$Value)

    if ($null -eq $Value) {
        return ""
    }

    $s = [string]$Value
    $e = $s.Replace('"', '""')

    if ($e.Contains(",") -or $e.Contains('"') -or $e.Contains("`r") -or $e.Contains("`n")) {
        return '"' + $e + '"'
    }

    return $e
}

function CsvLine {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]]$Values)
    return (($Values | ForEach-Object { CsvCell $_ }) -join ",")
}

function Add-Finding {
    param(
        [string]$Phase,
        [string]$CheckId,
        [string]$CheckName,
        [string]$InputFile,
        [string]$Expected,
        [string]$Observed,
        [bool]$Pass,
        [string]$FailureLabel,
        [bool]$BlocksNextPhase,
        [string]$NextLegalAction
    )

    $script:Findings.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        RunId = $script:RunIdValue
        Phase = $Phase
        CheckId = $CheckId
        CheckName = $CheckName
        InputFile = $InputFile
        Expected = $Expected
        Observed = $Observed
        Pass = $Pass
        FailureLabel = $FailureLabel
        BlocksNextPhase = $BlocksNextPhase
        DoesNotProve = "Finding row does not approve live use."
        NextLegalAction = $NextLegalAction
    })
}

function Assert-InputFile {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$FailureLabel
    )

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        throw "$FailureLabel`: $Path"
    }
}

function Assert-DirectoryBoundary {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$AllowedParent,
        [string]$FailureLabel
    )

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $Path -Parent $AllowedParent)) {
        throw "$FailureLabel`: $Path"
    }
}

function Read-CsvStrict {
    param([string]$Path)

    Assert-InputFile -Path $Path -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_INPUT_MISSING"
    return @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)
}

function Read-JsonStrict {
    param([string]$Path)

    Assert-InputFile -Path $Path -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_INPUT_MISSING"
    return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
}

function Invoke-StaticTextScan {
    param(
        [string]$ScriptPath,
        [array]$ForbiddenRows,
        [array]$RequiredRows
    )

    $scriptText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $ScriptPath -Raw
    $allPass = $true

    foreach ($row in $ForbiddenRows) {
        $patternId = [string]$row.PatternId
        $pattern = [string]$row.Pattern
        $allowedIfCommentOnly = ([string]$row.AllowedIfCommentOnly).Equals("true", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        $failure = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$row.FailureLabel)) { "REVIEW_RUNNER_FORBIDDEN_PATTERN_HIT" } else { [string]$row.FailureLabel }

        $hit = $scriptText.IndexOf($pattern, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0

        if ($hit -and $allowedIfCommentOnly) {
            # Draft-level scan: conservative. A later AST pass must prove comment-only.
            Add-Finding "STATIC_REVIEW" $patternId "FORBIDDEN_PATTERN_SCAN" $ScriptPath "Pattern absent or comment-only with AST proof" "Pattern text present: $pattern" $false $failure $true "Run AST/comment-context review or remove pattern."
            $allPass = $false
        }
        elseif ($hit) {
            Add-Finding "STATIC_REVIEW" $patternId "FORBIDDEN_PATTERN_SCAN" $ScriptPath "Pattern absent" "Pattern present: $pattern" $false $failure $true "Remove forbidden pattern."
            $allPass = $false
        }
        else {
            Add-Finding "STATIC_REVIEW" $patternId "FORBIDDEN_PATTERN_SCAN" $ScriptPath "Pattern absent" "Pattern absent" $true "" $false "Continue static review."
        }
    }

    foreach ($row in $RequiredRows) {
        $patternId = [string]$row.PatternId
        $pattern = [string]$row.RequiredPattern
        $failure = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$row.FailureLabel)) { "REVIEW_RUNNER_REQUIRED_PATTERN_MISSING" } else { [string]$row.FailureLabel }

        $hit = $scriptText.IndexOf($pattern, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0

        if (-not $hit) {
            Add-Finding "STATIC_REVIEW" $patternId "REQUIRED_PATTERN_SCAN" $ScriptPath "Pattern present: $pattern" "Missing" $false $failure $true "Add required pattern or revise script."
            $allPass = $false
        }
        else {
            Add-Finding "STATIC_REVIEW" $patternId "REQUIRED_PATTERN_SCAN" $ScriptPath "Pattern present: $pattern" "Present" $true "" $false "Continue static review."
        }
    }

    return $allPass
}

function Invoke-StaticStructureScan {
    param([string]$ScriptPath)

    $text = Get-Content -LiteralPath $ScriptPath -Raw
    $checksPass = $true

    $requiredChecks = @(
        @{ Id="SR-004"; Name="NO_PLACEHOLDER_CONTROL_FUNCTION_ACTIVE"; Needle="New-ControlFileContent"; ShouldBeAbsent=$true; Failure="MATERIALIZER_STATIC_REVIEW_PLACEHOLDER_CONTROL_ACTIVE" },
        @{ Id="SR-005"; Name="CONTROLS_ARRAY_REQUIRED"; Needle="Controls"; ShouldBeAbsent=$false; Failure="MATERIALIZER_CONTROL_ENTRY_NOT_USED" },
        @{ Id="SR-006"; Name="BODIES_ARRAY_REQUIRED"; Needle="Bodies"; ShouldBeAbsent=$false; Failure="MATERIALIZER_BODY_FROM_METADATA" },
        @{ Id="SR-007"; Name="VALIDATION_LEDGER_PARAMETER_REQUIRED"; Needle="BootstrapValidationLedgerPath"; ShouldBeAbsent=$false; Failure="MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION_LEDGER_REQUIRED" },
        @{ Id="SR-008"; Name="VALIDATION_GATE_BEFORE_WRITE"; Needle="Read-BootstrapValidationLedger"; ShouldBeAbsent=$false; Failure="MATERIALIZER_WRITES_BEFORE_BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION" },
        @{ Id="SR-011"; Name="HASH_LEDGER_112_EXPECTATION"; Needle="112"; ShouldBeAbsent=$false; Failure="MATERIALIZER_HASH_LEDGER_ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH" },
        @{ Id="SR-012"; Name="RECEIPT_PLACEHOLDER_FIELDS"; Needle="PlaceholderControlGenerationUsed: false"; ShouldBeAbsent=$false; Failure="MATERIALIZER_RECEIPT_PLACEHOLDER_FIELD_MISSING" },
        @{ Id="SR-015"; Name="NO_BUNDLE_WRITE"; Needle="source_body_bundle"; ShouldBeAbsent=$true; Failure="MATERIALIZER_STATIC_REVIEW_BUNDLE_WRITE" },
        @{ Id="SR-017"; Name="NO_LIVE_COMMAND_CENTER_WRITE"; Needle="COMMAND_CENTER\"; ShouldBeAbsent=$true; Failure="MATERIALIZER_STATIC_REVIEW_LIVE_TARGET_WRITE" },
        @{ Id="SR-021"; Name="NO_EXECUTION_CHAIN"; Needle="Start-Process"; ShouldBeAbsent=$true; Failure="MATERIALIZER_STATIC_REVIEW_EXECUTION_CHAIN" },
        @{ Id="SR-022"; Name="NO_DESTRUCTIVE_OR_REPO_MUTATION"; Needle="Remove-Item"; ShouldBeAbsent=$true; Failure="MATERIALIZER_STATIC_REVIEW_DESTRUCTIVE_COMMAND" }
    )

    foreach ($c in $requiredChecks) {
        $hit = $text.IndexOf($c.Needle, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0

        if ($c.ShouldBeAbsent -and $hit) {
            Add-Finding "STATIC_REVIEW" $c.Id $c.Name $ScriptPath "Absent: $($c.Needle)" "Present" $false $c.Failure $true "Remove forbidden structure/pattern or prove safe by stronger AST review."
            $checksPass = $false
        }
        elseif ((-not $c.ShouldBeAbsent) -and (-not $hit)) {
            Add-Finding "STATIC_REVIEW" $c.Id $c.Name $ScriptPath "Present: $($c.Needle)" "Missing" $false $c.Failure $true "Add required structure."
            $checksPass = $false
        }
        else {
            Add-Finding "STATIC_REVIEW" $c.Id $c.Name $ScriptPath "Expected structure condition" "Observed matching condition" $true "" $false "Continue."
        }
    }

    return $checksPass
}

function Write-FindingsLedger {
    param([string]$Path)

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("RunId,Phase,CheckId,CheckName,InputFile,Expected,Observed,Pass,FailureLabel,BlocksNextPhase,DoesNotProve,NextLegalAction")

    foreach ($f in $script:Findings) {
        $lines.Add((CsvLine @(
            $f.RunId,
            $f.Phase,
            $f.CheckId,
            $f.CheckName,
            $f.InputFile,
            $f.Expected,
            $f.Observed,
            $f.Pass,
            $f.FailureLabel,
            $f.BlocksNextPhase,
            $f.DoesNotProve,
            $f.NextLegalAction
        )))
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
}

    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$ScriptPath,
        [string]$Verdict,
        [string]$FindingsPath
    )

    $scriptHash = Get-FileSha256 -Path $ScriptPath

    $body = @"
# REVISED MATERIALIZER STATIC REVIEW REPORT

Status: $Verdict
SchemaName: REVISED_MATERIALIZER_STATIC_REVIEW_REPORT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: STATIC_REVIEW_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

DoesNotProve:

NextLegalAction:

function New-FixtureSandbox {
    param(
        [string]$FixtureId,
        [string]$FixtureName
    )

    $safeId = $FixtureId.Replace("..", "").Replace("\", "_").Replace("/", "_")
    $root = Join-Path $script:ResolvedSandboxRoot ("fixtures\" + $safeId)

    $paths = @{
        Root = $root
        WorkingLane = Join-Path $root "working_lane"
        BuildHarness = Join-Path $root "working_lane\build_harness"
        StagingRoot = Join-Path $root "working_lane\build_harness\source_body_staging"
        Receipts = Join-Path $root "receipts"
        Inputs = Join-Path $root "inputs"
        Observed = Join-Path $root "observed"
    }

    foreach ($p in $paths.Values) {
        [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($p) | Out-Null
    }

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $paths.StagingRoot -Parent $root)) {
        throw "REVIEW_RUNNER_SANDBOX_BOUNDARY_FAIL: $($paths.StagingRoot)"
    }

    return [pscustomobject]$paths
}

function Invoke-Fixture {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$FixtureRow,
        [string]$MaterializerScriptPath
    )

    $fixtureId = [string]$FixtureRow.FixtureId
    $fixtureName = [string]$FixtureRow.FixtureName
    $fixtureType = [string]$FixtureRow.FixtureType
    $fixtureMode = [string]$FixtureRow.Mode
    $expectedExit = [int]$FixtureRow.ExpectedExitCode
    $expectedFailure = [string]$FixtureRow.ExpectedFailureLabel

    $fx = New-FixtureSandbox -FixtureId $fixtureId -FixtureName $fixtureName

    # This draft intentionally does not fully author fixture payloads.
    # Fixture payload construction belongs to the fixture source pack.
    # Until fixture payloads exist, every fixture remains NOT_RUN_BY_DRAFT.
    Add-Finding "FIXTURE_COURT" $fixtureId $fixtureName $MaterializerScriptPath "Fixture payload exists and executes in sandbox" "Fixture payload source pack not yet materialized" $false "REVIEW_RUNNER_FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_MISSING" $true "Create fixture source pack before runner execution."

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        FixtureId = $fixtureId
        FixtureName = $fixtureName
        FixtureType = $fixtureType
        ExpectedExitCode = $expectedExit
        ExpectedFailureLabel = $expectedFailure
        ObservedExitCode = ""
        ObservedFailureLabel = "NOT_RUN_BY_DRAFT"
        Pass = $false
        BlocksHappyPath = $true
        SandboxRoot = $fx.Root
    }
}

function Write-BlockerReceipt {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Phase,
        [string]$FailureLabel,
        [string]$Observed,
        [string]$Expected
    )

    $body = @"
# REVISED MATERIALIZER REVIEW COURT BLOCKER RECEIPT

Status: REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKED
SchemaName: REVISED_MATERIALIZER_REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKER_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKER_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

RunId: $($script:RunIdValue)
BlockedUtc: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o"))
BlockedPhase: $Phase
FailureLabel: $FailureLabel
Observed: $Observed
Expected: $Expected
ReviewedScript: $($script:ResolvedMaterializerScript)
FindingsLedger: $($script:FindingsLedgerPath)
SandboxRoot: $($script:ResolvedSandboxRoot)

RollbackAttempted: false
MaterializerApprovedForUse: false
GeneratorRunAttempted: false
WriterRunAttempted: false
HarnessRunAttempted: false
LiveL0ApprovalAttempted: false

DoesNotProve:
- This blocker receipt does not repair the runner or materializer.
- No real staging materialization may proceed from a blocked review court.
- No source body bundle generator may run from a blocked review court.

NextLegalAction:
Repair the blocked layer, then rerun review court from static review.
"@

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $body
}

function Invoke-Main {
    $script:RunIdValue = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-ReviewCourtRunId } else { $RunId }

    $script:ResolvedMaterializerScript = Resolve-FullPathStrict $RevisedMaterializerScriptPath
    $script:ResolvedForbiddenLedger = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ForbiddenPatternLedgerPath
    $script:ResolvedRequiredLedger = Resolve-FullPathStrict $RequiredPatternLedgerPath
    $script:ResolvedReviewPack = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReviewPackPath
    $script:ResolvedFixtureManifest = Resolve-FullPathStrict $FixtureManifestPath
    $script:ResolvedExpectedResults = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ExpectedResultsPath
    $script:ResolvedSandboxRoot = Resolve-FullPathStrict $SandboxRoot
    $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReceiptRoot
    $script:ResolvedReviewReport = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReviewReportPath
    $script:ResolvedSelfTestReport = Resolve-FullPathStrict $SelfTestReportPath
    $script:ResolvedBlockerReceipt = Resolve-FullPathStrict $BlockerReceiptPath

    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedSandboxRoot) | Out-Null
    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedReceiptRoot) | Out-Null

    $script:FindingsLedgerPath = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("REVISED_MATERIALIZER_REVIEW_COURT_FINDINGS_" + $script:RunIdValue + ".csv")

    Assert-InputFile -Path $script:ResolvedMaterializerScript -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_INPUT_MISSING"
    Assert-InputFile -Path $script:ResolvedForbiddenLedger -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_INPUT_MISSING"
    Assert-InputFile -Path $script:ResolvedRequiredLedger -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_INPUT_MISSING"
    Assert-InputFile -Path $script:ResolvedFixtureManifest -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_INPUT_MISSING"
    Assert-InputFile -Path $script:ResolvedExpectedResults -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_INPUT_MISSING"

    if ($Mode -eq "PLAN_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PLAN_ONLY_NO_REVIEW_NO_FIXTURES"
        Write-Output "NEXT: STATIC_REVIEW_ONLY"
        exit 0
    }

    $forbidden = Read-CsvStrict $script:ResolvedForbiddenLedger
    $required = Read-CsvStrict $script:ResolvedRequiredLedger
    $fixtures = Read-CsvStrict $script:ResolvedFixtureManifest
    [void](Read-JsonStrict $script:ResolvedExpectedResults)

    $staticTextPass = Invoke-StaticTextScan -ScriptPath $script:ResolvedMaterializerScript -ForbiddenRows $forbidden -RequiredRows $required
    $staticStructPass = Invoke-StaticStructureScan -ScriptPath $script:ResolvedMaterializerScript

    $staticPass = ($staticTextPass -and $staticStructPass)

    if ($staticPass) {
        $script:StaticReviewPassed = $true
        $staticVerdict = "STATIC_REVIEW_PASSED_FOR_SANDBOX_ONLY"
    }
    else {
        $staticVerdict = "STATIC_REVIEW_BLOCKED"
    }

    Write-FindingsLedger -Path $script:FindingsLedgerPath
    Write-StaticReviewReport -Path $script:ResolvedReviewReport -ScriptPath $script:ResolvedMaterializerScript -Verdict $staticVerdict -FindingsPath $script:FindingsLedgerPath

    if ($Mode -eq "STATIC_REVIEW_ONLY") {
        if ($staticPass) {
            Write-Output "STATUS: STATIC_REVIEW_PASSED_FOR_SANDBOX_ONLY"
            Write-Output "NEXT: RUN_NEGATIVE_FIXTURES_ONLY"
            exit 0
        }

        Write-BlockerReceipt -Path $script:ResolvedBlockerReceipt -Phase "STATIC_REVIEW" -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_STATIC_BLOCKED_FIXTURES" -Observed "Static review failed" -Expected "All static checks pass before fixtures"
        Write-Output "STATUS: REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKED"
        Write-Output "BLOCKER_RECEIPT: $($script:ResolvedBlockerReceipt)"
        exit 20
    }

    if (-not $staticPass) {
        Write-BlockerReceipt -Path $script:ResolvedBlockerReceipt -Phase "STATIC_REVIEW" -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_STATIC_BLOCKED_FIXTURES" -Observed "Static review failed" -Expected "Static review pass before fixture execution"
        Write-CourtReport -Path (Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("REVISED_MATERIALIZER_REVIEW_COURT_REPORT_" + $script:RunIdValue + ".md")) -FinalVerdict "REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKED" -FindingsPath $script:FindingsLedgerPath
        Write-Output "STATUS: REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKED"
        exit 20
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "BUILD_FIXTURE_SANDBOX_ONLY") {
        foreach ($fx in $fixtures) {
            [void](New-FixtureSandbox -FixtureId ([string]$fx.FixtureId) -FixtureName ([string]$fx.FixtureName))
        }

        Write-Output "STATUS: FIXTURE_SANDBOX_BUILT_NO_MATERIALIZER_RUN"
        Write-Output "NEXT: RUN_NEGATIVE_FIXTURES_ONLY"
        exit 0
    }

    $fixtureResults = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]

    if ($Mode -eq "RUN_NEGATIVE_FIXTURES_ONLY" -or $Mode -eq "RUN_FULL_COURT_SANDBOX_ONLY") {
        $negativeFixtures = @($fixtures | Where-Object { [string]$_.FixtureType -ne "HAPPY_PATH_SANDBOX" })

        foreach ($fx in $negativeFixtures) {
            $result = Invoke-Fixture -FixtureRow $fx -MaterializerScriptPath $script:ResolvedMaterializerScript
            $fixtureResults.Add($result)
        }

        Write-FindingsLedger -Path $script:FindingsLedgerPath
        $script:NegativeFixturesPassed = $false
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "RUN_HAPPY_PATH_SANDBOX_ONLY") {
        throw "REVIEW_RUNNER_HAPPY_PATH_RAN_BEFORE_NEGATIVES"
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "RUN_FULL_COURT_SANDBOX_ONLY") {
        if (-not $script:NegativeFixturesPassed) {
            Write-SelfTestReport -Path $script:ResolvedSelfTestReport -FixtureResults @($fixtureResults) -Verdict "SELFTEST_BLOCKED"
            Write-BlockerReceipt -Path $script:ResolvedBlockerReceipt -Phase "NEGATIVE_FIXTURES" -FailureLabel "REVIEW_RUNNER_NEGATIVE_FIXTURE_SKIPPED_OR_BLOCKED" -Observed "Negative fixtures not passed" -Expected "All 19 negatives pass before happy path"
            Write-CourtReport -Path (Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("REVISED_MATERIALIZER_REVIEW_COURT_REPORT_" + $script:RunIdValue + ".md")) -FinalVerdict "REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKED" -FindingsPath $script:FindingsLedgerPath
            Write-Output "STATUS: REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKED"
            Write-Output "NEXT: MATERIALIZE_FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_SOURCE_PACK_OR_REPAIR_RUNNER"
            exit 20
        }
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "REPORT_ONLY") {
        Write-CourtReport -Path (Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("REVISED_MATERIALIZER_REVIEW_COURT_REPORT_" + $script:RunIdValue + ".md")) -FinalVerdict "REVIEW_COURT_NOT_RUN" -FindingsPath $script:FindingsLedgerPath
        Write-Output "STATUS: REPORT_ONLY_NO_FIXTURES_RUN"
        exit 0
    }
}

try {
    Invoke-Main
}
catch {
    try {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($BlockerReceiptPath)) {
            $resolvedBlocker = Resolve-FullPathStrict $BlockerReceiptPath
            Write-BlockerReceipt -Path $resolvedBlocker -Phase "RUNNER_EXCEPTION" -FailureLabel "REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKED" -Observed $_.Exception.Message -Expected "Clean review runner preconditions"
            Write-Output "STATUS: REVIEW_COURT_BLOCKED"
            Write-Output "BLOCKER_RECEIPT: $resolvedBlocker"
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    }

    Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    exit 30
}
```

## 11AG.4 Draft Honesty Boundary

This is a **runner draft**, not a runner pass.

Known limits:

`RUNNER_NOT_STATIC_REVIEWED`

`RUNNER_NOT_SELFTESTED`

`FIXTURE_PAYLOADS_NOT_MATERIALIZED`

`MATERIALIZER_INVOCATION_DISABLED_BY PAYLOAD ABSENCE`

`STATIC STRUCTURE SCAN IS TEXT-LEVEL, NOT FULL AST-PROVEN`

`COMMENT-ONLY DETECTION IS CONSERVATIVE`

`NO REAL MATERIALIZER RUN PERFORMED`

`NO SANDBOX FIXTURE EXECUTION PERFORMED IN CHAT`

`NO COURT REPORT CREATED IN FILESYSTEM`

These are not optional warnings. They are blockers before use.

## 11AG.5 Required Runner Review Before Use

The runner itself must be reviewed before it can run.

Review must confirm:

`runner cannot accept RUN_REAL_MATERIALIZER mode`

`runner cannot pass real source_body_staging as fixture root`

`runner cannot write source_body_bundle`

`runner cannot write final package files`

`runner cannot write live COMMAND_CENTER`

`runner cannot write live assistant state`

`runner cannot call git commit or git push`

`runner cannot delete/move/archive/restore`

`runner cannot run happy path before negatives`

`runner cannot overclaim SELFTEST_PASS as live approval`

`REVIEW_RUNNER_SCRIPT_SELFTEST_REQUIRED`

`REVIEW_RUNNER_SCRIPT_FORBIDDEN_MODE_PRESENT`

`REVIEW_RUNNER_SCRIPT_FORBIDDEN_WRITE_PRESENT`

`REVIEW_RUNNER_SCRIPT_HAPPY_PATH_ORDER_UNPROVEN`

## 11AG.6 Fixture Payload Gap

The runner draft deliberately blocks fixture execution because the fixture payload source pack has not yet been materialized.

This is correct.

The runner court needs exact fixture inputs:

`old bootstrap shape`

`Controls count ten`

`missing validation ledger`

`blocking validation ledger`

`C002 placeholder content`

`C003 incomplete extraction ledger`

`C008 incomplete rollup ledger`

`control file path separator`

`I014 unplanned body`

`I090 nonempty`

`I120 short stub`

`I002 incomplete manifest`

`existing different control file`

`existing different body file`

`hash ledger row count below 112`

`receipt missing placeholder proof fields`

`forbidden bundle write`

`forbidden live state write`

`forbidden generator chain`

`happy path sandbox exact 112 outputs`

Until those fixture payloads exist, any fixture pass would be fake.

Failure:

`REVIEW_RUNNER_FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_MISSING`

## 11AH.5 Synthetic Body Content Standard

Fixture payloads do not need to carry production command-center content. They need deterministic sandbox test content that satisfies the materializer’s validators.

Body template for ordinary markdown bodies:

```text
# <TargetId> SANDBOX BODY

Status: FIXTURE_SANDBOX_BODY
SchemaName: FIXTURE_BODY
SchemaVersion: V0_1
TargetId: <TargetId>
FamilyId: <FamilyId>

DoesNotProve:
- This sandbox body does not create real staging files.
- This sandbox body does not approve live materializer use.
- This sandbox body does not generate source body bundle.

NextLegalAction:
Use only inside review-court fixture sandbox.
```

Body template for ordinary CSV bodies:

```text
ColumnA,ColumnB,ColumnC,DoesNotProve
```

But CSV bodies that need header-only behavior must remain header-only unless the fixture deliberately tests fake rows.

Body template for ordinary JSON bodies:

```json
{
  "Status": "FIXTURE_SANDBOX_JSON",
  "SchemaName": "FIXTURE_JSON",
  "SchemaVersion": "V0_1",
  "DoesNotProve": [
    "This sandbox JSON does not create real state.",
    "This sandbox JSON does not approve live use."
  ],
  "NextLegalAction": "Use only inside review-court fixture sandbox."
}
```

Empty JSONL bodies:

`I090 = empty string`

`I095 = empty string`

Required marker for those entries:

`EMPTY_JSONL`

Failure labels:

`FIXTURE_BODY_DNP_MISSING`

`FIXTURE_BODY_NEXT_ACTION_MISSING`

`FIXTURE_JSONL_NOT_EMPTY`

## 11AI.6 Draft Script Body

```powershell
<#
SCRIPT PURPOSE:
Build revised materializer fixture payload input files for review-court use.

SCRIPT STATUS:
SCRIPT_DRAFT_NOT_REVIEWED

SCRIPT DOES NOT:
run the review runner, run the materializer, run fixtures, create real source_body_staging files,
generate source body bundle, create final source package files, touch live COMMAND_CENTER, touch live
assistant state, approve live L0, mark fixtures passed, mark review court passed, delete, move, archive,
restore, commit, or push.

MUTATION BOUNDARY:
May write only fixture payload input files under fixtures_payload_source\built_payloads and fixture-payload
receipts/hash ledgers under the approved receipt root.

DOES_NOT_PROVE:
This script draft does not prove payloads were built.
Built payloads do not prove fixtures ran.
Built payloads do not prove materializer safety.
Built payloads do not approve live use.
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateSet("PLAN_ONLY", "PREFLIGHT_ONLY", "BUILD_PAYLOADS", "VALIDATE_PAYLOADS", "REPORT_ONLY")]
    [string]$Mode,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$FixturePayloadManifestPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$NegativeOverridesPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ForbiddenOutputChecksPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$FixturePayloadDnpPath,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$OutputRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ReceiptRoot,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$ReviewedMaterializerScriptTemplatePath = "",

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$RunId = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$script:HashRows = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:Findings = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$script:Created = 0
$script:Matched = 0
$script:Blocked = 0

function New-FixturePayloadRunId {
    return "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_" + (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyyMMddTHHmmssZ")
}

function Resolve-FullPathStrict {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)

    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) {
        throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_BLANK_PATH"
    }

    if ($Path -match "\.\.") {
        throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_PATH_TRAVERSAL_RISK: $Path"
    }

    $bad = @("PASTE_THE_COPIED_PATH_HERE", "TODO_PATH", "CHANGE_ME", "<PATH>", "[PATH]", "C:\path\to")
    foreach ($b in $bad) {
        if ($Path -like "*$b*") {
            throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_PLACEHOLDER_PATH: $Path"
        }
    }

    return [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
}

function Test-InsidePath {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Child,
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Parent
    )

    $c = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Child).TrimEnd('\')
    $p = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Parent).TrimEnd('\')

    if ($c.Equals($p, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
        return $true
    }

    return $c.StartsWith($p + "\", [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
}

function Get-Sha256Bytes {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][byte[]]$Bytes)

    $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
    try {
        return ([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($Bytes))).Replace("-", "")
    }
    finally {
        $sha.Dispose()
    }
}

function Get-FileSha256 {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path)
    return Get-Sha256Bytes -Bytes ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path))
}

function Get-Utf8Bytes {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    return ([System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)).GetBytes($Text)
}

function Get-LineCount {
    param([AllowNull()][string]$Text)

    if ($null -eq $Text -or $Text.Length -eq 0) {
        return 0
    }

    return $Text.Replace("`r`n", "`n").Replace("`r", "`n").Split("`n").Count
}

function Write-Utf8NoBom {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Path,
        [AllowNull()][string]$Text
    )

    if ($null -eq $Text) {
        $Text = ""
    }

    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($Path)) | Out-Null
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
}

function CsvCell {
    param([AllowNull()][object]$Value)

    if ($null -eq $Value) {
        return ""
    }

    $s = [string]$Value
    $e = $s.Replace('"', '""')

    if ($e.Contains(",") -or $e.Contains('"') -or $e.Contains("`r") -or $e.Contains("`n")) {
        return '"' + $e + '"'
    }

    return $e
}

function CsvLine {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][object[]]$Values)
    return (($Values | ForEach-Object { CsvCell $_ }) -join ",")
}

function Add-Finding {
    param(
        [string]$FixtureId,
        [string]$PayloadObject,
        [string]$ValidationType,
        [string]$Expected,
        [string]$Observed,
        [bool]$Pass,
        [string]$FailureLabel,
        [bool]$BlocksRunner,
        [string]$NextLegalAction
    )

    $script:Findings.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        ValidationId = "VAL-" + ($script:Findings.Count + 1).ToString("0000")
        FixtureId = $FixtureId
        PayloadObject = $PayloadObject
        ValidationType = $ValidationType
        Expected = $Expected
        Observed = $Observed
        Pass = $Pass
        FailureLabel = $FailureLabel
        BlocksRunner = $BlocksRunner
        DoesNotProve = "Payload validation row does not prove fixture execution."
        NextLegalAction = $NextLegalAction
    })

    if ($BlocksRunner -and -not $Pass) {
        $script:Blocked++
    }
}

function Add-HashRow {
    param(
        [string]$ArtifactKind,
        [string]$ArtifactPath
    )

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($ArtifactPath)) {
        return
    }

    $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($ArtifactPath)
    $text = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($bytes)

    $script:HashRows.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        RunId = $script:RunIdValue
        ArtifactKind = $ArtifactKind
        ArtifactPath = $ArtifactPath
        SHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes -Bytes $bytes
        Bytes = $bytes.Length
        LineCount = Get-LineCount -Text $text
        Scope = "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_INPUT_ONLY"
        DoesNotProve = "Hash row proves only fixture payload bytes; it does not prove fixture execution or live approval."
    })
}

Use only inside review-court fixture sandbox.

    if ($TargetId -eq "I120") {
```
