function Get-PlannedTargetIds {
    $ids = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]

    foreach ($n in 1..13) { $ids.Add(("I{0:D3}" -f $n)) }
    foreach ($n in 30..38) { $ids.Add(("I{0:D3}" -f $n)) }
    foreach ($n in 40..50) { $ids.Add(("I{0:D3}" -f $n)) }
    foreach ($n in 60..65) { $ids.Add(("I{0:D3}" -f $n)) }
    foreach ($n in 80..115) { $ids.Add(("I{0:D3}" -f $n)) }
    foreach ($n in 120..125) { $ids.Add(("I{0:D3}" -f $n)) }
    foreach ($n in 130..144) { $ids.Add(("I{0:D3}" -f $n)) }
    foreach ($n in 150..154) { $ids.Add(("I{0:D3}" -f $n)) }

    return @($ids)
}

function Get-FamilyId {
    param([string]$TargetId)

    $n = [int]$TargetId.Substring(1)
    if ($n -ge 1 -and $n -le 13) { return "CORE_CONTROL" }
    if ($n -ge 30 -and $n -le 38) { return "FRONT_DOOR" }
    if ($n -ge 40 -and $n -le 50) { return "BACKSTAGE_MARKDOWN" }
    if ($n -ge 60 -and $n -le 65) { return "STARTER_JSON_STATE" }
    if ($n -ge 80 -and $n -le 115) { return "CSV_JSONL" }
    if ($n -ge 120 -and $n -le 125) { return "SCRIPT_REVIEW_SUPPORT" }
    if ($n -ge 130 -and $n -le 144) { return "FIXTURES" }
    if ($n -ge 150 -and $n -le 154) { return "RECEIPT_CLOSEOUT" }

    return "UNKNOWN"
}

function New-BodyEntry {
    param(
        [string]$TargetId,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes -Text $Text
    $markers = @("DoesNotProve")
    if ($TargetId -eq "I090" -or $TargetId -eq "I095") {
        $markers = @("EMPTY_JSONL")
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        TargetId = $TargetId
        FamilyId = Get-FamilyId $TargetId
        BodyFile = "$TargetId.body"
        SourceBatch = "11AH-11AI"
        SourceSubPacket = "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD"
        ExtractionBoundary = "SYNTHETIC_SANDBOX_ONLY"
        MayBeBlank = (($TargetId -eq "I090") -or ($TargetId -eq "I095"))
        ContentUtf8Base64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
        ExpectedSHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes -Bytes $bytes
        ExpectedByteCount = $bytes.Length
        ExpectedLineCount = Get-LineCount -Text $Text
        RequiredMarkers = $markers
        DoesNotProve = @("Fixture body entry does not prove fixture execution or live approval.")
    }
}

function New-ControlEntry {
    param(
        [string]$ControlId,
        [string]$ControlFile,
        [string]$Text
    )

    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes -Text $Text

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        ControlId = $ControlId
        ControlFile = $ControlFile
        ControlRole = "FIXTURE_STAGING_CONTROL"
        SourceBatch = "11AH-11AI"
        SourceSection = "CONTROL_PAYLOAD_STANDARD"
        MayBeBlank = $false
        ContentUtf8Base64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
        ExpectedSHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes -Bytes $bytes
        ExpectedByteCount = $bytes.Length
        ExpectedLineCount = Get-LineCount -Text $Text
        RequiredMarkers = @("DoesNotProve")
        DoesNotProve = @("Fixture control entry does not prove fixture execution or live approval.")
    }
}

function New-BaselineBootstrap {
    $bodyEntries = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($id in Get-PlannedTargetIds) {
        $bodyEntries.Add((New-BodyEntry -TargetId $id -Text (New-BodyText -TargetId $id -FamilyId (Get-FamilyId $id))))
    }

    $controls = @(
        @("C001", "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_PACKET__COMMAND_CENTER_SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_V0_1.md"),
        @("C002", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_INDEX.csv"),
        @("C003", "SOURCE_BODY_EXTRACTION_LEDGER.csv"),
        @("C004", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_VALIDATION_LEDGER.csv"),
        @("C005", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_DOES_NOT_PROVE.md"),
        @("C006", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_FAMILY_MATRIX.csv"),
        @("C007", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_INTENTIONAL_GAPS.csv"),
        @("C008", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_ROLLUP_LEDGER.csv"),
        @("C009", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_GENERATOR_GATE.md"),
        @("C010", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_ROLLUP_REPORT.md"),
        @("C011", "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_ROLLUP_BLOCKER_RECEIPT.md")
    )

    $controlEntries = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
    foreach ($c in $controls) {
        $controlEntries.Add((New-ControlEntry -ControlId $c[0] -ControlFile $c[1] -Text (New-ControlText -ControlId $c[0] -ControlFile $c[1])))
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        SchemaName = "COMMAND_CENTER_STAGING_BOOTSTRAP_BODY_INPUT"
        SchemaVersion = "V0_1"
        Status = "BOOTSTRAP_BODY_INPUT_NOT_EXECUTED"
        BundleId = "FIXTURE_BASELINE_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT"
        SourceDesign = "OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2 / 11AH-11AI"
        Encoding = "UTF8_BASE64"
        BodyCountExpected = 101
        ControlCountExpected = 11
        IntentionalGapCountExpected = 7
        FamilyCountExpected = 8
        DoesNotProve = @(
            "Fixture bootstrap input does not create staging files.",
            "Fixture bootstrap input does not prove fixture execution.",
            "Fixture bootstrap input does not approve live use."
        )
        Bodies = @($bodyEntries)
        Controls = @($controlEntries)
    }
}

function Apply-Override {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$Bootstrap,
        [string]$OverrideApplied
    )

    $clone = $Bootstrap | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50 | ConvertFrom-Json

    switch ($OverrideApplied) {
        "NONE" { return $clone }

        "REMOVE_CONTROLS_ARRAY" {
            $clone.PSObject.Properties.Remove("Controls")
            return $clone
        }

        "REMOVE_C011_CONTROL" {
            $clone.Controls = @($clone.Controls | Where-Object { $_.ControlId -ne "C011" })
            return $clone
        }

        "REPLACE_C002_WITH_PLACEHOLDER" {
            foreach ($c in $clone.Controls) {
                if ($c.ControlId -eq "C002") {
                    $text = "PLACEHOLDER CONTROL CONTENT`r`nDoesNotProve: placeholder only"
                    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes $text
                    $c.ContentUtf8Base64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
                    $c.ExpectedSHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes $bytes
                    $c.ExpectedByteCount = $bytes.Length
                    $c.ExpectedLineCount = Get-LineCount $text
                }
            }
            return $clone
        }

        "REMOVE_C003_EXTRACTION_ANCHOR_I144" {
            foreach ($c in $clone.Controls) {
                if ($c.ControlId -eq "C003") {
                    $text = (New-ControlText "C003" "SOURCE_BODY_EXTRACTION_LEDGER.csv").Replace("EXT-I144,I144,Fixture extraction row`r`n", "")
                    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes $text
                    $c.ContentUtf8Base64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
                    $c.ExpectedSHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes $bytes
                    $c.ExpectedByteCount = $bytes.Length
                    $c.ExpectedLineCount = Get-LineCount $text
                }
            }
            return $clone
        }

        "REMOVE_C008_ROLLUP_ANCHOR_I120" {
            foreach ($c in $clone.Controls) {
                if ($c.ControlId -eq "C008") {
                    $text = (New-ControlText "C008" "SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_ROLLUP_LEDGER.csv").Replace("R-I120,I120,Fixture rollup row`r`n", "")
                    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes $text
                    $c.ContentUtf8Base64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
                    $c.ExpectedSHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes $bytes
                    $c.ExpectedByteCount = $bytes.Length
                    $c.ExpectedLineCount = Get-LineCount $text
                }
            }
            return $clone
        }

        "SET_C006_CONTROLFILE_WITH_SEPARATOR" {
            foreach ($c in $clone.Controls) {
                if ($c.ControlId -eq "C006") {
                    $c.ControlFile = "bad\path\SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_FAMILY_MATRIX.csv"
                }
            }
            return $clone
        }

        "ADD_I014_BODY" {
            $entry = New-BodyEntry -TargetId "I014" -Text (New-BodyText -TargetId "I014" -FamilyId "UNPLANNED")
            $clone.Bodies = @($clone.Bodies) + @($entry)
            return $clone
        }

        "SET_I090_TO_NONEMPTY_ARRAY" {
            foreach ($b in $clone.Bodies) {
                if ($b.TargetId -eq "I090") {
                    $text = "[]"
                    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes $text
                    $b.ContentUtf8Base64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
                    $b.ExpectedSHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes $bytes
                    $b.ExpectedByteCount = $bytes.Length
                    $b.ExpectedLineCount = Get-LineCount $text
                }
            }
            return $clone
        }

        "REPLACE_I120_WITH_SHORT_STUB" {
            foreach ($b in $clone.Bodies) {
                if ($b.TargetId -eq "I120") {
                    $text = "SCRIPT PURPOSE:`r`nshort stub"
                    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes $text
                    $b.ContentUtf8Base64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
                    $b.ExpectedSHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes $bytes
                    $b.ExpectedByteCount = $bytes.Length
                    $b.ExpectedLineCount = Get-LineCount $text
                }
            }
            return $clone
        }

        "REMOVE_I002_ANCHOR_I144" {
            foreach ($b in $clone.Bodies) {
                if ($b.TargetId -eq "I002") {
                    $text = (New-BodyText -TargetId "I002" -FamilyId "CORE_CONTROL").Replace("I144`r`n", "")
                    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes $text
                    $b.ContentUtf8Base64 = [System.Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
                    $b.ExpectedSHA256 = Get-Sha256Bytes $bytes
                    $b.ExpectedByteCount = $bytes.Length
                    $b.ExpectedLineCount = Get-LineCount $text
                }
            }
            return $clone
        }

        default {
            return $clone
        }
    }
}

function New-ValidationLedger {
    param(
        [string]$FixtureId,
        [string]$OverrideApplied
    )

    if ($OverrideApplied -eq "OMIT_VALIDATION_LEDGER") {
        return $null
    }

    $passValue = "true"
    $blocks = "false"
    $failure = ""

    if ($OverrideApplied -eq "SET_BLOCKING_VALIDATION_FAIL") {
        $passValue = "false"
        $blocks = "true"
        $failure = "MATERIALIZER_BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION_BLOCKED"
    }

    $required = @(
        "BODY_COUNT_101",
        "CONTROL_COUNT_11",
        "I002_COMPOSITE_COMPLETE",
        "I120_NOT_STUB",
        "CONTROL_INDEX_COMPLETE",
        "CONTROL_EXTRACTION_LEDGER_COMPLETE",
        "CONTROL_ROLLUP_LEDGER_COMPLETE",
        "FALSE_CLAIM_ABSENT",
        "NO_STAGING_BODY_FILES_WRITTEN",
        "NO_SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_WRITTEN",
        "NO_EXECUTION_CHAIN_STARTED"
    )

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("ValidationId,EntryKind,EntryId,FileName,ValidationType,Expected,Observed,Pass,FailureLabel,BlocksMaterializer,DoesNotProve,NextLegalAction")

    foreach ($t in $required) {
        $lines.Add((CsvLine @(
            "VAL-$FixtureId-$t",
            "FIXTURE",
            $FixtureId,
            "BootstrapInput.json",
            $t,
            "pass",
            $(if ($passValue -eq "true") { "pass" } else { "blocking fail" }),
            $passValue,
            $failure,
            $blocks,
            "Validation ledger row does not prove materializer execution.",
            "Use only inside review-court fixture sandbox."
        )))
    }

    return (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
}

function New-MaterializationManifest {
    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("TargetId,OutputPath,OutputKind,FamilyId,SourceBatch,SourceSubPacket,ContentSource,MayBeBlank,MayOverwrite,IfExistsAction,RequiresHash,RequiresValidation,BlockedFromBundleGeneration,DoesNotProve")
    foreach ($id in Get-PlannedTargetIds) {
        $lines.Add((CsvLine @($id, "$id.body", "BODY_FILE", (Get-FamilyId $id), "11AH-11AI", "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD", "BootstrapInput", (($id -eq "I090") -or ($id -eq "I095")), "false", "SKIP_IF_EXACT_MATCH_BLOCK_IF_DIFFERENT", "true", "true", "false", "Manifest row does not prove fixture execution.")))
    }
    return (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
}

function New-ExpectedResultJson {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]$ManifestRow
    )

    $obj = [pscustomobject]@{
        SchemaName = "FIXTURE_EXPECTED_RESULT"
        SchemaVersion = "V0_1"
        Status = "EXPECTED_RESULT_ONLY_NOT_EXECUTED"
        FixtureId = [string]$ManifestRow.FixtureId
        FixtureName = [string]$ManifestRow.FixtureName
        ExpectedMode = [string]$ManifestRow.ExpectedMode
        ExpectedExitCode = [int]$ManifestRow.ExpectedExitCode
        ExpectedFailureLabel = [string]$ManifestRow.ExpectedFailureLabel
        ExpectedReceiptType = $(if ([string]$ManifestRow.ExpectedFailureLabel -eq "NO_FAILURE") { "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_RECEIPT" } else { "STAGING_MATERIALIZATION_BLOCKER_RECEIPT" })
        ExpectedForbiddenFilesCreated = 0
        DoesNotProve = @("Expected result does not prove observed fixture execution or live approval.")
    }

    return ($obj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20)
}

function New-ExistingFileSetupJson {
    param([string]$OverrideApplied)

    $items = @()

    if ($OverrideApplied -eq "PRECREATE_DIFFERENT_C002") {
        $items += [pscustomobject]@{
            Path = "source_body_staging\SOURCE_BODY_STAGING_INDEX.csv"
            Content = "DIFFERENT_CONTROL_CONTENT"
            ExpectedFailureLabel = "MATERIALIZER_EXISTING_CONTROL_DIFF_BLOCK"
            DoesNotProve = @("Existing file setup does not prove fixture execution.")
        }
    }

    if ($OverrideApplied -eq "PRECREATE_DIFFERENT_I001") {
        $items += [pscustomobject]@{
            Path = "source_body_staging\I001.body"
            Content = "DIFFERENT_BODY_CONTENT"
            ExpectedFailureLabel = "MATERIALIZER_EXISTING_BODY_DIFF_BLOCK"
            DoesNotProve = @("Existing file setup does not prove fixture execution.")
        }
    }

    return ([pscustomobject]@{
        SchemaName = "FIXTURE_EXISTING_FILE_SETUP"
        SchemaVersion = "V0_1"
        Status = "SETUP_DEFINITION_NOT_EXECUTED"
        Items = $items
        DoesNotProve = @("Existing file setup definition does not create files.")
    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20)
}

function New-StaticScriptMutationJson {
    param([string]$OverrideApplied)

    $mutation = ""

    if ($OverrideApplied -eq "MUTATE_SCRIPT_ADD_BUNDLE_WRITE") { $mutation = "source_body_bundle" }
    if ($OverrideApplied -eq "MUTATE_SCRIPT_ADD_ACTIVE_OBJECT_WRITE") { $mutation = "ACTIVE_OBJECT.json" }
    if ($OverrideApplied -eq "MUTATE_SCRIPT_ADD_START_PROCESS") { $mutation = "Start-Process" }

    return ([pscustomobject]@{
        SchemaName = "FIXTURE_STATIC_SCRIPT_MUTATION"
        SchemaVersion = "V0_1"
        Status = "MUTATION_DEFINITION_NOT_EXECUTED"
        MutationText = $mutation
        MutateRealScript = $false
        DoesNotProve = @("Static script mutation definition does not modify the real script.")
    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20)
}

function Write-OrBlockIfDifferent {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Text,
        [string]$ArtifactKind
    )

    if (-not (Test-InsidePath -Child $Path -Parent $script:ResolvedOutputRoot)) {
        throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_OUTPUT_OUTSIDE_ROOT: $Path"
    }

    $bytes = Get-Utf8Bytes $Text
    $sha = Get-Sha256Bytes $bytes

    if ([System.IO.File]::Exists($Path)) {
        $pre = Get-FileSha256 $Path
        if ($pre -ne $sha) {
            throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_EXISTING_DIFF_BLOCK: $Path"
        }
        $script:Matched++
    }
    else {
        Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $Text
        $script:Created++
    }

    Add-HashRow -ArtifactKind $ArtifactKind -ArtifactPath $Path
}

function Write-ValidationLedger {
    param([string]$Path)

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("ValidationId,FixtureId,PayloadObject,ValidationType,Expected,Observed,Pass,FailureLabel,BlocksRunner,DoesNotProve,NextLegalAction")

    foreach ($f in $script:Findings) {
        $lines.Add((CsvLine @($f.ValidationId,$f.FixtureId,$f.PayloadObject,$f.ValidationType,$f.Expected,$f.Observed,$f.Pass,$f.FailureLabel,$f.BlocksRunner,$f.DoesNotProve,$f.NextLegalAction)))
    }

    Write-OrBlockIfDifferent -Path $Path -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n") -ArtifactKind "PAYLOAD_VALIDATION_LEDGER"
}

function Write-HashLedger {
    param([string]$Path)

    $lines = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
    $lines.Add("RunId,ArtifactKind,ArtifactPath,SHA256,Bytes,LineCount,Scope,DoesNotProve")

    foreach ($r in $script:HashRows) {
        $lines.Add((CsvLine @($r.RunId,$r.ArtifactKind,$r.ArtifactPath,$r.SHA256,$r.Bytes,$r.LineCount,$r.Scope,$r.DoesNotProve)))
    }

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text (($lines -join "`r`n") + "`r`n")
}

function Write-Report {
    param(
        [string]$Path,
        [string]$Verdict
    )

    $text = @"
# FIXTURE PAYLOAD BUILD REPORT

Status: $Verdict
SchemaName: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_REPORT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

RunId: $($script:RunIdValue)
CreatedUtc: $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o"))
OutputRoot: $($script:ResolvedOutputRoot)
ReceiptRoot: $($script:ResolvedReceiptRoot)

PayloadsExpected: 20
FilesCreatedOrMatched: $($script:Created + $script:Matched)
CreatedFiles: $script:Created
MatchedFiles: $script:Matched
BlockedFindings: $script:Blocked

RunnerRunAttempted: false
MaterializerRunAttempted: false
RealStagingRootTouched: false
SourceBodyBundleGenerated: false
FinalPackageFilesCreated: false
LiveCommandCenterTouched: false
LiveStateTouched: false
ReviewCourtPassClaimed: false
LiveUseApproved: false

FinalVerdict: $Verdict

Allowed FinalVerdicts:
- FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_BLOCKED
- FIXTURE_PAYLOADS_BUILT_PENDING_VALIDATION
- FIXTURE_PAYLOADS_VALIDATED_FOR_REVIEW_RUNNER_INPUT_ONLY

Forbidden FinalVerdicts:
- FIXTURES_RUN
- NEGATIVE_FIXTURES_PASS
- HAPPY_PATH_PASS
- REVIEW_COURT_PASS
- MATERIALIZER_APPROVED
- SAFE
- DONE

DoesNotProve:
- This report does not prove fixture execution.
- This report does not run the review runner.
- This report does not run the materializer.
- This report does not approve live use.

NextLegalAction:
Review and self-test the fixture payload builder, then use built payloads only as review-court inputs.
"@

    Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $Path -Text $text
}

function Invoke-Main {
    $script:RunIdValue = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-FixturePayloadRunId } else { $RunId }

    $manifestPath = Resolve-FullPathStrict $FixturePayloadManifestPath
    $overridesPath = Resolve-FullPathStrict $NegativeOverridesPath
    $forbiddenPath = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ForbiddenOutputChecksPath
    $dnpPath = Resolve-FullPathStrict $FixturePayloadDnpPath
    $script:ResolvedOutputRoot = Resolve-FullPathStrict $OutputRoot
    $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot = Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReceiptRoot

    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($manifestPath)) { throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_INPUT_MISSING: manifest" }
    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($overridesPath)) { throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_INPUT_MISSING: overrides" }
    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($forbiddenPath)) { throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_INPUT_MISSING: forbidden checks" }
    if (-not [System.IO.File]::Exists($dnpPath)) { throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_INPUT_MISSING: dnp" }

    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedOutputRoot) | Out-Null
    [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($script:ResolvedReceiptRoot) | Out-Null

    $manifest = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $manifestPath)
    if ($manifest.Count -ne 20) {
        throw "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_MANIFEST_COUNT_MISMATCH"
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "PLAN_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PLAN_ONLY_NO_PAYLOADS_BUILT"
        Write-Output "EXPECTED_FIXTURES: 20"
        Write-Output "NEXT: PREFLIGHT_ONLY"
        exit 0
    }

    $baseline = New-BaselineBootstrap
    Add-Finding "BASELINE" "BootstrapInput" "BASELINE_BODY_COUNT_101" "101" "$(@($baseline.Bodies).Count)" (@($baseline.Bodies).Count -eq 101) "FIXTURE_BASELINE_BODY_COUNT_FAIL" $true "Repair baseline body construction."
    Add-Finding "BASELINE" "BootstrapInput" "BASELINE_CONTROL_COUNT_11" "11" "$(@($baseline.Controls).Count)" (@($baseline.Controls).Count -eq 11) "FIXTURE_BASELINE_CONTROL_COUNT_FAIL" $true "Repair baseline control construction."

    if ($Mode -eq "PREFLIGHT_ONLY") {
        Write-Output "STATUS: PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE_NO_PAYLOADS_BUILT"
        Write-Output "NEXT: BUILD_PAYLOADS"
        exit 0
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "BUILD_PAYLOADS" -or $Mode -eq "VALIDATE_PAYLOADS") {
        foreach ($row in $manifest) {
            $fixtureId = [string]$row.FixtureId
            $override = [string]$row.OverrideApplied
            $fixtureRoot = Join-Path $script:ResolvedOutputRoot $fixtureId

            $bootstrap = Apply-Override -Bootstrap $baseline -OverrideApplied $override
            $bootstrapJson = $bootstrap | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 100
            Write-OrBlockIfDifferent -Path (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "BootstrapInput.json") -Text $bootstrapJson -ArtifactKind "BOOTSTRAP_INPUT"

            $ledger = New-ValidationLedger -FixtureId $fixtureId -OverrideApplied $override
            if ($null -ne $ledger) {
                Write-OrBlockIfDifferent -Path (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "BootstrapValidationLedger.csv") -Text $ledger -ArtifactKind "BOOTSTRAP_VALIDATION_LEDGER"
            }

            Write-OrBlockIfDifferent -Path (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "StagingMaterializationManifest.csv") -Text (New-MaterializationManifest) -ArtifactKind "MATERIALIZATION_MANIFEST"
            Write-OrBlockIfDifferent -Path (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "ExpectedResult.json") -Text (New-ExpectedResultJson -ManifestRow $row) -ArtifactKind "EXPECTED_RESULT"
            Write-OrBlockIfDifferent -Path (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "ExistingFileSetup.json") -Text (New-ExistingFileSetupJson -OverrideApplied $override) -ArtifactKind "EXISTING_FILE_SETUP"
            Write-OrBlockIfDifferent -Path (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "StaticScriptMutation.json") -Text (New-StaticScriptMutationJson -OverrideApplied $override) -ArtifactKind "STATIC_SCRIPT_MUTATION"
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath $forbiddenPath -Destination (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "ForbiddenOutputChecks.csv") -ErrorAction Stop
            Add-HashRow -ArtifactKind "FORBIDDEN_OUTPUT_CHECKS" -ArtifactPath (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "ForbiddenOutputChecks.csv")

            $receipt = @"
# FIXTURE PAYLOAD RECEIPT

Status: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILT_NOT_EXECUTED
SchemaName: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
FixtureId: $fixtureId
OverrideApplied: $override

RunnerRunAttempted: false
MaterializerRunAttempted: false
FixtureExecuted: false
ReviewCourtPassClaimed: false
LiveUseApproved: false

DoesNotProve:
- This receipt does not prove fixture execution.
- This receipt does not prove expected failure was observed.
- This receipt does not approve live use.

NextLegalAction:
Use this payload only as input to the review runner sandbox fixture court.
"@
            Write-OrBlockIfDifferent -Path (Join-Path $fixtureRoot "FixturePayloadReceipt.md") -Text $receipt -ArtifactKind "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_RECEIPT"
        }

        $validationLedger = Join-Path $script:ResolvedOutputRoot "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_VALIDATION_LEDGER_V0_1.csv"
        Write-ValidationLedger -Path $validationLedger

        $hashLedger = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_HASH_LEDGER_" + $script:RunIdValue + ".csv")
        Write-HashLedger -Path $hashLedger

        $verdict = if ($script:Blocked -gt 0) { "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_BLOCKED" } else { "FIXTURE_PAYLOADS_BUILT_PENDING_VALIDATION" }
        $report = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_REPORT_" + $script:RunIdValue + ".md")
        Write-Report -Path $report -Verdict $verdict

        Write-Output "STATUS: $verdict"
        Write-Output "REPORT: $report"
        Write-Output "HASH_LEDGER: $hashLedger"
        Write-Output "NEXT: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_STATIC_REVIEW_AND_SELFTEST"
        exit 0
    }

    if ($Mode -eq "REPORT_ONLY") {
        $report = Join-Path $script:ResolvedReceiptRoot ("FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_REPORT_" + $script:RunIdValue + ".md")
        Write-Report -Path $report -Verdict "FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_REPORT_ONLY"
        Write-Output "STATUS: REPORT_ONLY"
        exit 0
    }
}

try {
    Invoke-Main
}
catch {
    try {
        $rr = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ReceiptRoot)) { "" } else { Resolve-FullPathStrict $ReceiptRoot }
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($rr)) {
            [System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($rr) | Out-Null
            $blocker = Join-Path $rr ("FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BLOCKER_RECEIPT_" + (if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($RunId)) { New-FixturePayloadRunId } else { $RunId }) + ".md")
            Write-Utf8NoBom -Path $blocker -Text @"
# FIXTURE PAYLOAD BLOCKER RECEIPT

Status: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BLOCKED
SchemaName: REVISED_MATERIALIZER_FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BLOCKER_RECEIPT
SchemaVersion: V0_1
Role: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BLOCKER_EVIDENCE
OwnerLayer: BUILD_HARNESS
ActivationLevel: NOT_LIVE_L0
MutationAuthorized: false

FailureLabel: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_BLOCKED
Observed: $($_.Exception.Message)
Expected: Clean fixture payload build preconditions

RunnerRunAttempted: false
MaterializerRunAttempted: false
RealStagingRootTouched: false
SourceBodyBundleGenerated: false
LiveStateTouched: false

DoesNotProve:
- This blocker receipt does not repair fixture payloads.
- No review runner execution may proceed from blocked fixture payloads.
"@
            Write-Output "STATUS: FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILD_BLOCKED"
            Write-Output "BLOCKER_RECEIPT: $blocker"
        }
    }
    catch {
        Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    }

    Write-Error $_.Exception.Message
    exit 30
}
```

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AK — Fixture Payload Builder Use Approval Packet / One-Time Payload Build Only / No Review Runner Execution

Batch 11AJ created the review/self-test court around the fixture payload builder. Batch 11AK defines the approval packet that can authorize exactly one payload build attempt after that court passes.

This is not a general approval. It is not approval to run the review runner. It is not approval to run the materializer. It is not approval to create real staging files. It is only a one-time approval packet for building fixture payload input files.

Core rule:

`ONE-TIME PAYLOAD BUILD APPROVAL != REVIEW RUNNER APPROVAL.`
`ONE-TIME PAYLOAD BUILD APPROVAL != MATERIALIZER APPROVAL.`
`ONE-TIME PAYLOAD BUILD APPROVAL != FIXTURE EXECUTION.`
`ONE-TIME PAYLOAD BUILD APPROVAL MAY ONLY AUTHORIZE BUILT_PAYLOADS OUTPUT.`
`NO REAL SOURCE_BODY_STAGING FILES MAY BE CREATED.`

---

## 11AK.1 Parent Rule

`FIXTURE_PAYLOAD_BUILDER_USE_REQUIRES_ONE_TIME_APPROVAL_AFTER_REVIEW_SELFTEST_V0_1`

Wording:

`The fixture payload builder may be used only after its static review and self-test evidence pass. Approval must be one-time, scoped to a specific reviewed script hash, specific input files, specific output root, specific receipt root, and specific allowed mode. The approval may authorize BUILD_PAYLOADS or VALIDATE_PAYLOADS only for fixture payload inputs under fixtures_payload_source\built_payloads. It may not authorize review runner execution, materializer execution, fixture execution, source-body bundle generation, final package creation, real source_body_staging writes, live command center writes, live state writes, git mutation, cleanup, archive, delete, move, safe, done, or MVP activation.`

This blocks:

`using builder repeatedly from one pass`

`using unreviewed script`

`using changed script after review`

`changing input manifest after approval`

`building payloads into review sandbox execution root`

`building payloads into real staging root`

`running runner immediately after payload build`

`claiming payloads passed review court`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AL — Payload Build Judge Packet / Verify Built Payloads Before Review Runner Input / No Runner Execution

Batch 11AK allowed, in design, a one-time payload build after review/self-test approval. Batch 11AL handles the next custody gap:

`BUILT PAYLOADS ARE NOT AUTOMATICALLY TRUSTED.`

A payload build may create files, but those files still need a judge before the review runner can consume them. The judge verifies count, scope, hashes, forbidden outputs, no-execution claims, expected fixture structure, and no overclaim.

Core rule:

`PAYLOAD BUILD RECEIPT != PAYLOAD BUILD JUDGED.`
`BUILT PAYLOADS != REVIEW RUNNER INPUT APPROVED.`
`PAYLOAD JUDGE DOES NOT RUN REVIEW RUNNER.`
`PAYLOAD JUDGE DOES NOT RUN MATERIALIZER.`
`PAYLOAD JUDGE DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE USE.`

---

## 11AL.1 Parent Rule

`BUILT_FIXTURE_PAYLOADS_MUST_BE_JUDGED_BEFORE_REVIEW_RUNNER_CAN_CONSUME_THEM_V0_1`

Wording:

`After a fixture payload builder run, the built payload output must be judged before any review runner may consume it. The judge must verify approval scope, script/input hashes, output root, receipt root, fixture folder count, required payload files, expected negative overrides, happy-path baseline, forbidden-output absence, no review-runner execution, no materializer execution, no fixture execution, no source-body bundle generation, no real source_body_staging writes, no live state touch, no git mutation, and no overclaim. A passing judge may approve payloads only as review-runner input candidates, not as fixture pass, review court pass, materializer approval, live L0 approval, safe, done, or MVP active.`

This blocks:

`runner consumes unjudged payloads`

`payload build report treated as enough`

`missing fixture folder hidden`

`bad override silently accepted`

`source_body_bundle accidental output ignored`

`review sandbox execution files mixed into payload output`

`payload judge approves materializer`

## 11AM.1 Parent Rule

`REVIEW_RUNNER_MAY_CONSUME_JUDGED_PAYLOADS_ONLY_THROUGH_BOUND_INPUT_PACKET_V0_1`

`The review runner may consume built fixture payloads only through a review-runner input packet that binds a passing payload build judge report, judged payload root, reviewed runner script hash, reviewed materializer script hash, fixture manifest hash, expected results hash, sandbox root, receipt root, and one court run ID. This packet may prepare inputs for one sandbox review court run only. It may not execute the runner, execute the materializer, create real source_body_staging files, generate source body bundle, create final package files, touch live state, approve live L0, or claim fixture/review/materializer pass.`

`runner consumes unjudged payloads`

`runner runs with changed script after packet`

`runner uses real source_body_staging as sandbox`

`runner reuses packet for multiple court runs`

`runner court pass treated as live materializer approval`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AN — Review Runner One-Time Sandbox Approval Packet / Run Court Once / No Live Materializer Use

Batch 11AM created the bound input packet. Batch 11AN defines the approval gate that may later allow the review runner to run exactly one sandbox review court.

This is still not execution. It does not run the review runner. It does not run the materializer. It does not create sandbox fixture outputs. It does not approve live materializer use.

Core rule:

`INPUT PACKET READY != RUNNER EXECUTION APPROVED.`
`REVIEW RUNNER APPROVAL IS ONE-TIME AND SANDBOX-ONLY.`
`SANDBOX MATERIALIZER INVOCATION IS NOT LIVE MATERIALIZER USE.`
`COURT PASS, IF LATER OBSERVED, DOES NOT APPROVE SOURCE BODY BUNDLE GENERATION.`
`NO REAL SOURCE_BODY_STAGING MAY BE TOUCHED.`

---

## 11AN.1 Parent Rule

`REVIEW_RUNNER_SANDBOX_COURT_REQUIRES_ONE_TIME_APPROVAL_AFTER_BOUND_INPUT_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`The review runner may execute one sandbox court only after a bound review-runner input packet passes, the runner script hash is fixed, the materializer script hash is fixed, the judged payload root is fixed, the sandbox root is fixed, and the court run ID is fixed. The approval may authorize static review and fixture execution only inside the approved sandbox root. It may not authorize real source_body_staging writes, source-body bundle generation, final package creation, live COMMAND_CENTER writes, live assistant state writes, live L0 approval, repeated execution, cleanup, archive, delete, move, git mutation, safe, done, or MVP activation.`

This blocks:

`running the review runner from only the input packet`

`changing sandbox root after approval`

`changing runner script after approval`

`changing materializer script after approval`

`using real staging root as fixture root`

`running court twice under the same approval`

`treating sandbox court pass as live approval`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AO — Review Court Judge Packet / Judge Sandbox Court Results Before Materializer Use Approval / No Live Use

Batch 11AN defined one-time sandbox court approval. Batch 11AO closes the next custody gap:

`SANDBOX COURT RUN != MATERIALIZER USE APPROVAL.`

Even if the review runner later completes static review and sandbox fixtures, the result must be judged before any real staging materializer use packet can be prepared.

Core rule:

`REVIEW COURT OUTPUT IS EVIDENCE, NOT AUTHORITY.`
`SANDBOX PASS DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE MATERIALIZER USE.`
`COURT JUDGE DOES NOT RUN THE MATERIALIZER.`
`COURT JUDGE DOES NOT GENERATE SOURCE BODY BUNDLE.`
`COURT JUDGE DOES NOT CREATE FINAL PACKAGE FILES.`
`COURT JUDGE MAY ONLY DECIDE WHETHER A LATER MATERIALIZER USE APPROVAL PACKET MAY BE PREPARED.`

---

## 11AO.1 Parent Rule

`REVIEW_COURT_RESULTS_MUST_BE_JUDGED_BEFORE_STAGING_MATERIALIZER_USE_APPROVAL_V0_1`

Wording:

`After a one-time sandbox review court run, the resulting reports, findings ledgers, fixture receipts, fixture hash ledgers, sandbox outputs, and blocker receipts must be judged before any staging materializer use approval packet may be prepared. The judge must verify static review result, negative fixture order and failure labels, happy-path sandbox result, fixture-local materializer boundaries, no real source_body_staging touch, no source body bundle generation, no final package creation, no live state touch, no git mutation, receipt honesty, hash custody, and no overclaim. A passing judge may only authorize preparation of a one-time staging materializer use approval packet. It may not approve materializer use directly.`

This blocks:

`review court pass treated as live approval`

`happy path sandbox treated as production proof`

`negative fixture skipped`

`wrong failure label accepted`

`fixture writes outside sandbox ignored`

`source body bundle created during court`

`materializer use packet prepared from blocked court`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AP — Staging Materializer One-Time Use Approval Packet / Real Source Body Staging Creation Only / No Bundle Generation

Batch 11AO defined the review-court judge. Batch 11AP defines the first packet that may later authorize the revised staging materializer to touch the real `source_body_staging` lane.

This is the narrowest real-use approval so far.

It does not generate the source body bundle.
It does not create final build-harness package files.
It does not run the source writer.
It does not run the L0 harness.
It does not touch live `COMMAND_CENTER`.
It does not activate MVP.

Core rule:

`REVIEW COURT READY != MATERIALIZER RUN.`
`MATERIALIZER APPROVAL IS ONE-TIME AND EXACT-SCOPE.`
`REAL STAGING MATERIALIZATION CREATES SOURCE_BODY_STAGING INPUTS ONLY.`
`SOURCE_BODY_STAGING INPUTS ARE NOT SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE.`
`NO BUNDLE GENERATION FROM THIS PACKET.`

## 11AP.1 Parent Rule

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_REAL_USE_REQUIRES_ONE_TIME_APPROVAL_AFTER_REVIEW_COURT_JUDGE_V0_1`

Wording:

`The revised staging materializer may run against the real build-harness source_body_staging lane only after the sandbox review court has been judged ready, the materializer script hash is fixed, the bootstrap body input hash is fixed, the bootstrap validation ledger hash is fixed, the staging materialization manifest hash is fixed, the staging root is fixed, the receipt root is fixed, and one run ID is fixed. The approval may authorize creation or exact-match verification of source_body_staging controls and body files only. It may not authorize source body bundle generation, source package creation, harness execution, final template creation, live command center mutation, live state mutation, git mutation, cleanup, delete, move, archive, restore, safe, done, or MVP activation.`

This blocks:

`materializer run from sandbox pass alone`

`changed materializer script after review`

`changed bootstrap input after approval`

`changed staging root after approval`

`bundle generator starts after materializer`

`source writer starts after materializer`

`real staging files treated as final package`

`materializer pass treated as MVP active`

## 11AP.6 Existing File Policy

The materializer may:

```text
create missing approved staging files
skip exact pre-existing approved staging files
block on different pre-existing approved staging files
```

The materializer may not:

```text
overwrite
append
merge
move aside
backup-and-replace
delete
autoclean
repair body content
repair control content
invent missing content
substitute placeholder content
```

Failure labels:

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_USE_EXISTING_DIFF_BLOCK_REQUIRED`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_USE_OVERWRITE_ATTEMPT`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_USE_APPEND_ATTEMPT`

`STAGING_MATERIALIZER_USE_AUTOCLEAN_ATTEMPT`

merge
move aside

delete
autoclean
repair body content
repair control content
placeholder substitution

PreSHA256
PostSHA256
CreatedOrMatched

RollbackAttempted: false

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AS — Source Body Bundle Judge Packet / Verify Bundle Before Source Package Creation / No Source Writer Yet

Batch 11AR defined the one-time bundle-generation approval. Batch 11AS closes the next custody gap:

`SOURCE BODY BUNDLE GENERATED != SOURCE PACKAGE READY.`

A generated bundle is only an intermediate artifact. It must be judged before any packet may authorize expanding it into actual package files, templates, fixtures, scripts, manifests, or harness inputs.

Core rule:

`BUNDLE FILE IS EVIDENCE, NOT PACKAGE AUTHORITY.`
`BUNDLE JUDGE DOES NOT WRITE SOURCE PACKAGE FILES.`
`BUNDLE JUDGE DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER.`
`BUNDLE JUDGE DOES NOT RUN HARNESS.`
`BUNDLE JUDGE DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0.`
`BUNDLE JUDGE MAY ONLY PERMIT PREPARING A SOURCE PACKAGE CREATION PACKET.`

---

## 11AS.1 Parent Rule

`SOURCE_BODY_BUNDLE_MUST_BE_JUDGED_BEFORE_SOURCE_PACKAGE_CREATION_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After a one-time source body bundle generation run, the generated bundle, bundle manifest, bundle receipt, bundle hash ledger, source staging evidence, staging judge evidence, generator approval scope, and forbidden-output scan must be judged before any source package creation packet may be prepared. The judge must verify approval scope, generator script hash, staging judge hash, source_body_staging snapshot, bundle schema, bundle status, 101 body entries, 11 control entries, 112 manifest rows, entry hashes, base64 decode integrity, blank policy, special anchors, no unplanned entries, receipt honesty, no source package files, no final templates, no final fixtures, no source writer run, no harness run, no live state touch, no git mutation, and no overclaim. A passing judge may only permit preparation of a one-time source package creation approval packet.`

This blocks:

`bundle generation receipt treated as package approval`

`bundle JSON trusted without schema/hash verification`

`missing body entry hidden inside bundle`

`unplanned I014 carried into package`

`I090/I095 blank policy violated`

`source writer starts immediately after bundle generation`

`bundle judge creates templates`

`bundle judge claims safe/done/MVP`

```

Each control entry must include:

```text
ControlId
ControlFile
ControlRole
SourceSHA256
SourceByteCount
SourceLineCount
ContentUtf8Base64
BundleEntrySHA256
RequiredMarkers
DoesNotProve
```

Each control entry must prove:

```text
ControlId is planned
ControlFile is approved
SourceSHA256 matches judged source_body_staging control file SHA256
SourceByteCount matches judged source_body_staging control byte count
SourceLineCount matches judged source_body_staging control line count
ContentUtf8Base64 decodes exactly to source file bytes
BundleEntrySHA256 matches decoded bytes
RequiredMarkers present
DoesNotProve present
no placeholder content
no false safe/done/live/package approval claim
```

Special control checks:

`C002` must include the body index anchors.

`C003` must include extraction anchors.

`C008` must include rollup anchors.

## 11AS.11 Source Staging Cross-Check

every bundle control entry has matching source_body_staging control file

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AT — Source Package Creation One-Time Approval Packet / Expand Judged Bundle to Package Files / No Harness Execution

Batch 11AS judged the source body bundle. Batch 11AT defines the next narrow gate:

`JUDGED SOURCE BODY BUNDLE != SOURCE PACKAGE CREATED.`

This packet may later authorize one package-creation run that reads the judged bundle and writes package candidate files only.

It does not run those files.
It does not run the source writer.
It does not run the harness.
It does not freeze templates.
It does not activate live L0.
It does not mark safe, done, or MVP active.

Core rule:

`SOURCE PACKAGE CREATION WRITES CANDIDATE FILES ONLY.`
`PACKAGE FILES CREATED != PACKAGE VERIFIED.`
`PACKAGE CREATION != HARNESS EXECUTION.`
`PACKAGE CREATION != LIVE L0.`
`NO SOURCE WRITER OR HARNESS FROM THIS PACKET.`

## 11AT.1 Parent Rule

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_CREATION_REQUIRES_ONE_TIME_APPROVAL_AFTER_BUNDLE_JUDGE_V0_1`

Wording:

`The source package creator may run only after the source body bundle has been judged ready for source package creation. The approval must bind the source body bundle judge report, source body bundle ready marker, bundle JSON, bundle manifest, bundle hash ledger, package creator script hash, package output root, receipt root, and one run ID. The package creator may expand judged bundle entries into candidate source package files only. It may not run the source writer, run the harness, run static validator, run self-test, touch live command center, touch live assistant state, mutate git, approve live L0, mark safe, mark done, or activate MVP.`

This blocks:

`package creator runs from bundle generation receipt alone`

`bundle changes after judge`

`package creator writes outside candidate package root`

`package creator runs generated scripts`

`package creator calls harness after writing files`

`package creator promotes candidate files into live system`

`package creation treated as proof that package works`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AU — Source Package Judge Packet / Verify Package Candidate Before Source Writer or Harness / No Execution Yet

Batch 11AT defined the one-time source package creation approval packet. Batch 11AU closes the next custody gap:

`SOURCE PACKAGE CANDIDATE CREATED != SOURCE PACKAGE VERIFIED.`

A package candidate is still only a staged candidate. It must be judged before anything writes live package files, runs scripts, runs a harness, freezes templates, promotes fixtures, or touches live command-center state.

Core rule:

`PACKAGE CANDIDATE IS NOT VERIFIED PACKAGE.`
`PACKAGE JUDGE DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER.`
`PACKAGE JUDGE DOES NOT RUN HARNESS.`
`PACKAGE JUDGE DOES NOT PROMOTE FILES.`
`PACKAGE JUDGE DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0.`
`PACKAGE JUDGE MAY ONLY PERMIT PREPARING THE NEXT ROUTE PACKET.`

---

## 11AU.1 Parent Rule

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_CANDIDATE_MUST_BE_JUDGED_BEFORE_SOURCE_WRITER_OR_HARNESS_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After a one-time source package candidate creation run, the package candidate root, package manifest, package index, package DNP, package creation receipt, package hash ledger, package blocker receipt if present, source body bundle evidence, and forbidden-output scan must be judged before any source writer, harness, static validator, self-test, live promotion, or template freeze packet may be prepared. The judge must verify approval scope, script hash, bundle hash, candidate root boundary, package structure, manifest rows, index fields, 101 body outputs, 11 control outputs, special body/control preservation, receipt honesty, hash custody, no live writes, no downstream execution, no git mutation, and no overclaim. A passing judge may only permit preparation of the next source-writer-or-harness route packet.`

This blocks:

`package creation receipt treated as verification`

`candidate files copied into live templates without judge`

`candidate files run as scripts`

`harness runs from unjudged candidate`

`missing package body hidden in manifest`

`unplanned I014 carried forward`

`I090/I095 blank policy broken`

`I120 stub carried forward`

`judge claims safe/done/MVP`

## 11AU.13 Source Bundle Cross-Check

The judge must cross-check package candidate outputs against judged source body bundle.

Required cross-checks:

```text
every judged bundle body entry has exactly one package body output
every judged bundle control entry has exactly one package control output
every package body output maps to one judged bundle body entry
every package control output maps to one judged bundle control entry
no package output exists for intentional gap TargetIds
no package output exists for unplanned control ids
bundle JSON hash unchanged after bundle judge
bundle manifest hash unchanged after bundle judge
package candidate root equals approved root
```

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AV — Source Writer or Harness Route Packet / Choose Verification Path Before Any Execution / No Execution Yet

Batch 11AU judged the source package candidate. Batch 11AV closes the next custody gap:

`PACKAGE CANDIDATE JUDGED READY != EXECUTION PATH CHOSEN.`

A judged package candidate still needs a route decision before any source writer, harness, static validator, self-test, template freeze, or live promotion packet can exist.

Core rule:

`ROUTE PACKET CHOOSES NEXT GATE ONLY.`
`ROUTE PACKET DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER.`
`ROUTE PACKET DOES NOT RUN HARNESS.`
`ROUTE PACKET DOES NOT RUN STATIC VALIDATOR.`
`ROUTE PACKET DOES NOT PROMOTE FILES.`
`ROUTE PACKET DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0.`

## 11AV.1 Parent Rule

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_MUST_BE_SELECTED_BEFORE_ANY_EXECUTION_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After a source package candidate is judged ready, a route packet must select the next verification path before any source writer, harness, static validator, self-test, template freeze, or live promotion packet may be prepared. The route packet must bind the source package judge report, ready marker, package candidate root, package manifest, package index, package hash ledger, selected route, route rationale, risk class, required next approval packet, forbidden routes, and no-execution fields. The route packet may only authorize preparation of the selected next approval packet. It may not execute tools, write live files, run tests, mutate git, approve live L0, safe, done, or MVP active.`

This blocks:

`jumping from package judge to source writer`

`jumping from package judge to harness`

`running generated scripts because package candidate looks clean`

`promoting candidate files into live templates`

`choosing multiple paths at once without custody`

`using source writer when static validation should run first`

`route packet claiming verification`

## 11AV.4 Route Options

Allowed route options:

```text
STATIC_VALIDATOR_FIRST
HARNESS_SANDBOX_FIRST
SOURCE_WRITER_CANDIDATE_TO_STAGING_FIRST
BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR
```

Preferred default:

```text
STATIC_VALIDATOR_FIRST
```

Reason:

`Static validation is the narrowest next gate. It can inspect package candidate structure, schema, paths, claims, scripts, manifests, DNP, and forbidden outputs without writing live package files or executing harness behavior.`

`HARNESS_SANDBOX_FIRST` may be selected only if:

```text
static validator already passed under a separate judged packet
or package candidate contains no executable scripts and harness is read-only/sandboxed
or the harness itself is the only available static+dynamic judge and is separately bounded
```

`SOURCE_WRITER_CANDIDATE_TO_STAGING_FIRST` may be selected only if:

```text
static validator passed
harness or self-test requirement is waived with explicit reason
writer target is staging-only, not live
writer has its own one-time approval packet
writer cannot run generated files
writer cannot freeze or promote templates
```

Failure labels:

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_OPTION_INVALID`

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_STATIC_VALIDATOR_SKIPPED`

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_HARNESS_SELECTED_WITHOUT_STATIC_PROOF`

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_WRITER_SELECTED_TOO_EARLY`

## 11AV.7 Route Selection Rules

The route selector must evaluate:

```text
candidate contains executable scripts
candidate contains templates
candidate contains fixtures
candidate contains generated manifests
candidate contains package DNP
candidate has exact 101 body outputs
candidate has exact 11 control outputs
package judge passed
package judge did not overclaim
forbidden output scan clean
no source writer already ran
no harness already ran
no live state touched
```

Selection logic:

```text
If package judge is blocked -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If package judge passed and no static validator has judged the package -> STATIC_VALIDATOR_FIRST.
If static validator judged clean and harness is required -> HARNESS_SANDBOX_FIRST.
If static validator judged clean and harness is waived with explicit receipt -> SOURCE_WRITER_CANDIDATE_TO_STAGING_FIRST.
If any live write, git mutation, source writer run, harness run, or overclaim is observed -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
```

Failure labels:

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_SELECTOR_INPUT_MISSING`

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_SELECTOR_CONFLICT`

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_SELECTOR_LIVE_TOUCH_OBSERVED`

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_ROUTE_SELECTOR_DOWNSTREAM_EXECUTION_OBSERVED`

THE ROUTE PACKET DOES NOT RUN STATIC VALIDATOR, SOURCE WRITER, HARNESS, SELFTEST, TEMPLATE FREEZE, LIVE PROMOTION, OR GIT MUTATION. IT DOES NOT TOUCH LIVE COMMAND_CENTER OR LIVE STATE AND DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0, SAFE, DONE, OR MVP ACTIVE. IF READY, IT ONLY PERMITS PREPARING THE SELECTED NEXT APPROVAL PACKET.`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AW — Source Package Static Validator One-Time Approval Packet / Validate Candidate Without Live Writes / No Harness Yet

Batch 11AV selected the route. Batch 11AW defines the next approval gate:

`ROUTE SELECTED != STATIC VALIDATOR APPROVED TO RUN.`

The static validator may later inspect the judged package candidate, but only under one-time approval. It may read candidate files, schemas, manifests, hashes, path boundaries, forbidden claims, DNP coverage, and script boundaries. It may write reports and receipts only. It may not write package files, run generated scripts, run source writer, run harness, freeze templates, promote anything, or touch live state.

Core rule:

`STATIC VALIDATION IS INSPECTION, NOT EXECUTION.`
`STATIC VALIDATOR MAY READ CANDIDATE FILES ONLY.`
`STATIC VALIDATOR MAY WRITE REPORTS AND RECEIPTS ONLY.`
`STATIC VALIDATOR DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER.`
`STATIC VALIDATOR DOES NOT RUN HARNESS.`
`STATIC VALIDATOR DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0.`

## 11AW.1 Parent Rule

`SOURCE_PACKAGE_STATIC_VALIDATOR_REQUIRES_ONE_TIME_APPROVAL_AFTER_ROUTE_SELECTION_V0_1`

Wording:

`The source package static validator may run only after the source package route packet selects STATIC_VALIDATOR_FIRST. The approval must bind the source package judge report, source package ready marker, route packet, route decision ledger, package candidate root, package manifest, package index, package DNP, package creation hash ledger, static validator script hash, validator report root, receipt root, and one run ID. The static validator may inspect package candidate structure, manifest rows, index fields, body/control outputs, hashes, DNP, forbidden claims, executable script boundaries, path boundaries, and no-downstream-execution fields. It may not write package candidate files, live templates, live fixtures, source writer outputs, harness outputs, command-center files, live assistant state, git files, safe, done, live L0, or MVP activation.`

This blocks:

`running validator from route marker alone`

`validator modifies package candidate during inspection`

`validator repairs files while validating`

`validator runs generated scripts`

`validator calls source writer or harness`

`validator writes live templates`

`validator claims package verified enough for live use`

## 11AW.7 Static Validation Scope

The validator must check:

```text
candidate root boundary
required directory structure
required files
package manifest header
package manifest row counts
package index fields
package index status
package DNP contents
101 body outputs
11 control outputs
112 source-derived outputs
body/control hash custody
body/control DNP
I090/I095 blank policy
I002 family anchors
I120 script-shape markers and non-stub threshold
C002 index anchors
C003 extraction anchors
C008 rollup anchors
forbidden package statuses
forbidden live claims
forbidden source writer claims
forbidden harness claims
forbidden safe/done/MVP claims
script files are not executed
script files contain DNP and boundary markers
no live-output files were produced
no downstream execution fields are true
```

The validator may classify:

```text
PASS
BLOCK
WARN
INFO
```

But a `WARN` may not be ignored if it touches:

```text
path boundary
hash mismatch
missing DNP
false live claim
executable script boundary
source writer/harness execution field
```

Failure labels:

`STATIC_VALIDATOR_SCOPE_MISSING`

`STATIC_VALIDATOR_WARN_USED_TO_BYPASS_BLOCK`

no live approve claim

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AX — Static Validation Judge Packet / Judge Validator Output Before Harness or Source Writer / No Execution Yet

Batch 11AW defined one-time static-validator approval. Batch 11AX closes the next custody gap:

`STATIC VALIDATION OUTPUT != STATIC VALIDATION JUDGED.`

The validator may later inspect the package candidate and produce reports, but those reports are still evidence. They do not automatically approve harness, source writer, package verification, template freeze, live L0, safe, done, or MVP active.

Core rule:

`STATIC VALIDATOR REPORT IS EVIDENCE, NOT AUTHORITY.`
`STATIC VALIDATION JUDGE DOES NOT RUN HARNESS.`
`STATIC VALIDATION JUDGE DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER.`
`STATIC VALIDATION JUDGE DOES NOT MODIFY PACKAGE CANDIDATE FILES.`
`STATIC VALIDATION JUDGE MAY ONLY PERMIT PREPARING THE NEXT ROUTE PACKET.`

## 11AX.1 Parent Rule

`STATIC_VALIDATION_OUTPUT_MUST_BE_JUDGED_BEFORE_HARNESS_OR_SOURCE_WRITER_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After a one-time static validation run, the static validation report, findings ledger, hash ledger, blocker receipt if present, use receipt, validator approval packet, package candidate root, package manifest, package index, package DNP, package creation hash ledger, source package judge report, and route packet must be judged before any harness, source writer, template freeze, live promotion, or live L0 packet may be prepared. The judge must verify approval scope, script hash, route hash, package hashes, validator report root, receipt root, required check families, blocking findings, warning classification, script-boundary findings, forbidden claims, forbidden outputs, no package modification, no generated-script execution, no source writer run, no harness run, no live state touch, no git mutation, and no overclaim. A passing judge may only permit preparation of a post-static-validation route packet.`

This blocks:

`validator report treated as enough`

`WARN used to bypass a blocking issue`

`validator auto-fixes package candidate files`

`validator report claims package verified`

`validator report approves source writer`

`validator report approves harness`

`validator output starts source writer`

`validator output starts live promotion`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_CHECK_ROW_MISSING`

Blocking if `Severity` is not one of:

```text
INFO
WARN
BLOCK
```

Failure label:

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_FINDING_SEVERITY_INVALID`

---

## 11AX.7 Blocking Finding Verification

If any finding has:

```text
Severity = BLOCK
```

then static validation judge must block.

If any finding has `Pass = false` in these families, it must block even if severity is incorrectly marked `WARN`:

```text
CANDIDATE_ROOT_BOUNDARY
PACKAGE_STRUCTURE
PACKAGE_MANIFEST
PACKAGE_INDEX
PACKAGE_DNP
BODY_OUTPUT
CONTROL_OUTPUT
SPECIAL_BODY
SPECIAL_CONTROL
HASH_CUSTODY
SCRIPT_BOUNDARY
FORBIDDEN_CLAIM
FORBIDDEN_OUTPUT
NO_DOWNSTREAM_EXECUTION
OVERCLAIM_SCAN
```

Failure labels:

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_BLOCKING_FINDING_NOT_BLOCKED`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_WARN_BYPASSED_BLOCK`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_FALSE_PASS_ON_FAILED_FINDING`

---

## 11AX.8 Script Boundary Verification

The judge must verify that static validation inspected candidate scripts as text only.

Required script-boundary findings:

```text
script files detected or none found
script files not executed
script files include SCRIPT PURPOSE where applicable
script files include SCRIPT STATUS where applicable
script files include SCRIPT DOES NOT where applicable
script files include DOES_NOT_PROVE where applicable
no generated script execution observed
no Start-Process execution chain accepted
no Invoke-Expression accepted
no iex accepted
no git commit accepted
no git push accepted
no Remove-Item accepted
no Move-Item accepted
no Copy-Item to live roots accepted
no writes to COMMAND_CENTER accepted
no writes to live assistant state accepted
no source writer invocation accepted
no harness invocation accepted
```

Failure labels:

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_SCRIPT_BOUNDARY_MISSING`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_CONFIRMED`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_SCRIPT_SHAPE_FAIL`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_SCRIPT_FORBIDDEN_EXECUTION_CHAIN`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_SCRIPT_DESTRUCTIVE_COMMAND_PRESENT`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_SCRIPT_LIVE_WRITE_PRESENT`

---

The judge must verify the forbidden claim ledger was used and that forbidden claims were not accepted except inside clearly marked forbidden-lists.

Forbidden claims:

```text
SOURCE_PACKAGE_VERIFIED
SOURCE_WRITER_APPROVED
SOURCE_WRITER_RUN
HARNESS_APPROVED
HARNESS_RUN
STATIC_VALIDATOR_RUN as final status
LIVE_L0_APPROVED
SAFE
DONE
MVP_ACTIVE
```

Allowed only when the context is:

```text
Forbidden FinalVerdicts
Blocked statuses
Forbidden claims ledger
DoesNotProve
test fixture expected failure label
```

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_FORBIDDEN_CLAIM_LEDGER_MISSING`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_FORBIDDEN_CLAIM_ACCEPTED`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_FORBIDDEN_CLAIM_CONTEXT_UNCLEAR`

`STATIC_VALIDATION_JUDGE_OVERCLAIM`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AY — Post-Static Validation Route Packet / Choose Harness Sandbox or Source Writer Staging / No Execution Yet

Batch 11AX judged static validation output. Batch 11AY closes the next custody gap:

`STATIC VALIDATION JUDGED READY != HARNESS OR SOURCE WRITER APPROVED.`

A clean static-validation judge result only proves the package candidate survived static inspection within scope. It does not decide whether the next step is harness sandbox, source writer staging, additional static repair, or blocked repair.

Core rule:

`POST-STATIC ROUTE CHOOSES NEXT PACKET ONLY.`
`POST-STATIC ROUTE DOES NOT RUN HARNESS.`
`POST-STATIC ROUTE DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER.`
`POST-STATIC ROUTE DOES NOT WRITE STAGING FILES.`
`POST-STATIC ROUTE DOES NOT PROMOTE OR FREEZE FILES.`
`POST-STATIC ROUTE DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0.`

---

## 11AY.1 Parent Rule

`POST_STATIC_VALIDATION_ROUTE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_HARNESS_OR_SOURCE_WRITER_APPROVAL_V0_1`

Wording:

`After static validation is judged ready, a post-static route packet must choose the next bounded path before any harness sandbox approval packet, source writer staging approval packet, self-test packet, template freeze packet, live promotion packet, or live L0 packet may be prepared. The route packet must bind the static validation judge report, static validation ready marker, source package judge report, package candidate root, package manifest, package index, package DNP, package creation hash ledger, selected route, route rationale, risk class, required next packet, waiver evidence if any, blocked routes, no-execution fields, and hash custody. The route packet may only authorize preparation of the selected next approval packet. It may not execute tools, write package files, write staging files, run harness, run source writer, mutate git, approve safe, approve done, approve live L0, or activate MVP.`

This blocks:

`static validation pass treated as harness approval`

`static validation pass treated as source writer approval`

`source writer chosen before sandbox harness without waiver`

`harness chosen without sandbox boundary`

`multiple routes selected at once`

`route packet creates staging writes`

`route packet claims safe/done/MVP`

## 11AY.4 Route Options

Allowed route options:

```text
HARNESS_SANDBOX_FIRST
SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_FIRST
REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST
BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR
```

Preferred default:

```text
HARNESS_SANDBOX_FIRST
```

Reason:

`After static validation is judged ready, the next safer dynamic proof is a sandbox harness run, not source writer staging. Harness sandbox can exercise package behavior inside a bounded sandbox without writing staging targets or live roots.`

`SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_FIRST` may be selected only if:

```text
harness is unavailable or not meaningful for this package class
harness waiver receipt exists
source writer target is staging-only
source writer approval packet will bind staging root and forbid live writes
source writer cannot run generated scripts
source writer cannot freeze templates
source writer cannot promote files
source writer has its own one-time judge after run
```

`REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
static validation passed with non-blocking warnings that should be cleaned before harness
route evidence reveals incomplete package metadata
route evidence reveals weak DNP coverage
route evidence reveals uncertain script boundary
```

Failure labels:

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_OPTION_INVALID`

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_HARNESS_DEFAULT_SKIPPED_WITHOUT_WAIVER`

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_SOURCE_WRITER_SELECTED_TOO_EARLY`

## 11AY.8 Route Selection Rules

The route selector must evaluate:

```text
static validation judge passed
no static validation blocker exists
all static validation blocking findings absent
package candidate root unchanged after static judge
package manifest unchanged after static judge
package index unchanged after static judge
package DNP unchanged after static judge
package creation hash ledger unchanged after static judge
no package candidate modification observed
no generated scripts executed
no source writer already ran
no harness already ran
no live state touched
no git mutation observed
harness availability known
harness sandbox boundary known if selecting harness
source writer staging boundary known if selecting writer
waiver evidence present if skipping harness
```

Selection logic:

```text
If static validation judge is blocked -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If package candidate changed after static judge -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If any source writer run, harness run, live write, git mutation, or overclaim is observed -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If static validation judge passed and harness sandbox can be bounded -> HARNESS_SANDBOX_FIRST.
If harness cannot be bounded and explicit waiver exists -> SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_FIRST.
If non-blocking warnings require cleanup before execution -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If selected route is ambiguous or multiple routes selected -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
```

Failure labels:

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_SELECTOR_INPUT_MISSING`

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_SELECTOR_CONFLICT`

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_STATIC_OUTPUT_CHANGED`

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_PACKAGE_CHANGED_AFTER_STATIC_JUDGE`

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_DOWNSTREAM_EXECUTION_OBSERVED`

`POST_STATIC_ROUTE_LIVE_TOUCH_OBSERVED`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11AZ — Harness Sandbox One-Time Approval Packet / Run Package Candidate in Sandbox Only / No Source Writer or Live Promotion

Batch 11AY selected the post-static route. Batch 11AZ defines the approval gate for the first bounded dynamic proof:

`HARNESS SANDBOX ROUTE SELECTED != HARNESS APPROVED TO RUN.`

This packet may later authorize one harness run inside an approved sandbox only. The harness may copy/read the judged package candidate inside the sandbox, execute bounded checks, and write harness reports/receipts. It may not write live templates, write live fixtures, run source writer, mutate live command-center state, freeze/promote files, mutate git, or approve live L0.

Core rule:

`HARNESS EXECUTION MUST BE SANDBOXED.`
`HARNESS SANDBOX RUN != LIVE PACKAGE APPROVAL.`
`HARNESS MAY WRITE REPORTS, NOT LIVE FILES.`
`HARNESS DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER.`
`HARNESS DOES NOT FREEZE OR PROMOTE FILES.`
`HARNESS DOES NOT APPROVE SAFE, DONE, OR MVP ACTIVE.`

The harness may execute only inside the approved sandbox. It may not write live templates, live fixtures, live scripts, live command-center files, live assistant state, source writer outputs, template freeze markers, promotion markers, git mutations, safe, done, live L0, or MVP activation.`

copy package candidate into approved sandbox
copy approved fixture set into approved sandbox
run harness script inside approved sandbox
read package candidate copy
read fixture files
write observed results
write sandbox logs
write harness report
write findings ledger
write hash ledger
write blocker receipt if blocked
write one-time use receipt

modify source_body_staging
write live templates
write live fixtures
write live scripts
write COMMAND_CENTER
touch live assistant state
run source writer
run static validator as auto-fix
run self-test outside sandbox
freeze templates
promote files
mutate git
approve live L0
mark safe
mark done
activate MVP

IT DOES NOT RUN THE HARNESS IN THIS BATCH, DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER, DOES NOT MODIFY ORIGINAL PACKAGE CANDIDATE FILES, DOES NOT WRITE LIVE TEMPLATES OR FIXTURES, DOES NOT FREEZE OR PROMOTE FILES, DOES NOT TOUCH LIVE COMMAND_CENTER OR LIVE STATE, AND DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0, SAFE, DONE, OR MVP ACTIVE. HARNESS OUTPUT, IF LATER OBSERVED, MUST BE JUDGED BEFORE ANY SOURCE WRITER OR LIVE-USE PACKET IS PREPARED.`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11BA — Harness Sandbox Judge Packet / Judge Harness Output Before Source Writer Staging Route / No Live Use

Batch 11AZ defined one-time harness sandbox approval. Batch 11BA closes the next custody gap:

`HARNESS SANDBOX OUTPUT != HARNESS JUDGED.`

A harness sandbox run is dynamic evidence only. It does not verify the source package by itself, approve source writer staging, freeze templates, promote files, approve live L0, or mark the system safe/done/MVP active.

Core rule:

`HARNESS REPORT IS EVIDENCE, NOT PROMOTION AUTHORITY.`
`HARNESS JUDGE DOES NOT RUN SOURCE WRITER.`
`HARNESS JUDGE DOES NOT FREEZE OR PROMOTE FILES.`
`HARNESS JUDGE DOES NOT MODIFY PACKAGE CANDIDATE FILES.`
`HARNESS JUDGE MAY ONLY PERMIT PREPARING THE NEXT ROUTE PACKET.`

---

## 11BA.1 Parent Rule

`HARNESS_SANDBOX_OUTPUT_MUST_BE_JUDGED_BEFORE_SOURCE_WRITER_OR_LIVE_ROUTE_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After one harness sandbox run, the harness report, findings ledger, hash ledger, blocker receipt if present, one-time use receipt, approval packet, sandbox root, report root, package candidate evidence, static validation judge evidence, post-static route evidence, fixture set, expected result ledger, observed result artifacts, and forbidden-output scan must be judged before any source writer staging packet, repair packet, template freeze packet, promotion packet, live L0 packet, safe, done, or MVP activation packet may be prepared. The judge must verify approval scope, harness script hash, route hash, package hashes, fixture set hash, expected result hash, sandbox boundary, fixture outcomes, negative fixtures, boundary fixtures, overclaim fixtures, report fields, findings ledger, hash ledger, no original package modification, no source writer run, no live writes, no git mutation, no promotion, and no overclaim. A passing judge may only permit preparation of a post-harness route packet.`

This blocks:

`harness pass treated as source writer approval`

`positive fixture pass overriding negative fixture failure`

`harness report claims safe/done/MVP`

`harness writes live templates`

`harness silently modifies package candidate`

`harness invokes source writer`

`harness pass treated as live L0 approval`

## 11BA.7 Fixture Outcome Verification

The judge must verify every expected fixture row was observed.

Required fixture types:

```text
NEGATIVE
POSITIVE
BOUNDARY
OVERCLAIM
```

Required fixture families:

```text
PACKAGE_STRUCTURE
PACKAGE_MANIFEST
PACKAGE_INDEX
BODY_OUTPUT
CONTROL_OUTPUT
SCRIPT_BOUNDARY
DNP_COVERAGE
FORBIDDEN_CLAIM
FORBIDDEN_OUTPUT
SANDBOX_BOUNDARY
NO_SOURCE_WRITER
NO_LIVE_WRITE
```

Rules:

```text
every expected fixture has one observed result
negative fixture expected block must block harness pass
boundary fixture expected block must block harness pass
overclaim fixture expected block must block harness pass
positive fixture pass cannot override any block
warn cannot bypass live write
warn cannot bypass source writer invocation
warn cannot bypass sandbox escape
warn cannot bypass hash mismatch
warn cannot bypass missing DNP
warn cannot bypass overclaim
```

Failure labels:

`HARNESS_SANDBOX_JUDGE_FIXTURE_RESULT_MISSING`

`HARNESS_SANDBOX_JUDGE_UNEXPECTED_FIXTURE_RESULT`

`HARNESS_SANDBOX_JUDGE_NEGATIVE_FIXTURE_FAILED_OPEN`

`HARNESS_SANDBOX_JUDGE_POSITIVE_OVERRIDE_OF_BLOCK`

`HARNESS_SANDBOX_JUDGE_WARN_BYPASSED_BLOCK`

## 11BB.1 Parent Rule

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SOURCE_WRITER_OR_REPAIR_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After harness sandbox output is judged ready, a post-harness route packet must select the next bounded path before any source writer staging approval packet, repair packet, additional harness packet, template freeze packet, promotion packet, live L0 packet, safe, done, or MVP activation packet may be prepared. The route packet must bind the harness sandbox judge report, harness ready marker, harness report, harness findings ledger, harness hash ledger, source package judge report, static validation judge report, package candidate root, package manifest, package index, package DNP, package creation hash ledger, selected route, route rationale, risk class, required next packet, blocked routes, no-execution fields, and hash custody. The route packet may only authorize preparation of the selected next approval packet. It may not execute tools, write staging files, run source writer, freeze templates, promote files, mutate git, approve live L0, mark safe, mark done, or activate MVP.`

This blocks:

`harness pass treated as source writer approval`

`harness pass treated as live package verification`

`source writer starts without a staging-only approval packet`

`repair skipped after harness warnings`

`additional harness run reused without new packet`

`template freeze starts from harness pass`

`route packet claims safe/done/MVP`

## 11BB.4 Route Options

Allowed route options:

```text
SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_FIRST
REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST
ADDITIONAL_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST
BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR
```

Preferred default after clean harness judge:

```text
SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_FIRST
```

Reason:

`Static validation and sandbox harness have both been judged. The next bounded forward path is a source writer staging write, not live promotion. The writer must write only to an approved staging root and must be judged before template freeze, promotion, or live L0.`

`REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
harness judge passed with non-blocking warnings that should be resolved
harness evidence exposed weak fixture coverage
package metadata is incomplete but not blocking
DNP coverage is weak
script boundary evidence is uncertain
fixture set needs strengthening before writer staging
```

`ADDITIONAL_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
harness passed but coverage is too narrow
a new fixture family was added
source writer staging is too risky without another sandbox pass
boundary proof is incomplete but repair is not required
dynamic behavior needs broader fixture pressure
```

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_OPTION_INVALID`

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_SOURCE_WRITER_SELECTED_WITH_BLOCKING_WARNING`

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_REPAIR_SELECTED_WITHOUT_FINDING`

## 11BB.7 Route Selection Rules

The route selector must evaluate:

```text
harness sandbox judge passed
no harness blocker exists
all negative fixtures passed as blocks
all boundary fixtures passed
all overclaim fixtures passed as blocks
no source writer already ran
no writer staging files already created
no package candidate modification occurred
no live state touched
no git mutation observed
no template freeze marker exists
no promotion marker exists
package candidate root unchanged after harness judge
source writer staging root can be bounded
source writer script has not yet been approved
```

Selection logic:

```text
If harness judge is blocked -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If harness judge says repair route -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If package candidate changed after harness judge -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If source writer already ran, writer staging files already exist, live write exists, git mutation exists, freeze exists, promotion exists, or overclaim exists -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If harness judge passed and no blocking or repair finding exists -> SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_FIRST.
If harness judge passed but coverage gap is recorded -> ADDITIONAL_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST.
If non-blocking repair finding should be closed before writer staging -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If multiple routes selected -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
```

Failure labels:

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_SELECTOR_INPUT_MISSING`

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_SELECTOR_CONFLICT`

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_PACKAGE_CHANGED_AFTER_HARNESS_JUDGE`

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_DOWNSTREAM_EXECUTION_OBSERVED`

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_WRITER_STAGING_ALREADY_EXISTS`

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_LIVE_TOUCH_OBSERVED`

`POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_FREEZE_OR_PROMOTION_OBSERVED`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11BC — Source Writer One-Time Staging Write Approval Packet / Write Package Candidate to Writer Staging Only / No Live Promotion

Batch 11BB selected the post-harness route. Batch 11BC defines the approval gate for the first bounded source-writer action:

`SOURCE WRITER STAGING ROUTE SELECTED != SOURCE WRITER APPROVED TO RUN.`

This packet may later authorize one source writer run that reads the judged package candidate and writes only into an approved writer staging root. It may not write live templates, live fixtures, live scripts, live `COMMAND_CENTER`, live assistant state, git, template freeze markers, promotion markers, safe/done/MVP markers, or live L0 approval.

Core rule:

`SOURCE WRITER MUST WRITE TO STAGING ONLY.`
`WRITER STAGING OUTPUT != LIVE PACKAGE.`
`WRITER STAGING OUTPUT != TEMPLATE FREEZE.`
`WRITER STAGING OUTPUT != PROMOTION.`
`WRITER STAGING OUTPUT != LIVE L0.`
`SOURCE WRITER APPROVAL IS ONE-TIME AND EXACT-SCOPE.`

## 11BC.1 Parent Rule

`SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_WRITE_REQUIRES_ONE_TIME_APPROVAL_AFTER_POST_HARNESS_ROUTE_V0_1`

Wording:

`The source writer may run only after the post-harness route packet selects SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_FIRST. The approval must bind the post-harness route packet, route decision ledger, route hash ledger, route ready marker, harness sandbox judge report, harness ready marker, static validation judge report, source package judge report, package candidate root, package manifest, package index, package DNP, package creation hash ledger, source writer script hash, writer staging root, writer staging manifest path, receipt root, and one run ID. The writer may read the approved package candidate and write package-derived files into the approved writer staging root only. It may not write live templates, live fixtures, live scripts, live command-center files, live assistant state, git files, freeze markers, promotion markers, live L0 approval, safe, done, or MVP activation.`

This blocks:

`source writer runs from harness pass alone`

`source writer writes directly to live templates`

`source writer writes directly to live fixtures`

`source writer mutates live COMMAND_CENTER`

`source writer executes generated scripts`

`source writer runs harness after writing`

`source writer freezes or promotes files`

`source writer staging receipt claims live approval`

## 11BC.10 Body / Control Preservation Requirements

Every writer staging output must preserve the judged package candidate content.

Body rules:

```text
all 101 planned body outputs present
no intentional gap TargetId output appears
I090 remains empty
I095 remains empty
I002 family anchors preserved
I120 remains non-stub
body hashes match package candidate source unless explicitly transformed with recorded reversible mapping
DoesNotProve retained
no live/safe/done claim
```

Control rules:

```text
all 11 planned control outputs present
C002 index anchors preserved
C003 extraction anchors preserved
C008 rollup anchors preserved
no placeholder control content
control hashes match package candidate source unless explicitly transformed with recorded reversible mapping
DoesNotProve retained
no live/safe/done claim
```

## 11BC.11 Writer Execution Scope

The writer may later perform only these actions:

```text
read approved package candidate root
read approved package manifest
read approved package index
read approved package DNP
read approved package creation hash ledger
create approved writer staging root
write package-derived files into approved writer staging root
write writer staging manifest
write writer staging index
write writer staging DNP
write writer staging receipt
write writer staging hash ledger
write writer staging blocker receipt if blocked
write one-time use receipt
```

The writer may not:

```text
execute generated scripts
run harness
run static validator
run self-test
modify original package candidate root
modify source body bundle
modify source_body_staging
write live templates
write live fixtures
write live scripts
write COMMAND_CENTER
touch live assistant state
freeze templates
promote files
mutate git
approve live L0
mark safe
mark done
activate MVP
```

Failure labels:

`SOURCE_WRITER_SCOPE_MISSING`

`SOURCE_WRITER_GENERATED_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_CONFIRMED`

`SOURCE_WRITER_HARNESS_INVOKED`

`SOURCE_WRITER_STATIC_VALIDATOR_INVOKED`

`SOURCE_WRITER_SELFTEST_INVOKED`

`SOURCE_WRITER_ORIGINAL_PACKAGE_MODIFIED`

`SOURCE_WRITER_SOURCE_BUNDLE_MODIFIED`

`SOURCE_WRITER_SOURCE_STAGING_MODIFIED`

`SOURCE_WRITER_TEMPLATE_FREEZE_ATTEMPT`

`SOURCE_WRITER_PROMOTION_ATTEMPT`
