## 11BC.12 Approved Command Shape

The approval packet may prepare, but not execute, this command shape:

```text
Mode: WRITE_SOURCE_PACKAGE_TO_STAGING
SourceWriterScriptPath: <approved source writer script path>
PackageCandidateRoot: <approved package candidate root>
PackageManifestPath: <approved package manifest path>
PackageIndexPath: <approved package index path>
PackageDnpPath: <approved package DNP path>
PackageCreationHashLedgerPath: <approved package creation hash ledger path>
WriterStagingRoot: <approved writer staging root>
WriterStagingManifestPath: <approved writer staging manifest path>
ReceiptRoot: <approved receipt root>
ApprovalPacketPath: <approval packet path>
RunId: <approved run id>
```

Forbidden command substitutions:

```text
Mode: WRITE_TO_LIVE
Mode: FREEZE_TEMPLATES
Mode: PROMOTE_TO_LIVE
Mode: RUN_HARNESS
Mode: RUN_SOURCE_WRITER_AND_PROMOTE
Mode: RUN_SELFTEST_LIVE
Mode: LIVE_APPROVE
WriterStagingRoot: BUILD_HARNESS\templates
WriterStagingRoot: BUILD_HARNESS\fixtures
WriterStagingRoot: COMMAND_CENTER
WriterStagingRoot: _LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS
ReceiptRoot: live assistant state root
RunId: anything other than approved run id
```

`SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_COMMAND_SHAPE_MISSING`

`SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_FORBIDDEN_COMMAND_SHAPE`

`SOURCE_WRITER_STAGING_RUNID_SUBSTITUTION`

## 11BD.13 Existing-Diff / No-Overwrite Verification

If writer staging root already contained files before the run, allowed behavior:

```text
exact match skipped
different file blocked
```

Blocked behavior:

```text
overwrite
append
merge
move aside
backup-and-replace
delete
autoclean
repair package content silently
substitute placeholder content
```

Judge must verify receipt or blocker recorded:

```text
PreExisting
PreSHA256
PostSHA256
CreatedOrMatched
BlockedExistingDiff
RollbackAttempted: false
```

It may not freeze templates, promote files, write live roots, mutate git, approve live L0, mark safe, mark done, or activate MVP.`

`writer staging judge pass treated as promotion`

`post-writer route claims live-ready`

Preferred default after clean writer staging judge:

```text
TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_FIRST
```

Reason:

`Source package, static validation, harness sandbox, source writer staging, and writer staging judge have all passed within scope. The next bounded forward step is a template freeze candidate packet, not live promotion. Template freeze must still be one-time approved, hash-bound, judged, and kept separate from promotion or live L0.`

`REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
writer staging judge passed with non-blocking repair findings
writer staging DNP is weak
writer staging manifest needs cleanup
writer staging index needs clarity
writer output naming is confusing but not blocking
template freeze mapping is incomplete
```

`EXTRA_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
writer staging output changed structure enough to warrant sandbox testing
new fixture family was added after writer staging
template freeze candidate would be risky without another dynamic pass
post-writer route detects coverage gap
```

`EXTRA_STATIC_VALIDATION_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
writer staging output should be statically checked as staging, not package candidate
new freeze mapping rules need static validation
manifest/index/DNP changed enough to warrant another static pass
script boundary changed in writer staging output
```

## 11BE.7 Route Selection Rules

The route selector must evaluate:

```text
writer staging judge passed
no writer staging blocker exists
writer staging root unchanged after judge
writer staging manifest unchanged after judge
writer staging index unchanged after judge
writer staging DNP unchanged after judge
writer staging hash ledger unchanged after judge
package candidate root unchanged
no template freeze already occurred
no promotion already occurred
no live L0 marker exists
no live root write exists
no git mutation observed
template freeze target boundary can be defined
template freeze mapping can be defined
repair findings absent or explicitly selected
coverage gaps absent or explicitly selected
```

Selection logic:

```text
If writer staging judge is blocked -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If writer staging judge says repair route -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If writer staging root changed after judge -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If freeze marker, promotion marker, live write, git mutation, safe/done/MVP marker, or overclaim exists -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If writer staging judge passed and no repair/coverage/static gap exists -> TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_FIRST.
If repair finding exists -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If dynamic coverage gap exists -> EXTRA_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST.
If static validation gap exists -> EXTRA_STATIC_VALIDATION_FIRST.
If multiple routes selected -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
```

Failure labels:

`POST_WRITER_ROUTE_SELECTOR_INPUT_MISSING`

`POST_WRITER_ROUTE_SELECTOR_CONFLICT`

`POST_WRITER_ROUTE_STAGING_CHANGED_AFTER_JUDGE`

`POST_WRITER_ROUTE_PACKAGE_CHANGED_AFTER_WRITER_JUDGE`

`POST_WRITER_ROUTE_FREEZE_ALREADY_EXISTS`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11BF — Template Freeze Candidate One-Time Approval Packet / Freeze Candidate Only / No Promotion or Live L0

Batch 11BE selected the post-writer route. Batch 11BF defines the next approval gate:

`TEMPLATE FREEZE CANDIDATE ROUTE SELECTED != TEMPLATE FREEZE APPROVED.`

This packet may later authorize one freeze-candidate creation run. It may read the judged writer staging root and write only to an approved freeze candidate root. It may not write live templates, promote files, mutate `COMMAND_CENTER`, touch live assistant state, mutate git, approve live L0, or mark safe/done/MVP active.

Core rule:

`FREEZE CANDIDATE IS NOT LIVE FREEZE.`
`FREEZE CANDIDATE OUTPUT IS NOT PROMOTION.`
`FREEZE CANDIDATE OUTPUT IS NOT LIVE L0.`
`FREEZE CANDIDATE APPROVAL IS ONE-TIME AND EXACT-SCOPE.`
`FREEZE CANDIDATE MUST BE JUDGED BEFORE PROMOTION ROUTE.`

## 11BF.1 Parent Rule

`TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_ONE_TIME_APPROVAL_AFTER_POST_WRITER_ROUTE_V0_1`

Wording:

`The template freeze candidate creator may run only after the post-writer-staging route packet selects TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_FIRST. The approval must bind the post-writer route packet, route decision ledger, route hash ledger, route ready marker, source writer staging judge report, source writer staging ready marker, writer staging root, writer staging manifest, writer staging index, writer staging DNP, writer staging hash ledger, harness sandbox judge report, static validation judge report, source package judge report, freeze candidate creator script hash, freeze candidate root, freeze manifest path, receipt root, and one run ID. The freeze candidate creator may read the approved writer staging root and write only into the approved freeze candidate root. It may not write live templates, live fixtures, live scripts, live command-center files, live assistant state, git files, promotion markers, live L0 approval, safe, done, or MVP activation.`

This blocks:

`freeze candidate run from writer judge alone`

`freeze candidate writing directly into live templates`

`freeze candidate treated as promotion`

`freeze candidate mutating live command center`

`freeze candidate skipping manifest/hash custody`

`freeze candidate claiming safe/done/MVP`

`freeze candidate route used multiple times`

## 11BF.12 Freeze Candidate Creator Scope

The freeze candidate creator may later perform only these actions:

```text
read approved writer staging root
read approved writer staging manifest
read approved writer staging index
read approved writer staging DNP
read approved writer staging hash ledger
create approved freeze candidate root
write freeze candidate files into approved freeze candidate root
write freeze candidate manifest
write freeze candidate index
write freeze candidate DNP
write freeze candidate receipt
write freeze candidate hash ledger
write freeze candidate blocker receipt if blocked
write one-time use receipt
```

The creator may not:

```text
execute generated scripts
run source writer
run harness
run static validator
run self-test
modify writer staging root
modify original package candidate root
modify source body bundle
modify source_body_staging
write live templates
write live fixtures
write live scripts
write COMMAND_CENTER
touch live assistant state
promote files
mutate git
approve live L0
mark safe
mark done
activate MVP
```

## 11BF.19 Post-Run Judge Requirement

After freeze candidate creation, a judge must inspect:

```text
one-time approval packet
one-time use receipt
freeze candidate root
freeze candidate manifest
freeze candidate index
freeze candidate DNP
freeze candidate receipt
freeze candidate hash ledger
freeze candidate blocker receipt if present
writer staging root
writer staging manifest
writer staging index
writer staging DNP
writer staging hash ledger
post-writer route packet
source writer staging judge report
harness sandbox judge report
static validation judge report
source package judge report
forbidden output scan
```

Allowed judge verdicts:

```text
TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_JUDGED_READY_FOR_PROMOTION_ROUTE_PACKET
TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_JUDGED_READY_FOR_REPAIR_PACKET
TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_JUDGED_BLOCKED
```

Forbidden judge verdicts:

```text
TEMPLATE_FREEZE_APPROVED
TEMPLATES_FROZEN
PROMOTED_TO_LIVE
LIVE_L0_APPROVED
SAFE
DONE
MVP_ACTIVE
```

Failure labels:

`TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_JUDGE_MISSING`

`TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_JUDGE_OVERCLAIM`

`TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_JUDGE_FORBIDDEN_OUTPUT_MISSED`

FREEZE CANDIDATE OUTPUT, IF LATER OBSERVED, MUST BE JUDGED BEFORE ANY PROMOTION OR LIVE-USE PACKET IS PREPARED.`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11BG — Template Freeze Candidate Judge Packet / Judge Freeze Candidate Before Promotion Route / No Live Use

Batch 11BF defined one-time template freeze candidate approval. Batch 11BG closes the next custody gap:

`FREEZE CANDIDATE CREATED != FREEZE CANDIDATE JUDGED.`

A freeze candidate is still only a candidate. It is not live. It is not promoted. It is not installed. It is not live L0. It is not safe, done, or MVP active.

Core rule:

`FREEZE CANDIDATE OUTPUT IS EVIDENCE, NOT PROMOTION AUTHORITY.`
`FREEZE CANDIDATE JUDGE DOES NOT PROMOTE FILES.`
`FREEZE CANDIDATE JUDGE DOES NOT WRITE LIVE ROOTS.`
`FREEZE CANDIDATE JUDGE DOES NOT TOUCH LIVE COMMAND_CENTER.`
`FREEZE CANDIDATE JUDGE MAY ONLY PERMIT PREPARING THE PROMOTION ROUTE PACKET.`

## 11BG.1 Parent Rule

`TEMPLATE_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_OUTPUT_MUST_BE_JUDGED_BEFORE_PROMOTION_ROUTE_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After one template freeze candidate creation run, the freeze candidate root, freeze candidate manifest, freeze candidate index, freeze candidate DNP, freeze candidate receipt, freeze candidate hash ledger, blocker receipt if present, one-time use receipt, approval packet, post-writer route evidence, source writer staging judge evidence, writer staging evidence, harness judge evidence, static validation judge evidence, source package judge evidence, and forbidden-output scan must be judged before any promotion packet, live L0 packet, safe, done, or MVP activation packet may be prepared. The judge must verify approval scope, creator script hash, route hash, writer staging hashes, judge hashes, freeze candidate root boundary, freeze candidate structure, manifest rows, index fields, DNP coverage, body/control preservation, template/fixture/script candidate preservation, transform ledger integrity, receipt honesty, hash custody, no generated-script execution, no writer staging modification, no package candidate modification, no live writes, no promotion, no git mutation, and no overclaim. A passing judge may only permit preparation of a post-freeze-candidate route packet.`

`freeze candidate treated as frozen live template`

`freeze candidate copied into live templates without judge`

`freeze candidate pass treated as promotion approval`

`freeze candidate output silently changes scripts`

`freeze candidate drops DNP`

`freeze candidate receipt claims safe/done/MVP`

`POST_FREEZE_CANDIDATE_ROUTE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PROMOTION_OR_LIVE_PACKET_V0_1`

The route packet must bind the template freeze candidate judge report, freeze candidate ready marker, freeze candidate root, freeze candidate manifest, freeze candidate index, freeze candidate DNP, freeze candidate hash ledger, source writer staging judge evidence, writer staging evidence, harness judge evidence, static validation judge evidence, source package judge evidence, selected route, route rationale, risk class, required next packet, blocked routes, no-execution fields, and hash custody. It may not promote files, write live roots, mutate command-center files, touch live assistant state, mutate git, approve live L0, mark safe, mark done, or activate MVP.`

`freeze candidate judge pass treated as promotion approval`

## 11BH.4 Route Options

Allowed route options:

```text
PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_FIRST
REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST
EXTRA_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST
EXTRA_STATIC_VALIDATION_FIRST
BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR
```

Preferred default after clean freeze candidate judge:

```text
PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_FIRST
```

Reason:

`Source package, static validation, harness sandbox, source writer staging, writer staging judge, freeze candidate creation, and freeze candidate judge have all passed within scope. The next bounded forward step is promotion candidate preparation, not live install or live L0. Promotion must still be one-time approved, hash-bound, staged, judged, and kept separate from live L0 approval.`

`REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
freeze candidate judge passed with non-blocking repair findings
freeze candidate manifest needs cleanup
freeze candidate index needs clarity
freeze candidate DNP is weak
transform ledger is valid but should be simplified
template/fixture/script mapping is confusing but not blocking
promotion mapping boundary is incomplete
```

`EXTRA_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
freeze candidate output changed layout enough to warrant sandbox testing
script candidate boundary needs dynamic pressure
fixture set changed after freeze candidate creation
promotion candidate would be risky without another harness pass
```

`EXTRA_STATIC_VALIDATION_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
freeze candidate should be statically checked as a freeze artifact
promotion mapping rules need static validation
manifest/index/DNP changed enough to warrant another static pass
transform ledger requires static consistency review
```

## 11BH.7 Route Selection Rules

The route selector must evaluate:

```text
freeze candidate judge passed
no freeze candidate blocker exists
freeze candidate root unchanged after judge
freeze candidate manifest unchanged after judge
freeze candidate index unchanged after judge
freeze candidate DNP unchanged after judge
freeze candidate hash ledger unchanged after judge
writer staging root unchanged
package candidate root unchanged
no promotion already occurred
no promotion candidate already exists unless exact-match/noop path is explicitly bound
no live install already occurred
no live L0 marker exists
no live root write exists
no git mutation observed
promotion candidate target boundary can be defined
promotion mapping can be defined
repair findings absent or explicitly selected
coverage gaps absent or explicitly selected
static validation gaps absent or explicitly selected
```

Selection logic:

```text
If freeze candidate judge is blocked -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If freeze candidate judge says repair route -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If freeze candidate root changed after judge -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If promotion marker, live install marker, live L0 marker, live write, git mutation, safe/done/MVP marker, or overclaim exists -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If freeze candidate judge passed and no repair/coverage/static gap exists -> PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_FIRST.
If repair finding exists -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If dynamic coverage gap exists -> EXTRA_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST.
If static validation gap exists -> EXTRA_STATIC_VALIDATION_FIRST.
If multiple routes selected -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
```

Failure labels:

`POST_FREEZE_ROUTE_SELECTOR_INPUT_MISSING`

`POST_FREEZE_ROUTE_SELECTOR_CONFLICT`

`POST_FREEZE_ROUTE_FREEZE_CHANGED_AFTER_JUDGE`

`POST_FREEZE_ROUTE_WRITER_CHANGED_AFTER_FREEZE_JUDGE`

`POST_FREEZE_ROUTE_PROMOTION_ALREADY_EXISTS`

`POST_FREEZE_ROUTE_LIVE_INSTALL_ALREADY_EXISTS`

## 11BI.1 Parent Rule

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_ONE_TIME_APPROVAL_AFTER_POST_FREEZE_ROUTE_V0_1`

`The promotion candidate creator may run only after the post-freeze-candidate route packet selects PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_FIRST. The approval must bind the post-freeze route packet, route decision ledger, route hash ledger, route ready marker, template freeze candidate judge report, template freeze candidate ready marker, freeze candidate root, freeze candidate manifest, freeze candidate index, freeze candidate DNP, freeze candidate hash ledger, source writer staging judge report, harness sandbox judge report, static validation judge report, source package judge report, promotion candidate creator script hash, promotion candidate root, promotion manifest path, receipt root, and one run ID. The promotion candidate creator may read the approved freeze candidate root and write only into the approved promotion candidate root. It may not write live templates, live fixtures, live scripts, live command-center files, live assistant state, git files, live install markers, live L0 approval, safe, done, or MVP activation.`

`promotion candidate run from freeze judge alone`

`promotion candidate writing directly into live roots`

`promotion candidate claiming safe/done/MVP`

`promotion candidate approval reused for a second run`

## 11BI.14 Promotion Candidate Creator Scope

The promotion candidate creator may later perform only these actions:

```text
read approved freeze candidate root
read approved freeze candidate manifest
read approved freeze candidate index
read approved freeze candidate DNP
read approved freeze candidate hash ledger
create approved promotion candidate root
write promotion candidate files into approved promotion candidate root
write promotion candidate manifest
write promotion candidate index
write promotion candidate DNP
write live target map as proposed-only
write rollback plan as proposed-only
write promotion candidate receipt
write promotion candidate hash ledger
write promotion candidate blocker receipt if blocked
write one-time use receipt
```

The creator may not:

```text
execute generated scripts
run source writer
run harness
run static validator
run self-test
modify freeze candidate root
modify writer staging root
modify original package candidate root
modify source body bundle
modify source_body_staging
write live templates
write live fixtures
write live scripts
write COMMAND_CENTER
touch live assistant state
mutate git
approve live L0
mark safe
mark done
activate MVP
```

Failure labels:

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_SCOPE_MISSING`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_GENERATED_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_CONFIRMED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_SOURCE_WRITER_INVOKED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_HARNESS_INVOKED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_STATIC_VALIDATOR_INVOKED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_SELFTEST_INVOKED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_FREEZE_ROOT_MODIFIED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_WRITER_STAGING_MODIFIED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_PACKAGE_CANDIDATE_MODIFIED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_SOURCE_BUNDLE_MODIFIED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_SOURCE_STAGING_MODIFIED`

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_LIVE_INSTALL_ATTEMPT`

## 11BI.15 Approved Command Shape

The approval packet may prepare, but not execute, this command shape:

```text
Mode: CREATE_PROMOTION_CANDIDATE
PromotionCandidateCreatorScriptPath: <approved creator script path>
FreezeCandidateRoot: <approved freeze candidate root>
FreezeCandidateManifestPath: <approved freeze candidate manifest path>
FreezeCandidateIndexPath: <approved freeze candidate index path>
FreezeCandidateDnpPath: <approved freeze candidate DNP path>
FreezeCandidateHashLedgerPath: <approved freeze candidate hash ledger path>
PromotionCandidateRoot: <approved promotion candidate root>
PromotionManifestPath: <approved promotion manifest path>
ReceiptRoot: <approved receipt root>
ApprovalPacketPath: <approval packet path>
RunId: <approved run id>
```

Forbidden command substitutions:

```text
Mode: PROMOTE_TO_LIVE
Mode: INSTALL_LIVE
Mode: LIVE_APPROVE
Mode: MARK_SAFE_DONE
Mode: PROMOTE_AND_GIT_COMMIT
PromotionCandidateRoot: BUILD_HARNESS\templates
PromotionCandidateRoot: BUILD_HARNESS\fixtures
PromotionCandidateRoot: COMMAND_CENTER
PromotionCandidateRoot: _LOCAL_CUSTODY_N_RECEIPTS
ReceiptRoot: live assistant state root
RunId: anything other than approved run id
```

Required approval fields:

```text
ApprovalExpiresAfterRun: true

ConsumedByRun:
```

After execution:

```text

MayReuse = false
```

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_APPROVAL_REUSE_ATTEMPT`

If run ID is changed:

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_RUNID_SUBSTITUTION`

If script, route, freeze candidate, freeze judge, writer judge, harness, static, or package hashes change:

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_HASH_MISMATCH`

If promotion candidate or receipt roots change:

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_BOUNDARY_MISMATCH`

`BATCH 11BI DEFINES THE PROMOTION CANDIDATE ONE-TIME APPROVAL PACKET. IT MAY LATER AUTHORIZE ONE PROMOTION-CANDIDATE CREATION RUN THAT READS THE JUDGED FREEZE CANDIDATE ROOT AND WRITES ONLY TO AN APPROVED PROMOTION CANDIDATE ROOT. IT BINDS POST-FREEZE ROUTE EVIDENCE, TEMPLATE FREEZE CANDIDATE JUDGE EVIDENCE, FREEZE CANDIDATE OUTPUT, SOURCE WRITER STAGING JUDGE EVIDENCE, HARNESS JUDGE EVIDENCE, STATIC VALIDATION JUDGE EVIDENCE, SOURCE PACKAGE JUDGE EVIDENCE, PROMOTION CANDIDATE CREATOR SCRIPT, PROMOTION CANDIDATE ROOT, RECEIPT ROOT, AND RUN ID. IT DOES NOT PROMOTE FILES, DOES NOT INSTALL LIVE TEMPLATES, DOES NOT WRITE LIVE ROOTS, DOES NOT TOUCH LIVE COMMAND_CENTER OR LIVE STATE, DOES NOT MUTATE GIT, AND DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0, SAFE, DONE, OR MVP ACTIVE. PROMOTION CANDIDATE OUTPUT, IF LATER OBSERVED, MUST BE JUDGED BEFORE ANY LIVE INSTALL OR LIVE-USE PACKET IS PREPARED.`

## OUTSIDE_ASSISTANT_COOPERATION_INDEX_V0.2

### Batch 11BJ — Promotion Candidate Judge Packet / Judge Promotion Candidate Before Live Install Route / No Live L0 Yet

Batch 11BI defined one-time promotion candidate approval. Batch 11BJ closes the next custody gap:

`PROMOTION CANDIDATE CREATED != PROMOTION CANDIDATE JUDGED.`

A promotion candidate is still not live. It is not installed. It is not promoted. It is not live L0. It is not safe, done, or MVP active.

Core rule:

`PROMOTION CANDIDATE OUTPUT IS EVIDENCE, NOT LIVE INSTALL AUTHORITY.`
`PROMOTION CANDIDATE JUDGE DOES NOT INSTALL LIVE FILES.`
`PROMOTION CANDIDATE JUDGE DOES NOT WRITE LIVE ROOTS.`
`PROMOTION CANDIDATE JUDGE DOES NOT MUTATE GIT.`
`PROMOTION CANDIDATE JUDGE MAY ONLY PERMIT PREPARING THE LIVE INSTALL ROUTE PACKET.`

## 11BJ.1 Parent Rule

`PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_OUTPUT_MUST_BE_JUDGED_BEFORE_LIVE_INSTALL_ROUTE_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After one promotion candidate creation run, the promotion candidate root, promotion candidate manifest, promotion candidate index, promotion candidate DNP, live target map, rollback plan, promotion candidate receipt, promotion candidate hash ledger, blocker receipt if present, one-time use receipt, approval packet, post-freeze route evidence, template freeze candidate judge evidence, freeze candidate evidence, source writer staging judge evidence, harness judge evidence, static validation judge evidence, source package judge evidence, and forbidden-output scan must be judged before any live install packet, live L0 packet, safe, done, or MVP activation packet may be prepared. The judge must verify approval scope, creator script hash, route hash, freeze candidate hashes, judge hashes, promotion candidate root boundary, promotion candidate structure, manifest rows, index fields, DNP coverage, live target map proposed-only status, rollback plan proposed-only status, body/control preservation, template/fixture/script preservation, transform ledger integrity, receipt honesty, hash custody, no generated-script execution, no freeze candidate modification, no live writes, no git mutation, no live install, and no overclaim. A passing judge may only permit preparation of a post-promotion-candidate route packet.`

`promotion candidate treated as live install`

`promotion candidate copied into live roots without judge`

`promotion candidate pass treated as live L0 approval`

`live target map treated as write approval`

`rollback plan treated as rollback proof`

`promotion receipt claims safe/done/MVP`

```text
promotion candidate approval packet
```

```text
freeze candidate index
```

```text
source package judge report

all fixture promotion candidate outputs
all script promotion candidate outputs
judge findings ledger
```

Batch 11BJ judged the promotion candidate. Batch 11BK closes the next custody gap:

`POST-PROMOTION ROUTE DOES NOT INSTALL LIVE FILES.`

## 11BK.1 Parent Rule

`POST_PROMOTION_CANDIDATE_ROUTE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_LIVE_INSTALL_OR_LIVE_L0_PACKET_V0_1`

Wording:

`After promotion candidate output is judged ready, a post-promotion-candidate route packet must select the next bounded path before any live install candidate packet, live install packet, live L0 packet, safe, done, or MVP activation packet may be prepared. The route packet must bind the promotion candidate judge report, promotion candidate ready marker, promotion candidate root, promotion candidate manifest, promotion candidate index, promotion candidate DNP, live target map, rollback plan, promotion candidate hash ledger, freeze candidate judge evidence, source writer staging judge evidence, harness judge evidence, static validation judge evidence, source package judge evidence, selected route, route rationale, risk class, required next packet, blocked routes, no-execution fields, and hash custody. The route packet may only authorize preparation of the selected next approval packet. It may not install live files, write live roots, mutate command-center files, touch live assistant state, mutate git, approve live L0, mark safe, mark done, or activate MVP.`

This blocks:

`promotion candidate judge pass treated as live install approval`

`live install packet prepared while repair findings exist`

`promotion candidate copied into live roots without live install candidate packet`

`live L0 packet prepared before live install candidate judge`

`rollback plan treated as rollback proof`

`post-promotion route claims installed/live/safe/done/MVP`

## 11BK.4 Route Options

Allowed route options:

```text
LIVE_INSTALL_CANDIDATE_FIRST
REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST
EXTRA_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST
EXTRA_STATIC_VALIDATION_FIRST
BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR
```

Preferred default after clean promotion candidate judge:

```text
LIVE_INSTALL_CANDIDATE_FIRST
```

Reason:

`Source package, static validation, harness sandbox, writer staging, freeze candidate, promotion candidate, and promotion candidate judge have all passed within scope. The next bounded forward step is live install candidate preparation, not live install and not live L0. Live install candidate must still be one-time approved, hash-bound, staged, judged, and kept separate from live install execution and live L0 approval.`

`REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
promotion candidate judge passed with non-blocking repair findings
promotion manifest needs cleanup
promotion index needs clarity
live target map is valid but confusing
rollback plan is valid but weak
target path mapping is incomplete
install boundary is incomplete
```

`EXTRA_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
promotion candidate output changed layout enough to warrant sandbox testing
script promotion candidate boundary needs dynamic pressure
fixture set changed after promotion candidate creation
live install candidate would be risky without another harness pass
```

`EXTRA_STATIC_VALIDATION_FIRST` may be selected if:

```text
promotion candidate should be statically checked as an install-facing artifact
live target map rules need static validation
rollback plan needs static consistency review
manifest/index/DNP changed enough to warrant another static pass
```

`POST_PROMOTION_ROUTE_OPTION_INVALID`

## 11BK.7 Route Selection Rules

The route selector must evaluate:

```text
promotion candidate judge passed
no promotion candidate blocker exists
promotion candidate root unchanged after judge
promotion candidate manifest unchanged after judge
promotion candidate index unchanged after judge
promotion candidate DNP unchanged after judge
live target map unchanged after judge
rollback plan unchanged after judge
promotion candidate hash ledger unchanged after judge
freeze candidate root unchanged
writer staging root unchanged
package candidate root unchanged
no live install already occurred
no live install candidate already exists unless exact-match/noop path is explicitly bound
no live L0 marker exists
no live root write exists
no git mutation observed
live install candidate target boundary can be defined
live install dry-run boundary can be defined
rollback preflight boundary can be defined
repair findings absent or explicitly selected
coverage gaps absent or explicitly selected
static validation gaps absent or explicitly selected
```

Selection logic:

```text
If promotion candidate judge is blocked -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If promotion candidate judge says repair route -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If promotion candidate root changed after judge -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If live install marker, live L0 marker, live write, git mutation, safe/done/MVP marker, or overclaim exists -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
If promotion candidate judge passed and no repair/coverage/static gap exists -> LIVE_INSTALL_CANDIDATE_FIRST.
If repair finding exists -> REPAIR_PACKET_FIRST.
If dynamic coverage gap exists -> EXTRA_HARNESS_PASS_FIRST.
If static validation gap exists -> EXTRA_STATIC_VALIDATION_FIRST.
If multiple routes selected -> BLOCKED_PENDING_REPAIR.
```

Failure labels:

`POST_PROMOTION_ROUTE_SELECTOR_INPUT_MISSING`

`POST_PROMOTION_ROUTE_SELECTOR_CONFLICT`

`POST_PROMOTION_ROUTE_PROMOTION_CHANGED_AFTER_JUDGE`

`POST_PROMOTION_ROUTE_FREEZE_CHANGED_AFTER_PROMOTION_JUDGE`

`POST_PROMOTION_ROUTE_LIVE_INSTALL_ALREADY_EXISTS`

`POST_PROMOTION_ROUTE_LIVE_L0_ALREADY_EXISTS`

`POST_PROMOTION_ROUTE_GIT_MUTATION_OBSERVED`

## 11BK.19 Batch 11BK Carry Line

`BATCH 11BK DEFINES THE POST-PROMOTION-CANDIDATE ROUTE PACKET. IT CHOOSES THE NEXT PATH AFTER PROMOTION CANDIDATE OUTPUT IS JUDGED READY. DEFAULT ROUTE IS LIVE_INSTALL_CANDIDATE_FIRST BECAUSE THE PROMOTION CANDIDATE HAS BEEN CREATED AND JUDGED WITHIN SCOPE, BUT LIVE INSTALL MUST STILL BE SEPARATELY APPROVED, HASH-BOUND, STAGED, JUDGED, AND KEPT SEPARATE FROM LIVE L0. THIS ROUTE PACKET DOES NOT INSTALL LIVE FILES, DOES NOT WRITE LIVE ROOTS, DOES NOT TOUCH LIVE COMMAND_CENTER OR LIVE STATE, DOES NOT MUTATE GIT, AND DOES NOT APPROVE LIVE L0, SAFE, DONE, OR MVP ACTIVE. IF READY, IT ONLY PERMITS PREPARING THE SELECTED NEXT APPROVAL PACKET.`

Next: **Batch 11BL — Live Install Candidate One-Time Approval Packet / Create Live Install Candidate Only / No Live L0 Yet**.
